item.title: The Optimal Ranking Tradeoffs Between Two Ranking Scores in Two-Class Classification
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-20　分类：论文PDF

The accuracy, true negative rate (negative class recall), true positive rate (positive class recall), negative predictive value (negative class precision), positive predictive value (positive class pr

The accuracy, true negative rate (negative class recall), true positive rate (positive class recall), negative predictive value (negative class precision), positive predictive value (positive class precision), class-specific intersections over unions, class-specific F-scores, Cohen's kappa, and balanced accuracy are scores that one intuitively wants to maximize when developing machine learning methods. However, they lead to different rankings of such methods. So, how can we establish a ranking that is an optimal tradeoff between any pair of these scores? It turns out that all these scores are special cases of ranking scores: a continuum of scores parameterized by the relative importance values assigned to the true negative, false positive, false negative, and true positive outcomes. Since all these scores are known to induce meaningful rankings, we seek the optimal tradeoffs among them. We consider the tradeoff between two scores to be optimal when it minimizes the Fréchet variance regarding the Kendall distance (also known as the bubble-sort distance) between rankings. For any given set of classifiers to rank, the optimal tradeoff lies at the center of the shortest (geodesic) path…

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Peak-Memory Schedules You Can Trust: Exact Realization, Certified Optimality, and the Limits of Recomputation for Inference
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-20　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题： 小设备实时推理需要低激活内存但不增加延迟——算子执行顺序是"免费的"内存杠杆，但编译器真的能做到吗？

方法： 不再信任编译器重新生成代码后能达到预测峰值，转而 profiling 已生成程序、从程序语句精确建模内存、对语句做排列搜索，证明在分配不依赖历史时总能精确兑现建模峰值。

关键数字： PyTorch Inductor 在 54 个 CPU 配置中 22 个未达预测峰值，9 个比原程序更差；GPU 上 50 个中 19 个更差且改变数值结果。

为什么值得看： 编译器不靠谱这件事在内存优化上被量化了，方法不依赖特定框架，对任何需要极致内存效率的推理部署都有参考价值。

item.title: PairSight: Characterizing and Predicting Operator-Level Interference in GPU Sharing for DNN Inference
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-20　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题： GPU 共享场景下，多个 DNN 推理任务共驻同一 GPU 时，算子级干扰到底来自哪里？能否做到既可解释又准确的慢化预测？

方法： 在 SM 分区下做算子级干扰实验，用硬件计数器追踪到共享内存路径上的争抢是关键根因；提出 PairSight，基于两算子特征联合预测慢化。

关键数字： 干扰取决于两个算子各自的内存带宽需求与计算强度组合，仅靠"算力型/内存型"二元分类远不够用。

为什么值得看： GPU 共享是降本关键手段，但粗暴的共存策略会引入不可预期的延迟抖动——这篇把干扰溯源到了可预测的算子级。

item.title: Memory Bandwidth, Not FLOPs: Profiling and Accelerating Query-Based Segmentation Decoders on Edge GPUs
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-20　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题： 边缘 GPU 上查询式分割模型（FastInst、Mask2Former）的 Transformer 解码器性能瓶颈究竟在算力还是内存带宽？

方法： 在 Jetson Orin Nano 上用 FP16 roofline 分析 + 硬件 DRAM 计数器做细粒度剖析，确认瓶颈后提出 CompactInst：用无参数 4× 空间池化压缩解码器内激活传输量，辅以双卷积精化头恢复空间细节。

关键数字： 非 Tensor Core 聚合仅占 CUDA-core 理论峰值的 2.5%–6%，却吃掉解码器 53%–70% 时间和 61%–71% 的字节搬运；单 kernel 可占满 90% DRAM 带宽。CompactInst 在 Jetson Orin Nano 上解码加速明显。

为什么值得看： 常见误区是"边缘推理瓶颈在算力"，本文用硬数据证明是内存带宽，且给出了无需重训的轻量解决方案。

item.title: Data-Driven Prediction of Optimal MPI Rank Placement and Node Count for Memory-Bound CFD on AMD EPYC Clusters
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-20　分类：论文PDF

Users who run a memory-bound OpenFOAM case on an AMD EPYC cluster must decide how many nodes to use and how many MPI ranks to place on each core complex.

Users who run a memory-bound OpenFOAM case on an AMD EPYC cluster must decide how many nodes to use and how many MPI ranks to place on each core complex. The fastest choice is often not the cheapest one. This paper revisits our earlier analytical model of this performance and energy trade-off with 560 measured configurations of the motorBike case on five Zen 4 and Zen 5 EPYC processors, including socket power from processor telemetry. On up to four nodes, small meshes are both fastest and cheapest on a single node on most processors. For the largest mesh the largest node count is both the fastest and the cheapest option, because its speedup is superlinear. A genuine trade-off arises only for medium meshes, where full speed costs a median of 20 to 97% more node hours than the cheapest option. The L3 miss rate and the halo traffic per cell are consistent with this pattern. For a new mesh of the same case, the configuration that was optimal on the nearest measured mesh is near optimal in 75 to 85% of the decisions. Running the two configurations it recommends for speed and for cost raises this share to 85 to 90% for runtime and node hours and determines the trade-off with median error…

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: A Taxonomy of Predicate Transformer Monads for Specifying Monadic Programs
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-20　分类：论文PDF

Monads of weakest precondition predicate transformers are the foundation of several verification frameworks for monadic programs.

Monads of weakest precondition predicate transformers are the foundation of several verification frameworks for monadic programs. For specifying monadic computations with nondeterminism and nontermination, in addition to weakest preconditions, we introduce the first strongest postcondition monads covering all combinations of angelic or demonic nondeterminism and partial or total interpretations of nontermination. For extending these base strongest postcondition monads with side effects such as mutable state, monad transformers do not yield the expected monads, so we instead generalize the base monads to arrows and use arrow transformers. We give a taxonomy of weakest precondition and strongest postcondition monads, for the base monads and for their versions with state, and show that the known relationships between under- and over-approximate triples based on predicate transformers already hold at the level of the predicate transformers themselves. We use the predicate transformer monads to define under- and over-approximate triples and, where possible, Dijkstra monads. Finally, we relate these two specification styles.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

阅读原文 ↗

item.title: qGAMMA: A Framework for Optimal DNN Mapping on Multi-Precision Accelerators
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-16　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：通用空间加速器支持多种定点/浮点精度，混合精度 DNN 该怎么映射才能最小化目标指标——能否有一个统一的探索与优化框架？

方法：qGAMMA 用领域专用遗传算法 + 基于硬件综合结果的分析性能模型，遍历映射与加速器配置设计空间，最小化目标指标。

关键数字：在多个 DNN 工作负载上的广泛评估显示，qGAMMA 能给出性能、能效与资源利用间的更优权衡（具体数字详见原文图表）。

为什么值得看：做混合精度映射与加速器设计选型的统一工具，把"试–错"变成可搜索的设计空间。

原文：qGAMMA: A Framework for Optimal DNN Mapping on Multi-Precision Accelerators

item.title: What Accuracy Hides In Learned Transformer Programs
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-16　分类：论文PDF

Transformer Programs (TP) (Friedman et al., 2023) constrain a Transformer's architecture so that its learned computation can be extracted as readable Python code.

Transformer Programs (TP) (Friedman et al., 2023) constrain a Transformer's architecture so that its learned computation can be extracted as readable Python code. TP expose learned computations, but token accuracy can hide incorrect complete answers. In this work, we examine how program inspection provides insights beyond accuracy scores and helps guide training. We first evaluated TP on nine algorithmic tasks. We compared token accuracy with accuracy on complete output sequences and checked for failures missed by sampled tests. Further, we assessed training data improvements informed by program inspection and failure analysis, finding gains in sequence accuracy on several tasks. We examined a counting task where a program achieved 100% accuracy on sampled test sequences but failed on another input using the symbols and lengths allowed during training. The program counted correctly, but the required answer was missing from its output labels. After adding training examples with larger counts, the retrained models passed exhaustive evaluation over the bounded domain. In the frequency ranking task, inspection showed how correct counts contributed to incorrect answers in programs train…

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Untrained CNN and coefficient-space regularization for joint reconstruction in photoacoustic tomography
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-16　分类：论文PDF

The joint reconstruction of the initial pressure and spatially varying sound speed in photoacoustic tomography from boundary measurements is considered.

The joint reconstruction of the initial pressure and spatially varying sound speed in photoacoustic tomography from boundary measurements is considered. A regularized data-driven framework is proposed in which the unknown fields are represented in finite-dimensional wavelet spaces and fixed nonlinear features generated by an untrained convolutional neural network (CNN) are used to reconstruct the initial-pressure coefficients through Tikhonov-regularized least squares. A learned coefficient-space prior is subsequently used to infer the squared sound-speed coefficients. Numerical experiments demonstrate accurate reconstruction on held-out data and strong generalization to previously unseen phantom geometries. The frozen reconstruction map also remains stable under measurement noise not represented during training, with only minor changes in reconstruction accuracy for noise levels up to $10\%$. In comparison with the supervised trained-CNN approach considered in this work, the untrained representation yields substantially smaller reconstruction errors while requiring approximately one-sixth of the computational time. These results demonstrate that fixed random convolutional features…

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Understanding KV Residency in Production-Scale Agentic LLM Workloads
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-16　分类：论文PDF

Agentic large language model (LLM) applications turn one user request into a sequence of model and tool calls over a growing context.

Agentic large language model (LLM) applications turn one user request into a sequence of model and tool calls over a growing context. Retaining this context's key-value (KV) state in GPU memory lets later calls reuse it instead of recomputing it, but at fleet scale this needs substantial memory. We characterize four production Microsoft M365 workload traces (Deep Research, Enterprise Assistant, Coding Agent and Enterprise Chat) spanning more than 121 million model calls. In Deep Research, the application issues 89% of model calls and the median context grows from about 10K to 68K tokens by the 30th call. About 80% of context tokens are served from the prefix cache. With the public Llama-2-70B KV layout standing in for confidential models, one 99th-percentile Deep Research session exceeds the 80 GB HBM of an NVIDIA H100, and holding all live sessions at their peak needs an estimated 501.8 TB of HBM, although inference occupies only 5.6% of that retention time. Trace-driven replay shows that a one-hour idle cap cuts this ceiling by 3.6x while raising the share of calls that recompute context only from 4.07% to 4.53%. Under tighter budgets, eviction alone is insufficient: at one tenth…

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: TriRouter: Sparse-to-Dense Electrode-Space Routing for Robust EEG Motor Imagery Decoding
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-16　分类：论文PDF

Motor imagery brain-computer interfaces require reliable decoding from multichannel EEG, but practical acquisition often yields sparse or corrupted electrode montages.

Motor imagery brain-computer interfaces require reliable decoding from multichannel EEG, but practical acquisition often yields sparse or corrupted electrode montages. We propose TriRouter, an electrode-space routing framework with discriminative-preservation, mask-robustness, and latent-compensation paths. A validation-calibrated router uses observable channel availability to allocate path contributions, preserving complete-channel discrimination while increasing representation recovery under severe missingness. In BNCI2014-001, TriRouter outperforms standard public backbones and a dynamic-spatial-filtering corrupted-EEG baseline. It improves accuracy over the strongest corrupted-EEG baseline by 3.68, 4.02, and 6.46 percentage points at nominal 25%, 50%, and 75% missing settings, and remains effective under structured regional missingness and additional low-channel dataset evaluation.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

阅读原文 ↗

item.title: Tree-Aware Posterior Distillation for Long-Horizon Agentic Reinforcement Learning
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-16　分类：论文PDF

Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards has become a scalable post-training paradigm for large language models.

Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards has become a scalable post-training paradigm for large language models. However, training agents over long-horizon interactions presents two challenges: using only terminal rewards makes turn-level credit assignment sparse and high-variance, while sequential mini-batch updates on a fixed rollout batch introduce policy staleness as the current policy drifts from the behavior policy. Existing approaches obtain denser credit via learned critics, process reward models, or on-policy distillation, but they rely on a value network, step-level annotations, or a stronger external teacher that increase training complexity. Meanwhile, importance sampling and clipping mitigate policy drift, but they do not specify a finite target that stops sequential updates from overshooting. In this work, we introduce TreeOPSD, a critic-free, tree-aware posterior self-distillation framework for long-horizon agentic reinforcement learning. Treating each interaction turn as a tree node, TreeOPSD branches alternative continuations from shared prefixes and recursively backs up terminal rewards into implicit turn-level credit. It then maps each credit to a closed-fo…

item.title: Towards Looped Models Done Right, Part I: Topology, Input Injection, Recurrent-State Design
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-16　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：循环语言模型用同一组物理 Transformer block 跨逻辑深度重复用，但 recurrence 位置、输入注入、循环状态组织常被混在一起——把这些轴拆开后哪一组合最优？

方法：在匹配参数/逻辑深度/token 预算下从零训练循环 Transformer，把 recurrence 位置、输入注入与循环状态组织三项正交化系统研究；优选 prelude-recurrent block-coda 三明治架构 + Huginn 风格设计，并迁移到 active-parameter 匹配的 MoE 模型。

关键数字：730M/336B token 规模下 Huginn 完整架构在 10 个基准上均优于 Ouro；优势迁移到 MoE：8B(32B unroll)/500B token 下知识/推理/编码基准近全胜；同 FLOPs 下常驻参数比 112 层 FF MoE 基线少 75%，DROP/GSM8K 仍优于基线，MATH500 持平。

为什么值得看：把循环模型设计从"各种变体"还原为可独立研究的三轴并给出 Huginn 风格的最优配方，做循环/重用参数模型的可参照蓝本。

原文：Towards Looped Models Done Right, Part I: Topology, Input Injection, Recurrent-State Design

item.title: TileDRAM: Compiler-Controlled Tile-to-DRAM Layouts for 3D DRAM GPGPUs
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-16　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：现代 GPU 编译器有 thread/on-chip 的丰富 layout 抽象，但 CU-local 3D DRAM 上没有 tile→DRAM 布局抽象；常规放置会让结构化 tile 访问撞到 row-buffer 冲突。

方法：TileDRAM 把 GPU Linear Layout 从计算侧映射扩展到 DRAM 放置坐标，按每个 tile 访问签名选 layout，以行缓冲行为单位评估候选；运行时仅做普通地址算术，无需新硬件或 ISA。

关键数字：在 Accel-Sim/Ramulator2 上 108 个 MoE FFN 用例的 full-trace replay：按请求加权的行冲突率从 75.7% 降至 15.2%，几何均速 1.77x；6 条 trace 在 6 种 3D DRAM 组织上几何均速 2.20x；RTX 3090 上地址变换可承受。

为什么值得看：把 GPU layout 抽象延伸到 3D DRAM 放置坐标，让编译器就能显著降冲突，做 GPU 编译器/3D DRAM 的桥梁工作。

原文：TileDRAM: Compiler-Controlled Tile-to-DRAM Layouts for 3D DRAM GPGPUs

item.title: The Sign Code: The Hidden Binary Nature of Deep Networks
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-16　分类：论文PDF

Every neuron in a trained network outputs a number that can be separated into its sign (positive or negative) and its magnitude (absolute size).

Every neuron in a trained network outputs a number that can be separated into its sign (positive or negative) and its magnitude (absolute size). We call the set of all neuron signs the \textit{sign code}. This raises a key question: does classification depend more on the sign code or on the magnitudes? For overparameterized vision classifiers with sign-preserving activations, the answer is overwhelmingly the sign code. A $k$-nearest neighbor classifier operating only on this binary sign code achieves accuracy comparable to the full model across different architectures, activation functions, and datasets. Moreover, replacing all magnitudes in every layer with random noise while keeping the original signs barely changes residual network performance. In contrast, flipping just 20\% of the signs reduces accuracy to chance. Models generalize well when same-class inputs share similar sign codes. When this overlap is disrupted by a regularizer, training accuracy remains high, but test performance collapses. A margin decomposition helps explain these results: the sign-only contribution to each logit grows as $\sqrt{d}$ in network width, dominating the magnitude residual. The natural unit o…

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: TALLOP: Joint Optimization of Local Training and Communication Compression for Time-Constrained Federated Learning
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-16　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：联邦学习里慢客户端拖累整轮时间；既有工作主要调本地计算，通信受限环境下通信压缩同样会成为瓶颈——如何在一个时间预算内联合调本地训练与通信压缩？

方法：TALLOP 用早期 mini-batch 损失轨迹预测不同计算预算可达训练损失（LENS），用压缩误差模型估计通信压缩损失（CLEN），二者组合求每轮时间预算下的最优本地训练工作量与通信压缩配比。

关键数字：在异构联邦环境下较仅调计算或仅调压缩的基线，达到目标精度所需墙钟时间更短（具体加速比详见原文图表）。

为什么值得看：把联邦学习的时间预算问题变成可联合优化的两个独立预测器，工程上可直接套用到联邦训练调度器。

原文：TALLOP: Joint Optimization of Local Training and Communication Compression for Time-Constrained Federated Learning

item.title: SETAREH Transform: A Sorting-Assisted Haar-Wavelet Sparsification Method for Approximate Inner-Product Computation
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-16　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：深度学习中高维输入/参数向量反复存储、传输、计算；模型压缩做得多，但输入向量本身的存储/通信开销仍是边缘/分布式部署的痛点。

方法：SETAREH 用 Haar 小波稀疏化：对固定系数向量与相继输入向量做相同置换 + Haar 变换，截断前保留精确内积；保留部分变换后的系数-输入对以减表示开销，引入可控近似误差。

关键数字：在合成高斯基线与 APPA-REAL 真实年龄估计任务上，用显著更少的非零项逼近被评估的内积（具体倍数详见原文图表）。

为什么值得看：把"输入向量通信开销"从模型压缩的盲区拎出来，给边缘/分布式推理一个可调近似内积机制。

原文：SETAREH Transform: A Sorting-Assisted Haar-Wavelet Sparsification Method for Approximate Inner-Product Computation

item.title: Response-Informed Value Estimation for Cost-Aware Multi-Turn LLM Routing
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-16　分类：论文PDF

Multi-turn LLM routing selects a model at every turn before its response is available, yet task success is revealed only when the interaction ends, leaving each intermediate choice without a label of its own.

Multi-turn LLM routing selects a model at every turn before its response is available, yet task success is revealed only when the interaction ends, leaving each intermediate choice without a label of its own. Logged trajectories, however, retain the response each call produced, which exposes what each turn required and how well the chosen model served it, evidence that outcomes alone hide. We introduce RIVET (Response-Informed Value Estimation for Turn-Level Routing), which exploits this post-call evidence during training while keeping routing strictly pre-call at deployment. RIVET jointly trains two value estimators over a shared state-model representation: a deployable Routing Value Estimator that scores candidate models from pre-call information, and a training-only Response-Informed Value Estimator that additionally observes the realized response. Conditioning on the response turns response-induced return variation from residual noise into an observed covariate, and we show that this reduces the leading asymptotic estimation error of the shared representation. On the MINT benchmark, RIVET solves more held-out tasks than the strongest multi-turn baseline while using 74.7% less t…

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: QuarkShard: Decomposing Cross-Shard Requests into Single-Input Transactions
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-16　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：分片区块链处理跨片用户请求时，传统"整体事务"范式同时带来片内 BFT 开销与片间通信开销——能否把跨片请求拆开降低两类开销？

方法：QuarkShard 把跨片请求分解为只需单分片共识与处理的"单输入分片事务"，并设计分解算法保证资金原子性或位置原子性；还通过结构特性增强抗 MEV/洪泛攻击能力。

关键数字：跨 4 个 AWS 区域的广域网评估峰值吞吐 1024k 请求/秒、时延 <4 秒；较传统分片协议吞吐提升最高 210.7%（具体基线对比见原文）。

为什么值得看：把跨片交易从"原子单体"解构为单输入事务，性能与安全性同时改善，分片链协议设计的新基线。

原文：QuarkShard: Decomposing Cross-Shard Requests into Single-Input Transactions

item.title: Predictable Scaling: Efficient Model Exploration via Scaling-Law Prediction
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-16　分类：论文PDF

Evaluating candidate changes (hypotheses) to recommendation models requires full-scale training runs consuming thousands of GPU-hours, severely limiting the hypothesis space engineers can feasibly explore.

Evaluating candidate changes (hypotheses) to recommendation models requires full-scale training runs consuming thousands of GPU-hours, severely limiting the hypothesis space engineers can feasibly explore. We introduce Predictable Scaling (PS), a systematic framework that exploits empirically verified regularity conditions to predict full-scale model performance from small-scale proxies. PS constructs scaled-down variants via composable scaling functions along distinct resource axes, and projects metrics to the target scale via curve fitting with calibrated uncertainty estimates. We compare three prediction strategies of increasing expressiveness: even the simplest (raw proxy) achieves prediction error within the empirical noise floor of repeated-run variance; the most expressive (Gaussian Process) provides an indicative 15% relative MAE improvement and calibrated uncertainty. Evaluation on two ranking models of increasing complexity---a task-specific model and a foundation model---demonstrates that PS correctly ranks actionable hypotheses across diverse hypothesis types at 79-88% compute reductions.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Ori: Drift-Aware Streaming $k$-PCA for Very Low-Rank LLM Training
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-16　分类：论文PDF

A prominent family of low-rank LLM optimizers, pioneered by GaLore, performs gradient-subspace projection: at each step, they project the gradient into a low-dimensional subspace and map the update back to the full model.

A prominent family of low-rank LLM optimizers, pioneered by GaLore, performs gradient-subspace projection: at each step, they project the gradient into a low-dimensional subspace and map the update back to the full model. Most existing work either recomputes the gradient subspace at certain intervals, or performs post-hoc adaptation to catch up to the moving subspace. In this work, we explicitly identify in practice the slow, stable manner in which LLM gradient subspaces drift across time. To this end, we propose Ori, a novel low-rank optimizer for training LLMs that captures the shifting principal gradient directions over time to achieve state-of-the-art accuracy under stringent low-rank constraints. Ori employs a streaming $k$-PCA algorithm inspired by Oja++, whose low per-step cost enables high-frequency, on-the-fly subspace tracking. In practice, Ori reduces the performance gap of the state-of-the-art low-rank optimizers to full-rank optimizers by up to 69.3\% on a 1B LLaMA pretraining task, and achieves the best performance on 10 out of 16 task scenarios in Roberta-Base fine-tuning. Together, these contributions allow Ori to further push the performance and efficiency frontier…

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.content:encoded:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-16　分类：论文PDF

A prominent family of low-rank LLM optimizers, pioneered by GaLore, performs gradient-subspace projection: at each step, they project the gradient into a low-dimensional subspace and map the update back to the full model.

A prominent family of low-rank LLM optimizers, pioneered by GaLore, performs gradient-subspace projection: at each step, they project the gradient into a low-dimensional subspace and map the update back to the full model. Most existing work either recomputes the gradient subspace at certain intervals, or performs post-hoc adaptation to catch up to the moving subspace. In this work, we explicitly identify in practice the slow, stable manner in which LLM gradient subspaces drift across time. To this end, we propose Ori, a novel low-rank optimizer for training LLMs that captures the shifting principal gradient directions over time to achieve state-of-the-art accuracy under stringent low-rank constraints. Ori employs a streaming $k$-PCA algorithm inspired by Oja++, whose low per-step cost enables high-frequency, on-the-fly subspace tracking. In practice, Ori reduces the performance gap of the state-of-the-art low-rank optimizers to full-rank optimizers by up to 69.3\% on a 1B LLaMA pretraining task, and achieves the best performance on 10 out of 16 task scenarios in Roberta-Base fine-tuning. Together, these contributions allow Ori to further push the performance and efficiency frontier…

item.title: One Communicator, Three Vendors: Extending the MoA Predictive Theory to a Real NVIDIA+AMD+CPU MPI Ensemble
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-16　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：将 MoA（Multiple of an Algorithm）预测理论扩展到首个真正的多厂商 MPI 通信器时，1/t 权重切分的假设在哪种硬件上会失效？

方法：用 Slurm 异构作业把 A100/MI100/CPU 共 9 个 rank 装入一个 MPI communicator；给出三路并发 1/t 权重切分理论与异构作业的可接受指令；用基于形状的 key/value 切分做 ring Allreduce，对每次测量记录提前预测。

关键数字：MI100 上 6 rows 实测 597 ms，1/t 线性预测仅 1.6 ms；通过改 launch 设置把 ~600 ms 降至 14.6 ms，6 rows 下每调用能耗降 32x；MI100 仍约比 A100 在 8192 rows 下慢 95x；8.5 MB Allreduce 实测 11.3/16.0/15.3 ms。

为什么值得看：揭示了 MoA 1/t 假设在 GPU 上的失效边界，并把异构 MPI 实测与理论预测摆在一起，异构 HPC 通信建模可直接借鉴。

原文：One Communicator, Three Vendors: Extending the MoA Predictive Theory to a Real NVIDIA+AMD+CPU MPI Ensemble

item.title: On the Power of Alternating Local Certification with Constant-Size Certificates
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-16　分类：论文PDF

We study alternation hierarchies for distributed decision in anonymous networks with constant-size certificates.

We study alternation hierarchies for distributed decision in anonymous networks with constant-size certificates. A prover and a disprover alternately assign certificates to nodes over a constant number of rounds, after which each node decides whether to accept based on its own input and the certificates observed in its neighborhood. An instance is accepted if all nodes accept. Unlike previous work on distributed alternation hierarchies, which considered restricted local computation (Reiter, PODC 2024) or logarithmic-size certificates (Feuilloley et al., ICALP 2016), we focus on constant-size certificates and the role of neighborhood information in determining expressive power. We consider three models: SET, where nodes observe only the set of certificate sequences of their neighbors; MULTISET, where multiplicities are also visible; and PORTS, where neighbors can additionally be distinguished by local port numbers. We establish that SET is strictly weaker than MULTISET, which is in turn strictly weaker than PORTS, and that all three alternation hierarchies are strict at every level. Despite their severe restrictions, these models are remarkably expressive: LEADER belongs to the thir…

item.title: Next Token or Vector? Learning How Far to Decode
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-16　分类：论文PDF

Standard autoregressive decoding advances one token at a time, even when several upcoming tokens can be predicted together.

Standard autoregressive decoding advances one token at a time, even when several upcoming tokens can be predicted together. We propose CADENCE (Context-Adaptive DEcoding), a generation method that learns both what to draft and how far to draft. Gaussian prediction heads represent future spans as continuous latent vectors, and a shared decoder converts the selected vector into token predictions in parallel. A learned router selects the prediction length from the model's own hidden states and predicted Gaussian parameters, adapting generation granularity to the current context with single-token generation as a fallback. The backbone verifies each proposed continuation and retains the prefix that matches its greedy predictions. Experiments with Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct on Alpaca, GSM8K, and HumanEval show that router-selected positions yield higher draft acceptance than applying the corresponding prediction length everywhere. CADENCE achieves up to 1.3x higher generation throughput than standard greedy decoding.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: MailRail: Mitigating Incast Congestion with User-Space, Node-Based Flow Control
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-16　分类：论文PDF

Irregular workloads, such as those stemming from Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) and Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models, frequently induce severe incast congestion in large-scale parallel environments.

Irregular workloads, such as those stemming from Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) and Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models, frequently induce severe incast congestion in large-scale parallel environments. Existing fabric-level congestion control mechanisms rely on reactive, link-level rate limiting that degrades overall throughput. While receiver-driven, credit-based flow control offers a proactive alternative, as process counts scale memory slots per rank fall below usable thresholds, rendering traditional rank-based accounting untenable. To address this challenge, we introduce MailRail, an out-of-order, asynchronous messaging framework, along with a novel user-space, node-based credit flow control system. By shifting credit accounting from individual processes to shared per-node pools, our proactive, fabric-agnostic approach maintains sufficient credit availability even as process density grows, enabling processes to dynamically utilize freed credits without waiting for receiver-side redistribution. Experimental evaluations demonstrate that node-based flow control achieves up to a 1132x speedup over unconstrained execution at an adversarial incast ratio of 4096:1 while adding minimal over…

item.title: Logic-Guided Graph Denoising Diffusion Models
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-16　分类：论文PDF

Graph diffusion models are competitive approaches for generating complex graph-structured data.

Graph diffusion models are competitive approaches for generating complex graph-structured data. However, when such distributions have strict structural constraints, diffusion models may fail to capture them exactly, resulting in the generation of invalid graphs. In this paper, we propose a method for grounding graph diffusion models in domain-specific knowledge via First Order Logic (FOL), leveraging its expressive and interpretable formalism to impose structural constraints on the generative process. We incorporate domain knowledge using classifier guidance, a technique that conditions the diffusion model's distribution on external variables to exert control over the sampled data. During the generative process, classifier guidance steers the denoising trajectory to optimize an objective function, which we define as a fuzzy and differentiable relaxation of the logical rules. Our methodology requires only the specification of constraints in FOL, whose satisfaction is encouraged at inference time to guide a pre-trained generative model. We evaluate our approach by comparing the unconditional generation of knowledge graphs with our logic-guided framework, which incorporates domain ont…

item.title: Local proxies for memory-efficient training
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-16　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：端到端反向传播要存所有激活，显存爆炸；现有 local learning 又常掉精度——能否在保持精度的同时把"全局反向"近似为块级局部代理？

方法：对每个 Transformer 块训练一个局部代理网络以蒸馏逼近全局网络输出；用代理独立反传来估计梯度；理论上对深度线性网络是精确的，对非线性残差模型梯度误差可被残差代理界定。

关键数字：CIFAR-100 + ViT 上代理传播相对其它 local 算法取得更优的精度/显存权衡；在小显存预算下微调 LLM 时比同等显存开销的零阶学习方法训练更快、性能更高。

为什么值得看：把"局部学习"从启发式变成"有理论保证的梯度近似"，小显存训练 LLM 的可选新底座。

原文：Local proxies for memory-efficient training

item.title: Large Diffusion Models Need More Than EMA
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-16　分类：论文PDF

Large-scale diffusion models are commonly trained with a constant learning rate (LR) and exponential moving average (EMA), despite the strong performance of LR decay and Schedule-Free optimization in training large language models.

Large-scale diffusion models are commonly trained with a constant learning rate (LR) and exponential moving average (EMA), despite the strong performance of LR decay and Schedule-Free optimization in training large language models. We study whether EMA is uniquely suited to diffusion training, or whether stronger alternatives have been underexplored. Our theory shows that averaging a constant-step trajectory has an inherent optimization limitation, whereas LR decay and Schedule-Free optimization admit vanishing stationarity guarantees under standard nonconvex assumptions. Empirically, LR decay and EMA provide complementary benefits: combining decay with EMA further improves the standard baseline at most tested starting points, although the gain remains sensitive to when decay begins. Schedule-Free avoids this timing requirement and consistently outperforms EMA with a constant LR across training stages, achieving both lower fixed-evaluation objectives and better generation quality. Our analysis further shows that all three strategies substantially reduce parameter variability, yet stronger stabilization is not always better: EMA with a constant LR retains comparatively higher parame…

item.title: LangNCO: Compiling Natural-Language Constraints into Inference-Time Interventions for Neural Combinatorial Optimization
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-16　分类：论文PDF

Neural combinatorial optimization (NCO) rapidly produces high-quality solutions for problem structures encountered during training, but operational requirements may change after deployment and be communicated in natural language.

Neural combinatorial optimization (NCO) rapidly produces high-quality solutions for problem structures encountered during training, but operational requirements may change after deployment and be communicated in natural language. We propose LangNCO, a framework that compiles instance-specific requirements into structured inference-time interventions for a frozen NCO solver, without changing the pretrained policy's architecture, learned input representation, or parameters. A pretrained LLM serves as a replaceable semantic front end, translating each requirement into a schema-validated domain-specific language (DSL) rule set. A deterministic Rule Executor applies the rules as nonexpansive hard action masks. Because local masking prevents immediate violations but does not ensure that a complete feasible continuation remains reachable, Critical-Offset Decoding extracts rule-referenced critical nodes and reallocates part of a fixed rollout budget to multi-strength biased rollouts. Using controlled task-specific language to isolate solver adaptation from open-ended language robustness, we evaluate a CVRP policy on road closures, time windows, vehicle assignments, visit-order requirements…

item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-16　分类：论文PDF

Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) have emerged as a promising alternative to autoregressive language models, enabling non-autoregressive text generation through parallel decoding.

Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) have emerged as a promising alternative to autoregressive language models, enabling non-autoregressive text generation through parallel decoding. Existing dLLMs can be broadly categorized into two families: masked diffusion models (MDMs) and uniform diffusion models (UDMs) In this work, we theoretically show that MDMs are easier to optimize due to their mask-based transition schedule but have lower computational expressivity, whereas UDMs enable iterative state revision and greater expressivity but are substantially harder to train. This trade-off raises a natural question: can we obtain the expressivity of iterative revision without giving up the simple, easy-to-optimize transition schedule of MDMs? Motivated by this analysis, we propose Lookahead Editing (\ours{}), which augments masked diffusion decoding with a rewritable proposal state. At each decoding step, the model performs several lookahead updates to iteratively refine future predictions in this proposal state before committing tokens to the masked sequence. item.title: JAXtari: High-Throughput and Easy-to-Modify Arcade Learning Environment
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-16　分类：论文PDF

The Arcade Learning Environment (ALE) has been a cornerstone of Deep Reinforcement Learning research, providing a standardized benchmark for evaluating general agents.

The Arcade Learning Environment (ALE) has been a cornerstone of Deep Reinforcement Learning research, providing a standardized benchmark for evaluating general agents. However, its lack of native support for object-extraction and environment modification restricts research into evaluating whether agents learn robust causal models or rely on brittle visual heuristics. Furthermore, the ALE's dependence on CPU-based emulation creates a significant bottleneck in modern GPU-accelerated training pipelines, limiting both experimental scale and iteration frequency. In this work, we introduce JAXtari, an open-source, high-performance reimplementation of Atari 2600 environments. By leveraging massive GPU parallelization, JAXtari allows PPO agents to finish training on 100M environment steps on a single A100-GPU in under an hour. Beyond speed, it provides object-centric observations and a flexible modification system, allowing researchers to, e.g. develop neuro-symbolic methods or discover novel shortcuts and subsequently train and adapt their agents rapidly, sometimes in only minutes.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Information Estimation with Discrete Diffusion
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-16　分类：论文PDF

Information-theoretic measures, such as Mutual Information (MI), play a crucial role in understanding non-linear relationships between random variables and are widely used across scientific disciplines.

Information-theoretic measures, such as Mutual Information (MI), play a crucial role in understanding non-linear relationships between random variables and are widely used across scientific disciplines. Yet, their use on real-world discrete data remains challenging. Existing methods typically rely on embedding discrete data into a continuous space and apply neural estimators originally designed for continuous distributions. This process requires careful engineering for both the embedding model and estimator architecture, but suffers from issues related to high data dimensionality. In this work, we introduce InfoSEDD, a discrete diffusion-based approach that bridges information-theoretic estimation and generative modeling such that they can be used to compute Kullback-Leibler divergences. Backed by Continuous Time Markov Chains theory principles, the design of InfoSEDD is lightweight and scalable and allows seamless integration with pretrained models. We showcase the versatility of our approach through applications on motif discovery in genetic promoter data, semantic-aware model selection in text summarization, and entropy estimation in Ising models. Yet, their use on real-world discrete data remains challenging. Existing methods typically rely on embedding discrete data into a continuous space and apply neural estimators originally designed for continuous distributions. This process requires careful engineering for both the embedding model and estimator architecture, but suffers from issues related to high data dimensionality. In this work, we introduce InfoSEDD, a discrete diffusion-based approach that bridges information-theoretic estimation and generative modeling such that they can be used to compute Kullback-Leibler divergences. Backed by Continuous Time Markov Chains theory principles, the design of InfoSEDD is lightweight and scalable and allows seamless integration with pretrained models. We showcase the versatility of our approach through applications on motif discovery in genetic promoter data, semantic-aware model selection in text summarization, and entropy estimation in Ising models. item.title: HBFSim: A Simulator for Exploring HBF in Memory Hierarchies for LLMs
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-16　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：高带宽闪存（HBF）号称 TB 级加速器本地容量与接近 HBM 的带宽，但 NAND 的高延迟、异地更新与写入寿命又会直接影响性能与寿命——能否在系统层量化这些影响？

方法：HBFSim 是 LLM 感知的异构 HBM+HBF 内存系统事件驱动模拟器，联合 HBM、带 host-managed FTL 的 HBF 与常规容量层，以校准的 serving 前端驱动模拟；保留应用级内存语义同时建模闪存内部行为。

关键数字：在 Llama-3.1-70B 与 Qwen3-235B-A22B 三种负载上，HBF 较 host DRAM 快 11.0–19.0x 提供超 HBM 数据；HBM 更适合放运行序列的 KV 而非作为 HBF 的缓存；Llama-3.1-70B 在发布峰值负载下 HBF 寿命 2.0–6.9 年。

为什么值得看：把 HBF 这个新兴存储层级从规格表变成可量化的系统权衡，做 LLM 内存层级选型可以直接拿来用。

原文：HBFSim: A Simulator for Exploring HBF in Memory Hierarchies for LLMs

item.title: GUMPIM: Unitary and Malleable Memory for Processing-in-Memory with Guaranteed PIM Pages
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-16　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：DRAM PIM 受内存交织与虚拟内存限制，可用 PIM 粒度受限；强行隔离 PIM 内存又会让 CPU 内存带宽下跌、引入额外数据搬运——如何兼得？

方法：GUMPIM 用统一可塑内存空间允许交织 CPU 页与非交织 PIM 页共存，带"保证 PIM 页"分配；提出双轨内存管理 + PIM DRAM 动态地址映射硬件 + PIM 辅助页迁移；无需改动商用 DRAM 标准，硬件修改只局限在 PIM-enabled DRAM。

关键数字：保持了 CPU 内存带宽，PIM 任务 offload 几乎零拷贝（具体基准数字详见原文图表）。

为什么值得看：把"PIM 内存隔离损失"与"PIM 内存墙"两难命题一起解决，做 PIM 系统/硬件的人必读。

原文：GUMPIM: Unitary and Malleable Memory for Processing-in-Memory with Guaranteed PIM Pages

item.title: GR-OPD: Group-Relative Sequence Credit for On-Policy Distillation
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-16　分类：论文PDF

On-policy distillation (OPD) provides token-level teacher feedback, yet common sampled-token updates assign credit locally and omit the effects of earlier actions on subsequent feedback.

On-policy distillation (OPD) provides token-level teacher feedback, yet common sampled-token updates assign credit locally and omit the effects of earlier actions on subsequent feedback. We introduce \method{} (Group-Relative On-Policy Distillation), which decouples feedback computation from credit assignment by aggregating token feedback into calibrated sequence-level credit. We establish a theoretical basis for this approach by showing that, under ideal on-policy assumptions, broadcasting raw summed feedback to every response token yields an unbiased estimate of the negative gradient of the sequence-level reverse-KL objective. To support effective learning in practice, \method{} discounts later feedback that may become less reliable under distribution shift and uses same-prompt rollout groups to calibrate teacher guidance. It preserves relative response preferences while retaining a controlled fraction of the group mean, which we term collective teacher pressure. Across five Qwen3 teacher--student settings and six mathematical reasoning benchmarks, \method{} outperforms vanilla OPD in macro Avg@K in every setting, including gains of 10.9 and 11.5 percentage points in two settings…

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Forecasting Voltage Time Series under Anomalies Using a WGAN Model With Lipschitz Control and Progressive Kernel Critic Strategy
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-16　分类：论文PDF

In time-series forecasting tasks, the use of recursive forecasting on high-dimensional data substantially increases the complexity of the prediction process.

In time-series forecasting tasks, the use of recursive forecasting on high-dimensional data substantially increases the complexity of the prediction process. The main challenge is that long-term dynamics becomes harder to model, since the sequences show greater temporal variability. To counteract this limitation and improve the modeling of long-term dynamics, and more importantly, address high-dimensional recursive forecasting, this paper uses a Wasserstein GAN equipped with a progressive Lipschitz penalty and an adaptive kernel. This model is capable of taking a window of the data stream and forecasting the next values, subsequently reconstructing the time-series stream and dynamically adapting its kernel to each new window. The proposed model is a deep learning framework based on a Wasserstein GAN (WGAN-CLP) with an adaptive kernel to model alterations in streaming voltage time series. To establish the methodological foundation, we review the WGAN-LP formulation another variant model in this class and extend its framework through an adaptive kernel critic model. item.title: Flash RNN-T: Memory-Efficient Joint Network and Transducer Loss Computation
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-16　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：流式 ASR 主流仍是 RNN-T，但训练需要存大中间张量，显存吃紧——能否在保持吞吐的前提下大幅压低显存？

方法：Flash RNN-T 用专门 kernel 做联合网络与 transducer 损失，支持可选的按对齐空间与词表的 tiled 重计算；不 tiled 与 tiled 两个变体覆盖吞吐-显存前沿。

关键数字：H100 上，untiled Flash 相对最快基线吞吐提升 24–39%、显存下降 26–56%（适用时）；tiled Flash 中等长度上显存降至 1/9（吞吐低 16%），长序列下在 80 GB 显存中其他方案均无法用单反向 batch 跑通。

为什么值得看：把流式 ASR 训练的显存-吞吐前沿完整刻画，做端侧/长流式语音训练的人可直接对照配置。

原文：Flash RNN-T: Memory-Efficient Joint Network and Transducer Loss Computation

item.title: Domain-specific language alignment of multimodal embeddings towards explainable predictions
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-16　分类：论文PDF

Multimodal data are commonly fused into latent representations that improve downstream task performance but are not interpretable, limiting their application in domains that require explainable model decisions.

Multimodal data are commonly fused into latent representations that improve downstream task performance but are not interpretable, limiting their application in domains that require explainable model decisions. Vision-language alignment has made image embeddings interpretable through language, but requires vast image-caption training data. However, captioned data are typically not available for multimodal embeddings, as relevant features cannot directly be observed and annotated from embeddings alone. Here, we propose a framework to language-align any embedding space that can be linked to interpretable auxiliary data. Captioning functions convert auxiliary data into partial captions; a soft contrastive loss weights pairs by the similarity of their properties that each caption describes; and a rank-based concept retrieval task evaluates alignment against the auxiliary data rather than the captions. We apply this framework to multimodal Earth embeddings to facilitate explainable predictions for two species distribution modelling tasks: S2BMS and SatBird. item.title: Deep LLM layers expose passage-level context in EEG during silent reading
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-16　分类：论文PDF

In a previous report we showed that a decoder can recover open-vocabulary word-level information from 19-channel EEG recorded during silent reading, by aligning short EEG windows with hidden-state emb

In a previous report we showed that a decoder can recover open-vocabulary word-level information from 19-channel EEG recorded during silent reading, by aligning short EEG windows with hidden-state embeddings of the presented word taken from a large language model (LLM). That analysis contrasted two of the model's 33 layers: the context-free input embedding and one mid-depth layer. Here we ask how EEG-decodable structure is distributed over the full depth of the language model. We trained one decoder per layer of Llama-3.1-8B, with and without a causal transformer over the sequence of EEG windows. We distinguish word-level decodability from a context-tracking component. Word-level decodability peaks in early layers and declines steadily towards the last layer. In contrast, the context-tracking component of the retrieval gain rises with depth, both with and without a causal transformer. Unexpectedly, a decoder that sees a single 0.5-s window at a time tracks the text passage too. Two new controls dissect this component. A target-geometry control, a synthetic predictor made of the true target plus noise calibrated to each decoder's word-level accuracy, shows that context tracking is n…

item.title: Data-Efficient Classifier Pretraining Through Diffusion Models
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-16　分类：论文PDF

Machine learning with limited data is susceptible to overfitting, especially with modern deep neural networks.

Machine learning with limited data is susceptible to overfitting, especially with modern deep neural networks. Prior to the introduction of AlexNet, reconstruction-based pretraining with auto-encoder and denoising auto-encoder were found to be beneficial, partially due to the limited size of the training sets at the time. Motivated by these traditional approaches, we propose DiffPT, a simple diffusion modeling approach to pretrain a given classifier backbone for limited domain-specific training data. We experiment on time-series data, standard natural-image benchmarks, and medical imaging datasets, and contrast the diffusion approach to a multitude of modern and traditional un/self-supervised methods. While contrastive pretraining performs better on CIFAR-10 and Tiny ImageNet in low-data regimes, DiffPT is particularly effective on medical imaging and time-series tasks, where it outperforms self-supervised baselines across a range of low-data regimes. Our results suggest that DiffPT is a simple and effective approach for data-efficient classifier pretraining on different modalities.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: DIFFLET: A Fast Inference Engine for Diffusion Transformer Models on AWS Trainium
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-16　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：AWS Trainium2 一切以固定 shape 预编译，扩散模型又跨请求/模型/缓存动态变化——如何在固定编译约束下做统一推理引擎？

方法：DIFFLET 用一个共享编译后端跑 5 种扩散流水线，注意力按 head 切到多核；host 控制器每步决定重跑去噪器或复用缓存，probe 程序在片上算缓存信号、常驻进程避免重加载。

关键数字：跨 5 种图像/视频模型，融合注意力较同框架 PyTorch/XLA 注意力提速 1.2–4.3x；在 32.8k 视觉 token 下是唯一可编译的注意力实现；4/5 模型上常驻 serving 较每次重加载快 1.5–3.4x。

为什么值得看：在硬件强约束下用"共享编译 + 注意力 head 切核 + 常驻"做扩散推理统一引擎，是 Trainium2 上做扩散推理的范本。

原文：DIFFLET: A Fast Inference Engine for Diffusion Transformer Models on AWS Trainium

item.title: CocoRNA: Collective RNA Design with Cooperative Multi-agent Reinforcement Learning
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-16　分类：论文PDF

Designing RNA sequences that reliably fold into specific secondary structures is essential for understanding their biological functions but remains a challenging computational problem.

Designing RNA sequences that reliably fold into specific secondary structures is essential for understanding their biological functions but remains a challenging computational problem. We propose CocoRNA, a cooperative multi-agent reinforcement learning framework for RNA inverse design. CocoRNA simplifies the design task by decomposing it into smaller sub-problems, each solved collaboratively by multiple agents. This approach reduces the complexity of the problem and improves the exploration of design policies. During training, a centralized critic uses global structural information to guide the agents, enabling them to jointly optimize their design strategies. As a result, CocoRNA learns high-quality RNA design policies that generalize effectively to unseen structures without additional training. Experiments on the Rfam dataset demonstrate that CocoRNA substantially outperforms state-of-the-art methods in both success rate and design speed. Further experiments on other biological sequence design tasks highlight the effectiveness and broad potential of CocoRNA for complex design tasks.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Bridging Compressed Communication and Local Steps via Spectral Method in Federated Learning
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-16　分类：论文PDF

Federated Learning (FL) enables collaborative training of complex models across large-scale networks of edge devices while keeping data localized.

Federated Learning (FL) enables collaborative training of complex models across large-scale networks of edge devices while keeping data localized. However, data heterogeneity and high communication overhead remain fundamental bottlenecks. Recently, the spectral optimizer Muon has demonstrated remarkable advantages over Adam-like methods in centralized training. While recent efforts have attempted to transition Muon to FL, naive integrations into traditional architectures fail short. Crucially, existing approaches do not support the the communication compression and local steps --- the two foundational techniques of efficient FL. To address this limitation, we introduce a novel spectral FL method that utilizes both local updates and compression. We establish rigorous convergence guarantees under mild assumptions, notably eliminating the restrictive bounded heterogeneity condition. Empirical evaluation on standard image classification benchmarks validates the efficiency and robustness of our approach.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Blitz: Accelerating the Diffusion Modules of AlphaFold3 and Boltz-2
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-16　分类：论文PDF

Diffusion-based protein structure prediction models produce all-atom structures in about 200 denoising steps, and that cost has driven a number of few-step samplers.

Diffusion-based protein structure prediction models produce all-atom structures in about 200 denoising steps, and that cost has driven a number of few-step samplers. We present Blitz, a few-step distillation framework that uses a geometric noise schedule to distribute steps more evenly across noise scales, then learns those updates through multistep consistency training. Physical steering and target-free candidate selection help reduce the remaining geometric defects at inference. We apply Blitz to AlphaFold 3 and Boltz-2, reducing denoising from 200 steps to eight. Because published few-step results use different benchmarks and scoring procedures, we compare both distilled models with their teachers and other few-step methods under a common evaluation protocol covering structural accuracy, interface quality, ligand placement, and stereochemical validity. Blitz retains teacher-level structural accuracy, with AF3-Blitz outperforming all evaluated few-step baselines and exceeding its teacher on several accuracy metrics.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Beyond Marginal Influence: Interaction-Aware Memory Selection for LLM Agents
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-16　分类：论文PDF

LLM-agent memory selection often uses retrieval rankings based on record relevance or individual influence.

LLM-agent memory selection often uses retrieval rankings based on record relevance or individual influence. Such rankings cannot identify sufficient subsets under redundant or jointly necessary evidence. We study per-decision memory sufficiency: selecting a small subset that preserves full-memory behavior. To separate search error from model error, we introduce JointCoreBench, a benchmark with nine interaction families, six workflow domains, natural-language decisions, and exact sufficient-set oracles, and JointCore, a relevance cost-ordered group-deletion baseline that tests blocks before individual records. On 6,912 exact conditions, cost-ordered JointCore recovers a minimum-cost sufficient set in 100.0% of cases, reduces subset evaluations from 30.00 to 11.13 (62.9%), and achieves 87.8% active-memory savings. Across four 12B-70B model families and 432 tasks per model, its unweighted mean is 10.28 versus 16.00 model queries and 50.6% versus 43.1% minimum-cost recovery relative to cost aware singleton deletion. Both methods preserve full-memory behavior under the deterministic primary interface. Tests with physical deletion, UNKNOWN masks, PENDING sentinels, counterfactual values,…

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Benchmarking and Enhancing Agentic Causal Discovery
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-16　分类：论文PDF

LLM agents can now run causal discovery algorithms on a dataset and report what comes out.

LLM agents can now run causal discovery algorithms on a dataset and report what comes out. Whether they do more than that, such as noticing where an algorithm went wrong and fixing it with further tests, is hard to tell from current benchmarks. Most of them give the variables meaningful names, and an LLM shown only the names of the Tübingen cause-effect pairs already gets 99% of the directions right. With the names removed, the data are usually clean enough that picking a better algorithm than PC closes most of the gap. We introduce Heuresis, a benchmark of anonymous simulated datasets whose mechanisms range from linear Gaussian to heavy-tailed. For each family of datasets it separates what a better existing algorithm can gain from what only a closer look at the data can gain, and it traces every edge an agent changes. Every family leaves a gap that none of the algorithms, the router and the two causal-discovery foundation models we ran can close, so a score above the best chosen algorithm has to come from using the data. We instantiate the benchmark with an agent harness and three LLMs, GPT-6.1 Sol, Claude Opus 5.5 and Qwen 3.8 Flash. GPT-6.1 Sol surpasses the best chosen algorith…

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: BaGuaLu-2: Taming Dynamic Memory Fluctuation for Efficient MoE Model Training over 10,000 GPUs
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-16　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：细粒度 MoE 训练中专家负载动态失衡带来严重显存波动；静态预留要么浪费要么 OOM——能否做到"按需"显存供给？

方法：BaGuaLu-2 把显存分配从一次性静态调参改为持续细粒度控制，按 batch 按需给精确的激活显存；并通过系统优化抵消动态管理开销。

关键数字：12,288 GPU 上训练 1040B 参数 MoE，维持 2 EFlops 以上、MFU 35%；较 Megatron-Kuai 与 AdaPipe 平均吞吐提升 1.14x / 1.13x。

为什么值得看：万卡 MoE 训练把"动态显存"从工程 hack 推到系统性能力，做大规模 MoE 训练基础设施的可读蓝本。

原文：BaGuaLu-2: Taming Dynamic Memory Fluctuation for Efficient MoE Model Training over 10,000 GPUs

item.title: BS-Spec: BFP-Based Bit-Sharing for Self-Speculative LLM Decoding with LUT-Driven Mixed-Precision Acceleration
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-16　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：传统投机解码要独立草稿模型与 KV，自投机方法配置又对负载不敏感——能否从一个 BFP 目标模型直接派生多档位草稿并配合硬件加速？

方法：BS-Spec 从同一 BFP 目标模型按位共享导出多种草稿表示（仅加载权重与 KV 的最高位、共享指数，省去独立草稿存储）；离线校准为不同 serving 区间选精度对，运行时查 LUT 应用；配套设计了 LUT 驱动的变精度 BFP 加速器 datapath。

关键数字：相对常规自回归解码最高 1.9x 加速；较已有位共享自投机解码基线平均提速 67.2%。

为什么值得看：把"自投机 + 混合精度 + 硬件加速"整合为一套统一框架，对自投机硬件落地与加速器 datapath 设计都是直接参考。

原文：BS-Spec: BFP-Based Bit-Sharing for Self-Speculative LLM Decoding with LUT-Driven Mixed-Precision Acceleration

item.title: BMuon: Budgeting Muon's Spectral Geometry for Structured Compressibility
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-16　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：Muon 优化器在谱范数几何下表现强，但训练后的 Transformer 在 MLP 隐通道被结构化剪枝时性能掉得快——能否让 Muon 本身就为结构化压缩而训练？

方法：BMuon 改写 Muon 的谱几何，让跨 block 的隐通道共享一份"分配预算"；其 oracle 等价于在一族介于 Muon 几何与结构化稀疏几何之间的范数下的归一化最速下降；推导了 minorization–maximization 代理用于实际训练。

关键数字：在 ImageNet-1K ViT-S/16 上逐步结构化 MLP 剪枝时优于 Muon，且学到的通道分配比权重幅值更准；1B 参数 LLaMA-style 模型在 FineWeb 训练 + 训练后 MLP 通道剪枝下也优于 Muon。

为什么值得看：把"优化器几何"与"结构化压缩预算"打通，给"训完即压"提供了一个原理性配方。

原文：BMuon: Budgeting Muon's Spectral Geometry for Structured Compressibility

item.title: Anisotropic Representation Dynamics in Transformers
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-16　分类：论文PDF

Small differences between internal representations can shrink or grow as they pass through a Transformer layer, affecting how information is preserved and how sensitive the model is to perturbations.

Small differences between internal representations can shrink or grow as they pass through a Transformer layer, affecting how information is preserved and how sensitive the model is to perturbations. Yet it remains unclear when changes in attention weights can turn a representation difference that would otherwise shrink into one that grows. We develop a \textbf{Mixture-Gated Theory of Anisotropic Representation Dynamics} that separates self-attention into value transport, query gating, and key gating. Our analysis reveals how the geometry of attended representations constrains gating and how interactions between these mechanisms can reverse contraction induced by value transport. We formalize this phenomenon as gating-induced regime switching, where a representation difference contracts under fixed attention routing but expands under full attention. We derive a necessary and sufficient spectral criterion that certifies the existence or absence of switching and identifies switching directions without exhaustive search. Beyond existence, our theory characterizes maximum relative switching strength, certifies the severity of contraction that gating can overcome, and determines the lar…

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Agentic AI for Heterogeneous System Design Across Chip, Scale-Up, and Scale-Out Domains
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-16　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：现代 AI/HPC 系统设计空间跨架构（GPU/dataflow/RISC-V）、存储（HBM/GDDR/SRAM）、互联（NVLink/UALink/IB 等），组合爆炸到无法人工遍历——LLM 能否做设计代理？

方法：ArchAgent：分层多代理框架——LLM planner 把系统设计拆为 chip/scale-up/scale-out 三个子问题，由专家 agent 各自处理；性能估计由确定性分析评估器闭环给出，避免 LLM 直接生成数字。

关键数字：在 1 MW 功率预算下，混合 AI+HPC 负载上较同构 GPU 基线加权几何均速 1.93x；ArchAgent 仅需 18 次评估，hill climbing 100 次评估仅 1.65x。

为什么值得看：把"LLM 做设计代理"从 demo 推到"分析评估器闭环 + 真实功率预算下显著加速"，做系统设计的可以套这套流程。

原文：Agentic AI for Heterogeneous System Design Across Chip, Scale-Up, and Scale-Out Domains

item.title: ADT: All-Atom Diffusion Tokenizer for 3D Molecular Structures
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-16　分类：论文PDF

Discrete structural tokenization provides a promising route to autoregressive 3D molecular generation.

Discrete structural tokenization provides a promising route to autoregressive 3D molecular generation. Yet, existing tokenizers face a trade-off between compact representation and all-atom reconstruction: atom-level tokens preserve atomic details but produce long sequences, while compact residue-level protein tokens typically omit side-chain geometry. To overcome this limitation, we propose All-atom Diffusion Tokenizer (ADT), which decouples token granularity from reconstruction resolution. ADT uses one structural token per atom for small molecules and one token per protein residue that jointly represents backbone and side-chain geometry. To mitigate geometric distortion introduced by quantization, we leverage the generative capacity of diffusion models to recover fine-grained atomic geometry beyond deterministic decoding from discrete tokens. Extensive experiments across small molecules and proteins demonstrate that ADT achieves strong reconstruction from compact discrete representations while enabling high-quality autoregressive generation of both small molecules and all-atom protein structures. These results establish compact structural tokens as an effective discrete interface …

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: A Stronger Teacher Within: Strengthening MoE Models via On-Policy Bidirectional Distillation
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-16　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：MoE 的 RLVR 奖励信号稀疏；on-policy 蒸馏需要更强的同源教师，自蒸馏又依赖特权信息——能否让 MoE 自身充当更强教师？

方法：MoEvolve 采用"恢复-再提升-反向回灌"的链式流程：先恢复高-k 模型，再利用其更多激活预算提升能力，然后反向把能力蒸馏回原低-k 学生，保留推理时的激活预算不变。

关键数字：跨多种 MoE 与基准上较初始模型平均提升最高 22.2 分；同算力 RLVR 基线之上再涨最高 6.5 分；最终低-k 模型常常超过其高-k 教师。

为什么值得看：无需外部教师就能在原激活预算下涨点的双向蒸馏，做 MoE 蒸馏与训练的人都该看。

原文：A Stronger Teacher Within: Strengthening MoE Models via On-Policy Bidirectional Distillation

发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-16　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：MoE 的 RLVR 奖励信号稀疏；on-policy 蒸馏需要更强的同源教师，自蒸馏又依赖特权信息——能否让 MoE 自身充当更强教师？

方法：MoEvolve 采用"恢复-再提升-反向回灌"的链式流程：先恢复高-k 模型，再利用其更多激活预算提升能力，然后反向把能力蒸馏回原低-k 学生，保留推理时的激活预算不变。

关键数字：跨多种 MoE 与基准上较初始模型平均提升最高 22.2 分；同算力 RLVR 基线之上再涨最高 6.5 分；最终低-k 模型常常超过其高-k 教师。

为什么值得看：无需外部教师就能在原激活预算下涨点的双向蒸馏，做 MoE 蒸馏与训练的人都该看。

原文：A Stronger Teacher Within: Strengthening MoE Models via On-Policy Bidirectional Distillation

item.title: A Minimal ReLU Classifier on Non-Linearly Separable Data: Convergence and Implicit Bias at and beyond the Edge of Stability
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-16　分类：论文PDF

Gradient descent (GD) with large learning rates can successfully optimize neural networks even though classical smoothness-based learning rate conditions are violated.

Gradient descent (GD) with large learning rates can successfully optimize neural networks even though classical smoothness-based learning rate conditions are violated. Yet theory for this regime largely covers linear models or linearly separable data. We analyze a minimal setting outside both regimes. Specifically, a two-neuron ReLU network trained with logistic loss on 1D non-linearly separable data. The objective is nonconvex and nonsmooth, and GD exhibits edge-of-stability (EoS) behavior. We identify an active cone in parameter space that contains every perfect classifier, where the problem becomes piecewise logistic regression with a varying effective dataset. Within this cone, we prove a finite-time loss bound for constant learning rates and show that GD converges in direction to an explicit max-margin vector, while the orthogonal component converges to the unique minimizer of a non-strongly convex potential. We further establish catapult results where exponentially small loss is reached after a single loss spike. Furthermore, we propose an adaptive schedule that lets learning rates grow to infinity without leaving the active cone. We prove that this schedule achieves a loss r…

item.title: Your Transformer Is Secretly Elastic
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：模型家族只提供少数固定尺寸（S/B/L），用户必须按硬件与延迟约束预先选定一个模型，面对波动负载这种刚性往往次优。

方法：提出免重训的弹性化方法，把预训练 transformer 变成单个可按算力预算在线自适应的模型。核心是对功能单元排序问题的可微松弛：不像以往按 MLP 块或注意力头给单一重要性权重，而是在统一尺度上联合排序每一个 MLP 神经元与注意力头，一次性在多个稀疏度目标下最小化软剪枝损失。

关键数字：27 个 22M–8B 参数的视觉/文本 encoder 上，稀疏度至 60% 均平滑退化且深剪枝下优于 one-shot 基线；DINOv3 ViT-H+/16 剪到 50% 移除 4.27 亿参数，ImageNet-1k 线性探测精度仅降 0.8%；AugReg ViT-B/16 在 60% 稀疏度下于 A100 吞吐量最高提升 1.80×、单查询延迟降低 1.26×；弹性模型分钟级产出，构建时间随参数量次线性增长。

为什么值得看：一个模型在连续算力谱上即时伸缩，免去为不同部署场景在家族里选尺寸。

item.title: Why don't Graph Transformers attend to the same token?
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF

In large language models (LLMs), attention concentrates heavily on the first token.

In large language models (LLMs), attention concentrates heavily on the first token. This 'attention sink' is believed to protect deep models against over-mixing. Even though graph transformers face a related pressure, we find that a SoTA graph transformer, GRIT, rarely forms sinks on molecules, and that it sinks less when trained on larger graphs, the opposite of the trend in LLMs. In principle, a graph can prevent sinks: we prove and show empirically that its symmetry and locality limit the attention any node can receive. On molecules, however, with distinguishable atoms and global attention, neither limit prevents sinks; what stops them lies in the model. We find that the attention scoring function is the main cause. Replacing GRIT's gated logit with a dot product raises its sink rate from 0.09 to 0.68 on identical graphs. In Graph Transformers using dot-product attention, removing the sink gives about the same error as removing a random node, while GRIT's most-attended nodes matter to its predictions. Attention sinks are therefore a property of dot-product attention rather than of Transformers. In our experiments, they form when dot-product scoring has a distinguishable node to …

item.title: Where to Start, How to Move: Analyzing Curricula under GRPO for Long-Horizon LLM Agents
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF

Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) provides no reward-relative learning signal when all rollouts receive identical rewards.

Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) provides no reward-relative learning signal when all rollouts receive identical rewards. In long-horizon tasks that require multiple interactions, rewards are given only upon successful task completion, making all-fail groups common early in training and limiting opportunities to practice later steps. Guide Assisted GRPO replays a successful reference prefix before the learner continues. We study how initial positions, handoff units, and movement rules affect unassisted task completion. Across three model sizes on BFCL, starting near completion is more effective under a fixed turn-level threshold rule. Finer handoffs alone do not consistently help, but outcome-informed tool-call selection outperforms GRPO on trained and untrained task categories. Guided starts also improve AppWorld success on both evaluation splits. These findings highlight where learning starts and how starting positions move as key curriculum choices.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: When the KV Cache Is Slower Than the GPU: Scaling Remote KV Tiers for Context-Parallel Prefill
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：长上下文 LLM 服务常用远程分层（remote tier）承载跨请求复用的 KV 缓存，但开启后为什么 p99 反而恶化、队列变得不稳定？远程 KV 层该怎么扩展？

方法：在 8×B300 节点上研究 GLM-5.3（FP8 MoE + MLA）上下文并行 prefill（PCP8）部署中的 LMCache/Valkey 远程层；建立两项成本模型——命中只在远程带宽超过盈亏平衡点 B* 时才划算，且每次命中有固定引擎成本 T0；据此做三件事：把 MLA KV 库跨 PCP rank 分片（附最长前缀查询正确性证明与不会打乱集合通信的加载协议）、按 rank 划分远程层（每 rank 一个 server 实例、无需协调）、加异步加载。

关键数字：开启远程层后 16k token 的 p99 从 3.96 s 涨到 17.3 s（中位 TTFT 不变）；远程命中耗时 0.88 s，重算 prompt 仅 0.31 s；同步加载下 p99 达 83.32 s 而 GPU 利用率只有 7%；该模型与 GPU 的盈亏平衡带宽 B*=2.53 GB/s、T0≈0.33 s，短于约 17k token 的 prompt 命中在任何带宽下都不如重算；按 rank 划分后 GET 带宽提升 6.3 倍至 10.76 GB/s。

为什么值得看：用量化成本模型驱动系统设计的完整案例，给出可直接套用的设计阈值；做推理系统与 KV 缓存分层的人值得精读。

item.title: When Non-Adversarial Noise Hurts Learning: Benchmarking Skill Self-Evolution in Agents
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF

Large language model agents increasingly improve by distilling experience into reusable skills, but errors in that experience can persist in learned rules and affect later tasks.

Large language model agents increasingly improve by distilling experience into reusable skills, but errors in that experience can persist in learned rules and affect later tasks. Existing evaluations largely examine clean learning or perturbations encountered after skills are frozen, leaving robustness during self-evolution insufficiently understood. We introduce RSE-Bench, to our knowledge the first benchmark for evaluating skill self-evolution under ordinary, non-adversarial noise. It spans four domains and six benchmarks, with controlled perturbations to instructions, environmental evidence, execution records, and outcome--record pairings that preserve the underlying tasks and native scoring rules. The protocol separates noise during learning from input-side noise at evaluation, testing frozen skill stores on held-out tasks. We also introduce \textsc{RSEClaw}, a method-agnostic framework supporting consistent noise injection and process diagnostics of actual exposure and skill updates. Across three methods and two backbones, noisy learning retains only $25.5\%$--$42.1\%$ of the aggregate gain achieved by clean self-evolution, depending on the noise type. Perturbations confined t…

item.title: When Does Muon Actually Win? A Paired Data-, Time-, and Tuning-Budget Benchmark
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：Muon 优化器以数据效率高著称，但在明确限定数据、时间和调参预算后，它到底什么时候比 AdamW 强？

方法：单张 A100 上，用参考实现的 Muon 与 AdamW 配对对比：17.7M 与 33.6M 参数的因果语言模型、2.70M 参数的视觉 Transformer；统一的 23 候选开发预算选配置，每配置 5 个匹配种子、完整验证轨迹、优化器单步计时、冻结的一次性测试。

关键数字：相同数据量下，Muon 把验证损失 AUC 降低 3.25%–22.44%，全部 20 组主要配对中测试损失都更低；时间归一化的损失 AUC 在视觉上 Muon 好 19.68%–22.31%，在语言上 AdamW 反而好 3.38%–6.96%；Muon 完整优化器调用（含辅助 AdamW 更新）占训练时间的 56.1%–69.6%，AdamW 基线仅 6.1%–9.1%。

为什么值得看：少见的诚实配对基准——明确指出小模型、参考核的墙钟排序不能外推到大模型或优化实现，且把 Muon 自身的优化器开销问题量化摆上台面。

item.title: When Does Depth Help? Understanding Layerwise Inference in Tabular Foundation Models
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF

Transformer-based tabular foundation models (TFMs) achieve state-of-the-art performance on small to medium-sized tabular prediction tasks while processing diverse inputs through a shared stack of layers.

Transformer-based tabular foundation models (TFMs) achieve state-of-the-art performance on small to medium-sized tabular prediction tasks while processing diverse inputs through a shared stack of layers. Recent layerwise analyses identify strong predictive performance in early TFM representations and substantial overlap in computation across layers. However, early predictive accessibility alone does not establish whether later layers are dispensable for every input, and aggregate accuracy can obscure which inputs benefit from additional computation. We study all 24 in-context-learning layers of TabPFN-3 across 272 classification datasets, combining representation geometry, prediction trajectories, truncation, and structural interventions, while also examining related representation dynamics in four additional TFMs. We uncover a pronounced expansion-compression trajectory, with stronger late dimensional contraction associated with larger increases in class-prototype separation. A targeted analysis of early-stabilizing samples shows that substantial representational changes persist after predicted classes stabilize, while locally ambiguous queries obtain larger accuracy gains from sh…

item.title: What Information Buys in Active Inference
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF

Information-theoretic exploration is of primary interest in methodological studies of reinforcement learning (RL) and computational cognitive neuroscience, while the established RL theory builds regret guarantees on confidence sets.

Information-theoretic exploration is of primary interest in methodological studies of reinforcement learning (RL) and computational cognitive neuroscience, while the established RL theory builds regret guarantees on confidence sets. This situation leaves open the conditions under which the information-driven exploration found in nature is more advantageous than the exploration of the established RL theory. We put the state-of-the-art methods of these two paradigms, Active Inference (AIF) and Bayes-UCBVI, on an equal footing: both act through the same state abstraction of a tabular MDP with $S$ states, and their greedy forms differ only in the exploration term. We find that AIF's information gain decays too fast to serve as a confidence width, locking greedy agents that explore by it out of the optimal action. Calibrating the information gain by a square root yields calibrated AIF, which attains regret of order $\sqrt T$ for an exact abstraction, but no better guarantee than Bayes-UCBVI for a fixed reward. When an adversary chooses rewards from the agent's data, Bayes-UCBVI's value-specific widths lock out, whereas calibrated AIF pays a factor $\sqrt S$, which no goal-memoryless age…

item.title: Waypoint-OPD: Transferring RL-Induced Policy Shifts via Gated On-Policy Distillation
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF

Policy-shift distillation reuses the difference between a teacher's log probabilities before and after reinforcement learning (RL) as supervision on student-generated trajectories.

Policy-shift distillation reuses the difference between a teacher's log probabilities before and after reinforcement learning (RL) as supervision on student-generated trajectories. However, this endpoint policy shift cannot reveal whether local action preferences evolved consistently during teacher training. The same endpoint shift can result from early and late shifts that reinforce or partially cancel each other. We investigate whether agreement between early and late teacher policy shifts can guide selective transfer. We introduce Waypoint-guided On-Policy Distillation (Waypoint-OPD), which uses an intermediate teacher checkpoint from the same RL run to compare early and late shifts in relative action preferences at student-visited prefixes. We gate the endpoint shift according to the directional agreement between the early and late shifts, suppressing it when they point in opposing directions. Compared with endpoint-only transfer, our method requires only one additional frozen-teacher scoring pass. Using RL-trained Qwen3-4B teachers, we evaluate our method with Qwen3-8B, Qwen3-14B, and Qwen3-30B-A3B as student models in mathematical and code reasoning. In all six domain--studen…

item.title: Verifying deployed bytecode against executable EVM semantics, with exact gas and no added axioms
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF

Much of Ethereum's most consequential code is immutable bytecode: old output of unverified compilers, and protocol logic run as contract code.

Much of Ethereum's most consequential code is immutable bytecode: old output of unverified compilers, and protocol logic run as contract code. We show that such bytecode can be verified as it is, without trusting what produced it, without simplifying the machine it runs on, and with no axioms beyond Lean's own. Blanc, a Lean 4 verification stack, reads fixed runtime bytes via kernel-checked certificates and states every theorem against Jaune, an executable semantics of the EVM and block processing that passes all 34,205 blockchain-test cases of Ethereum's fixture release v20.0.2 that involve only forks that have governed mainnet since May 2025. Eight artifacts, deployed from 2017 to 2026, come from seven compiler versions and an assembler. For the EIP-7002 contract, we prove that the end-of-block call to it, whose failure would invalidate the block, succeeds whatever its storage holds, and that each block's withdrawal requests are exactly the oldest pending submissions; mainnet met these theorems' starting premises when Prague began. item.title: Unlocking Structured Pruning for Reasoning Language Models via Attention-Preserving MLP Trimming
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：结构化剪枝能降低 LLM 推理成本，但现有方法在 AIME 等长程推理任务上会让推理性能崩塌。

方法：提出 LayerTrim——免训练的结构化剪枝：识别冗余 decoder 层，选择性裁剪其 MLP 特征，同时保留注意力与 decoder 深度，全程不需要梯度或恢复训练。

关键数字：在 3 个推理模型、5 个基准上，多数设置优于现有结构化剪枝方法，平均准确率比 RESP 最高提升 21.4 个百分点；在 Qwen3-14B 上相比稠密模型 prefill 加速 1.24×、峰值 GPU 显存降低 19.7%，且在被剪模型中平均生成长度最短、平均准确率最高。

为什么值得看：首个面向长程推理保持的免训练结构化剪枝方法，同时通过结构压缩与减少生成 token 两条路径提升推理效率。

item.title: Understanding NVIDIA Grace-Blackwell Unified Memory Through Placement-Controlled Microbenchmarks
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：NVIDIA Grace-Blackwell 上 CPU-GPU 内存编程层面统一了，但统一可寻址不等于内存系统均质——同一个「统一内存带宽」数字可能掩盖 HBM 本地、主机内存、迁移、预取、驱逐重载等完全不同的硬件路径。

方法：在 GB200 上做放置受控的微基准研究（GH200 作基线、GB10/DGX Spark 验证），分别隔离本地 HBM 访问、主机内存访问、显式搬移、managed 首触、预取、复用、访问模式敏感性、超配与 CPU-GPU 交接，并汇总成测量校准的成本模型。

关键数字：1 GB STREAM 风格 triad：本地 HBM 3963 GB/s，经主机映射内存仅 304 GB/s；256 MB 流式 kernel：冷的 CPU 初始化 managed 内存 14.1 GB/s，而 managed 预取/复用达 4606 / 4504 GB/s；容量内预取/复用保持在 4.6 TB/s 以上，超配到 125% 时跌至 968 / 1214 GB/s。

为什么值得看：给出计算、访问、迁移、驱逐、同步、交接的分项成本模型，说明统一内存必须按放置、访问历史与容量压力来理解。

item.title: TrimSO(2): Fast and Memory-Efficient Training of Equivariant Interatomic Potentials
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF

Equivariant interatomic potentials enable accurate and efficient simulations of molecules and materials.

Equivariant interatomic potentials enable accurate and efficient simulations of molecules and materials. Among them, models based on SO(2) convolutions reduce the cost of tensor products and achieve state-of-the-art accuracy, but their training remains time-consuming and memory-intensive. Existing training implementations materialize large edge tensors for representation transformations surrounding dense matrix multiplications, increasing memory usage and data movement. We observe that these transformations can be integrated into the model's existing dataflow, avoiding separate intermediate materialization. We introduce TrimSO(2), a fast and memory-efficient algorithm for SO(2)-based equivariant models. It realizes this principle through rotation on gather, recombination with activation, and inverse rotation on reduction, with support for the higher-order differentiation required for training. By avoiding intermediate materialization, TrimSO(2) delivers 2.71-16.73$\times$ operator speedups across forward, backward, and double backward and reduces model-level high-bandwidth memory traffic by 3.81-9.88$\times$. Finally, TrimSO(2) achieves 2.07-2.94$\times$ training speedups and 1.53-…
