item.title: Training-Free On-Policy Distillation
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：On-policy 蒸馏能把多个专家模型合并进一个学生模型，但每个教师都要付出 rollout、教师前向和梯度步；能否不训练、只做前向就完成合并？

方法：当各专家共享同一基座模型时，蒸馏存在精确的逐层解——融合模型的每个线性层须在读取自身答案的同时复现各专家在其输入上的输出，这是一个最小二乘问题，只需这些输入的二阶矩，几百条 rollout 的前向即可得到；作者发现 rollout 的内容比求解器更重要，剔除重复循环截断的答案后融合效果显著提升。

关键数字：在 Olmo 3 7B 上，每个专家只需几 GPU-小时的前向计算，得到的通才模型在 7 个数学与代码基准上保留了各专家的大部分收益；融合模型平均比任一单独专家更准；剔除截断 rollout 后 AIME25 从 task arithmetic 水平提升到与专家持平（相同精度档位）。

为什么值得看：免梯度的专家合并，成本极低，且揭示 rollout 质量（而非求解器）才是关键，对多专家融合与模型合并方向有直接启发。

item.title: Training Language Models to Fail Gracefully
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF

Reinforcement learning makes language models better at solving tasks, but the same mechanism also rewards guessing.

Reinforcement learning makes language models better at solving tasks, but the same mechanism also rewards guessing. When success is the only way to earn reward, opting for a safe fallback is always worse than a long-shot attempt. When a wrong action can corrupt a database or ship broken code, that incentive can be costly. Therefore, we propose training models to fail gracefully: to preserve successful behavior whenever possible while learning to execute a safe fallback policy when acting would be unreliable. However, naively using policy gradients with intermediate reward for fallback behavior is brittle due to unfavorable optimization dynamics. We address this challenge with GracefulRL, which reshapes the optimization landscape to promote graceful failure. Importantly, this behavior emerges directly from outcome-level reward signals, without annotations specifying when to fall back or additional inference-time machinery such as a verifier. Across a range of tasks and scales, we train models that largely preserve their task-solving capability while selectively falling back when acting would be unreliable. More broadly, our results show that reinforcement learning can not only incen…

item.title: Training Dynamics of Transformers on Unbounded Inputs: Attention Learning Can Lag Output Layer Learning
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF

The success of transformers is attributed to several factors, including their capacity to express formal languages over variable-length inputs, and ability of the attention mechanism to focus on relevant input features.

The success of transformers is attributed to several factors, including their capacity to express formal languages over variable-length inputs, and ability of the attention mechanism to focus on relevant input features. However, there is limited understanding of the training dynamics of shallow transformers, specifically how to decouple the learning of the attention and the output (feedforward) layer. A natural extension of the theory of one-step gradient feature learning in feedforward networks suggests that one could first learn the attention weights with a single gradient step, and then train the output layer. We show that this fails for a shallow transformer trained to recognize a star-free language from unbounded-length input. We prove that the transformer can be trained to recognize the language with a three-phase gradient descent: the output layer is updated first, followed by an attention update, and the output layer is fine-tuned in the third phase. In contrast, the language cannot be learned by training only the attention or output layer, or by a single attention-layer update followed by finetuning the output layer. item.title: Train to Stitch: Topology-Preserving Regularization for Interoperable Representations
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF

As large, powerful pre-trained models become more prevalent, there is growing interest in developing methods that allow different neural networks to be seamlessly combined with little or no direct communication between them.

As large, powerful pre-trained models become more prevalent, there is growing interest in developing methods that allow different neural networks to be seamlessly combined with little or no direct communication between them. Take autoencoder-based data compression as an example: the ability to independently choose architectures and train encoder and decoder models, while still ensuring they work together, could fundamentally transform how such models are built, deployed, and updated. In this work, we introduce a novel approach that leverages topological regularization to align the latent spaces of two independently trained autoencoder models, entirely eliminating the need for coordination during training. We provide a conditional theoretical analysis showing how the structural agreement encouraged by our regularizer can translate into approximate geometric compatibility between independently learned representations. Reconstruction experiments validate this approach empirically, substantially narrowing the interoperability gap across multiple datasets.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Tracking a Small Set of Experts in Online Convex Optimization
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF

For the fundamental problem of prediction from expert advice, Freund asked whether one could compete with a comparator that switches $k$ times among only $m$ experts.

For the fundamental problem of prediction from expert advice, Freund asked whether one could compete with a comparator that switches $k$ times among only $m$ experts. For a discrete set of experts, this problem was resolved by Bousquet and Warmuth (2020), who gave an efficient algorithm with optimal regret matching the information-theoretic limit. We study the analogous problem in online convex optimization, where the action space is continuous. An inefficient algorithm can be derived by discretizing the action space and applying the Bousquet--Warmuth algorithm, giving regret of $\widetilde{O}(md+k)$, while the best known efficient algorithm for this problem has regret $\widetilde{O}(dk)$. We show that this computational inefficiency is inherent, establishing a separation between the information-theoretic and polynomial-time regret achievable for this problem. Specifically, under the hypergraphic planted-clique conjecture, we show that for every polynomial-time algorithm there exist instances for which it incurs at least $(k\sqrt d)^{1-o(1)}$ regret.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.description:

Graph Neural Networks on large graphs commonly rely on in-memory graph storage with ad hoc data processing pipelines for both training and inference.

Graph Neural Networks on large graphs commonly rely on in-memory graph storage with ad hoc data processing pipelines for both training and inference. Graph databases provide scalable storage and efficient traversal for graphs that can evolve over time, but their applicability in GNN training and inference are rarely studied. We show that graph DBs can be used in GNN training and inference directly, executing sampling, feature retrieval, and even the full forward pass. We show different GNN training pipelines can perform on-the-fly sampling and retrieval in graph DBs using Cypher. We further provide optimisations that speed up the training process by \~2.5x while maintaining the same accuracy. We illustrate that fully in-DB inference is possible, independent of how the GNNs are trained. Our inference setup can be >10x faster than cold loading the graph into RAM with no extra memory overhead on real-world graphs. Our work lays the foundation for in-graph-DB GNN training and inference.

Scientific super-resolution (SR) models are typically optimized with pointwise reconstruction losses, yet scientific interpretation often hinges on extrema, connected regions, and multiscale scalar structure.

Scientific super-resolution (SR) models are typically optimized with pointwise reconstruction losses, yet scientific interpretation often hinges on extrema, connected regions, and multiscale scalar structure. We characterize this tension with pretrained CNN and GAN wind-field SR models. Pointwise metrics, bottleneck persistence-diagram (PD) distance, and merge-tree (MT) distance favor the CNN, whereas order-2 Wasserstein PD distances favor the sharper GAN, so even different distances on the same topological descriptor reward different properties. item.title: Top-Down Microarchitecture Analysis Without Causal Modelling Is Dangerous!
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF

Top-Down Microarchitecture Analysis (TMA) is the standard for identifying CPU bottlenecks.

Top-Down Microarchitecture Analysis (TMA) is the standard for identifying CPU bottlenecks. However, TMA implicitly models performance via a single causal path: Workload(dataset, algorithm) => CPU(CPI) => System(Performance) (microarchitectural efficiency path). It overlooks two hidden causal paths: Workload(dataset, algorithm) => Instructions(Retired) => System(Performance) (algorithmic efficiency path) and Workload(dataset, algorithm) => Instructions(Retired) => CPU(CPI) => System(Performance) (microarchitecture-algorithm efficiency path). This causal blindness often misleads architects into futile hardware optimizations. To address this, we propose Causal Top-Down Microarchitecture Analysis (CTMA). Utilizing the object causal model, CTMA explicitly models these three causal paths among the workload, instructions, CPU, and system. We validate CTMA across Intel, AMD, and ARM platforms. Our experiments reveal counterintuitive insights: (1) CPI Profiling Blindness: Algorithmic instruction bloat can double elapsed time while the CPI profile remains frozen. (2) Over-Speculation Congestion: Throttling the Frontend paradoxically improves performance in pointer-chasing algorithms. (3) ILP…

item.title: Token Utility for On-Policy Distillation via Local Trust-Region Optimization
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF

Token-selection methods for on-policy distillation (OPD) prioritize student-visited positions using diverse signals, including uncertainty, teacher-student disagreement, and mismatch direction.

Token-selection methods for on-policy distillation (OPD) prioritize student-visited positions using diverse signals, including uncertainty, teacher-student disagreement, and mismatch direction. We instead derive token importance from the distillation objective itself: how much can each position's loss decrease under an equal local KL budget on the student's predictive distribution? The answer is the utility $s_t=g_t^\top F_t^\dagger g_t$, where $g_t$ is the logit gradient and $F_t$ is the categorical Fisher matrix. For reverse-KL it equals the student-weighted variance of the student-teacher log-probability ratio, and for forward-KL it equals the Pearson $χ^2$ divergence, so the appropriate utility follows from the choice of objective. On shared training checkpoints, several independently motivated criteria, including student entropy, KL disagreement, and TIP, concentrate their importance on nearly the same positions as the derived utility at a 50\% selection fraction, while diverging at stricter fractions and for direction-specific criteria. item.title: TimeCap: A Scalable Open-Source Pipeline for Captioning Wearable Health Time-Series Data
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF

Time-series data generated continuously across industrial, environmental, and especially health domains produce multimodal signals whose scale and heterogeneity make their processing and interpretation particularly challenging.

Time-series data generated continuously across industrial, environmental, and especially health domains produce multimodal signals whose scale and heterogeneity make their processing and interpretation particularly challenging. Time-Series Language Models (TSLMs) promise scalable interpretation of these signals, yet remain bottlenecked by a fundamental lack of text-annotated time series pairs that are signal-grounded, reproducible, and extensible across modalities and schemas. Existing paired corpora are either closed or limited in scale and modality coverage. Annotation with large language models could scale them up, but its outputs cannot be regenerated exactly, which prevents others from re-deriving, extending, or auditing the resulting corpus. To address this, we release TimeCap, an open deterministic captioning pipeline with three reusable extractor tiers and a cross-channel synthesis layer that operates directly on the signal with no language model in the loop, extensible to new schemas by writing channel definitions alone. This positions TimeCap as a reproducible mechanism for future dataset generation rather than a one-off release. Applying TimeCap to OpenMHC, the MyHeart C…

item.title: The Ephemeral Cost of Switching Optimizers Across LLM Training Stages
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF

Recent work suggests that switching optimizers between pretraining and subsequent training stages incurs a performance cost, but systematic investigation of this phenomenon is lacking.

Recent work suggests that switching optimizers between pretraining and subsequent training stages incurs a performance cost, but systematic investigation of this phenomenon is lacking. We study the mismatch between AdamW and Muon optimizers by pretraining 1.2B Llama-3 models from scratch while varying the proportion of updates taken with each optimizer, and similarly interpolating between the two optimizers during continued pretraining and supervised fine-tuning (SFT). Surprisingly, we find little evidence of a meaningful optimizer mismatch penalty: final performance is largely explained by the independent effects of the pretraining and post-training optimizers, with downstream performance generally improving as the proportion of Muon updates during SFT increases. Although matching the pretraining optimizer can reduce forgetting during SFT, this does not translate into improved final benchmark performance. We further evaluate AdamW and Muon for task-general SFT of open-weight models, across the Llama and Qwen families up to 14B parameters, where Muon remains competitive with AdamW, despite these models having been pretrained with AdamW. item.title: The Cost of Context: Profiling the Energy Footprint of Input Tokens in Large Language Models
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：RAG 与长上下文把算力负担推向 prefill 阶段，但其能耗足迹刻画不足——硬件级功率尖峰与「输入 token 边际成本次线性」的系统级结论看似矛盾。

方法：在 NVIDIA A100 上对 Llama-3.1 与 Qwen-2 做高分辨率遥测，定位 O(n²) 注意力压过 GPU 并行化的效率阈值，并对比 PagedAttention / vLLM 等优化 serving 与非优化基线。

关键数字：优化内存编排（PagedAttention）把扩展瓶颈推迟三个数量级，在 112,000 token 时相比标准基线有最高 8.9× 的能效优势；优化 serving 下输入/输出 token 能耗比从约 850× 收窄到 750×，非优化基线则维持在约 150–230× 的较小且大致恒定的差距。

为什么值得看：建立区分引擎级优化与模型固有约束的上下文能耗 scaling law，为可持续 LLM 部署提供实证框架。

item.title: TRACE: Transformer Residual Activation Codebook Encoding for Communication-efficient Distributed Edge Inference
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：分布式 Transformer 推理在边缘设备间交换激活时受通信瓶颈制约；既有压缩仍要求接收端先做 key/value projection，计算被串行在通信之后。

方法：Trace 在每个 Transformer 层 post-attention 残差处放置一个 VQ，把对应的 key/value 表示离线预先计算为码本条目；运行时传输的只是码本索引，接收端通过查表直接恢复 KV，从而把通信与下游计算并行起来；并提供多层码本做运行时比特率自适应。

关键数字：在 ViT-Base 等模型上通信–计算重叠显著降低分布式推理关键路径延迟（具体数字详见原文图表）。

为什么值得看：把通信/计算 overlap 的设计点从"算子融合"推到"码本表查"，给边缘分布式 Transformer 推理一个新的抽象。

item.description:

Masked diffusion language models expose an inference-time choice: which positions become visible after each denoising pass.

Masked diffusion language models expose an inference-time choice: which positions become visible after each denoising pass. Many existing decoding methods use hand-designed rules or require visibility to grow monotonically. We present a $\textbf{T}$iny $\textbf{I}$nference-time $\textbf{P}$olicy for $\textbf{S}$caling ($\textbf{TIPS}$), an approximately $600$K-parameter controller that learns both unmasking and remasking while keeping the underlying language model frozen. TIPS uses visibility-aware confidence features and a shallow transformer to select which tokens should be visible, while a fixed schedule controls the expected visible fraction. item.title: TIMERSI: Towards Self-Improved Agentic Deployment for Time-Series Foundation Models
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF

Time-series foundation models provide strong zero-shot forecast, but deployment for real- world applications still requires task-specific designs for model inputs and outputs.

Time-series foundation models provide strong zero-shot forecast, but deployment for real-world applications still requires task-specific designs for model inputs and outputs. Direct inference can leave domain knowledge and recurring forecast errors unaddressed, while tailored pipelines require substantial human expertise and effort. We introduce TimeRSI, a self-improving agentic deployment system around frozen forecasting models. A coding agent translates task descriptions into executable pipeline changes. It tests each revision on historical forecasting windows and uses observed errors to guide subsequent revisions. During deployment, an adaptive selector chooses among the resulting pipelines using completed forecasts under similar conditions. Across 198 tasks on TIME and fev-bench, TimeRSI outperforms all submissions on six point and probabilistic forecasting metrics. Controlled comparisons support the value of feedback-guided revision over non-iterative pipeline search. Further experiments verify the generalization with different coding agents and forecasting models. Code is available at https://github.com/haoxin1998/TimeRSI.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: TCDA: Tunable Coded Distributed Arrays for Data Availability Sampling
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF

Data availability sampling (DAS) lets blockchain nodes verify a block's data availability by downloading only a few random pieces of it.

Data availability sampling (DAS) lets blockchain nodes verify a block's data availability by downloading only a few random pieces of it. Its network layer must disseminate each block in time for validators to attest (PUT), store it, and serve any piece on request (GET). A trustless DAS must sustain any number of Byzantine peers. The only known design with this guarantee, Robust Distributed Arrays (RDA), achieves it by full replication: each group of nodes responsible for part of a block stores that part in full, so a single good node per group suffices. The price to pay is a PUT load on the critical path to finality that grows with the network and cannot be tuned, hence the data may not reach validators before the attestation deadline. Coding is the natural remedy, but it was not known when a coded layer remains robust against an unbounded adversary, what it costs, or what it gains. We propose TCDA, a coded layer that is provably robust given enough good nodes, wherever they lie, with a tunable knob: how much of its assigned data each node keeps. Turning the knob trades PUT and storage costs against GET cost. It can be set per data type and adjusted as the good-node population chan…

Coding is the natural remedy, but it was not known when a coded layer remains robust against an unbounded adversary, what it costs, or what it gains. We propose TCDA, a coded layer that is provably robust given enough good nodes, wherever they lie, with a tunable knob: how much of its assigned data each node keeps. item.title: TALU: A Reconfigurable Tiled-ALU Grid for RISC-V
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：lane 式 RISC-V 向量处理器对两类常见模式代价高：归约需要额外的树状遍历，深依赖表达式链无法融合、只能串行发射。

方法：TALU 是一个 5 级流水 RISC-V 核，执行级用 NxN 带寄存器的 ALU tile 网格替代单一 ALU；tile 只从非后向邻居取操作数，配合对角转发让归约在空间上折叠。最小自定义扩展配置每个 tile 的运算、路由与常数，操作数流式穿过阵列。

关键数字：同 lane 数下比 RISC-V2 快 1.8–5.5×、比 Vicuna 快 4.5–15.5×；归约成本（dot÷add）1.05×，而两个向量核为 1.96× 和 1.26×；45nm 重定时实现可布局布线到 1.03 GHz、0.30 mm²，面积为 RISC-V2 的一半。

为什么值得看：同一张 fabric 统一跑标量、深路径表达式与多 lane 向量核，把归约开销压到接近加法本身。

item.title: Synthetic reaction data from transformation rules for graph-to-sequence pretraining in biodegradation pathway prediction
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF

The scarcity of observed biodegradation reactions constrains the training of product and pathway predictors.

The scarcity of observed biodegradation reactions constrains the training of product and pathway predictors. We present enviGraph, a framework that generates and curates synthetic reaction data, uses these data to pretrain a graph-to-sequence predictor, and fine-tunes the predictor on observed environmental reactions for product and recursive pathway prediction. Applying inherited environmental transformation rules to structures from PubChem, NORMAN SusDat and EPA DSSTox, followed by curation, produces 776,851 canonical parent-product pairs for pretraining. We compare this dataset with three United States Patent and Trademark Office (USPTO) reaction datasets: USPTO-50K, USPTO-MIT and USPTO-Stereo. We evaluate enviGraph and the sequence-based enviFormer using ten folds split by pathway on the EAWAG Biocatalysis/Biodegradation Database (BBD), regulatory pesticide biodegradation data (Soil) and activated-sludge biodegradation data (Sludge). For both predictors, synthetic pretraining gives the highest BBD mean precision-recall area under the curve (PR-AUC) among the evaluated pretraining datasets for single-generation and multi-generation prediction. enviGraph achieves BBD single-gener…

item.title: Structure-Aware Spatial Kernels for Gaussian Process Distributed Port-Hamiltonian Systems
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF

Gaussian process distributed port-Hamiltonian systems (GP-dPHS) enable data-driven modeling of distributed dynamical systems while preserving their physical structure.

Gaussian process distributed port-Hamiltonian systems (GP-dPHS) enable data-driven modeling of distributed dynamical systems while preserving their physical structure. However, standard stationary kernels can be inefficient for spatially heterogeneous systems because they neither exploit known input invariances nor reflect structured spatial dependencies. We address this limitation with a structure-aware kernel design that removes irrelevant state coordinates and decouples state and spatial dependencies through a tensor-product covariance. This modular construction allows qualitative knowledge of spatial heterogeneity to be incorporated by selecting an appropriate spatial kernel without requiring an analytical description of the underlying profile. Numerical experiments on a nonlinear string with periodic, smoothly varying, and semi-piecewise stiffness profiles demonstrate that structural decoupling consistently improves reconstruction accuracy, while profile-matched spatial kernels yield substantially larger gains in force-field and trajectory reconstruction.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: SpectrumQuant: Spectrum Alignment for LLM Quantization
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：LLM 低比特量化的正交变换路线目前要么用固定的数据无关变换（如 Hadamard 旋转），要么在校准期优化学习旋转，两者之间缺少有原则的桥梁。

方法：从第一性原理出发，证明最大化协方差可带来谱对齐，并据此提出闭式旋转方法 SpectrumQuant：用校准数据估计激活协方差，构造协方差感知的正交变换；该形式可分解为「对齐 + 混合」两部分，Hadamard 矩阵是其特例，一类 butterfly 矩阵也属此类。

关键数字：在 Llama 与 Mistral 模型上，SpectrumQuant 与 SOTA 旋转策略效果相当，而 GPU 显存需求不到 SpinQuant、DartQuant 等学习旋转方法的三分之一，耗时也显著更少。

为什么值得看：弥合数据无关结构化旋转与学习旋转之间的空白，为训练后量化提供高效的数据感知替代方案。

item.title: Spectral-MoE: Heterogeneous Per-Layer Expert Utilization in Dense-to-MoE Conversion
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：Dense 转 MoE 的现有方法在每一层都固定相同的激活专家数（utilization），忽略了层间异构分配的可能收益。

方法：提出 Spectral-MoE，学习跨层异构地分配 utilization 预算，含两种分配器：静态（每层一个标量、跨 token 共享）与动态（逐 token 输出调度）。

关键数字：25% FFN 利用率下，动态分配相对均匀分配在 learned base 上使 Llama-2-7B / Llama-3-8B / Qwen2.5-7B 的 WikiText-2 困惑度分别降低 1.04 / 2.96 / 2.71 点（analytic base 上为 2.45 / 6.26 / 2.17 点）；12.5% / 25% / 50% 利用率下六任务平均准确率平均提升 1.5 / 4.2 / 3.6 个百分点。

为什么值得看：把「每层专家利用率」确立为 dense-to-MoE 转换的新优化轴，且在解析式与学习式两类 SOTA 转换方法上都有效。

item.title: Spectral Limits of Polynomial Graph Filters on the Long-Range Ising Model Benchmark
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF

The Long-Range Ising Model benchmark (LRIM) guarantees long-range dependence by construction: each label is the node's spin times the spin field convolved with a power-law coupling, so any model's distance from the target is measurable.

The Long-Range Ising Model benchmark (LRIM) guarantees long-range dependence by construction: each label is the node's spin times the spin field convolved with a power-law coupling, so any model's distance from the target is measurable. We prove that a readout whose filter is a polynomial in the adjacency, the linear core of isotropic message passing and spectral graph networks, leaves an error floor that no degree lowers, because the target varies along a level set of the spectrum on which every such filter is constant. Computed exactly, the floor and the best filter of each degree predict two spectral networks adapted from published architectures to within a tenth of a decade. A filter escapes the floor only if it weighs separately the offsets the adjacency lumps together, and must still resolve the coupling across the whole lattice. A strided filter of about fifty coefficients does both: fitted to the training labels, its test error is 52 times below the best published network's. A dilated convolutional network beats the best published result at 256 nodes, matches it at 1,024, and gives the first in-domain results at the three larger sizes, while a Fourier neural operator with i…

item.title: Sparse Federated Echo State Networks for Time-Series Classification via Smooth-L1 Regularization
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF

Echo State Networks (ESNs), as lightweight implementations of reservoir computing, provide efficient solutions for temporal data processing in resource-constrained environments.

Echo State Networks (ESNs), as lightweight implementations of reservoir computing, provide efficient solutions for temporal data processing in resource-constrained environments. While standard ESNs offer computational efficiency, their dense readout layers inflate the stored model and the per-sample inference cost. This paper introduces a Smooth-L1 regularized ESN (SL1ESN) that promotes sparsity in the readout layer while preserving differentiability for gradient-based optimization. The method employs a twice-differentiable Smooth-L1 approximation compatible with Newton's method, which we exploit both for centralized training and for a second-order (Newton-step) federated aggregation scheme. Under a single fixed shrinkage threshold shared by every dataset and both settings, experiments on seven time-series classification benchmarks show that SL1ESN learns readouts that are $77$--$95\%$ sparse in the centralized setting and $75$--$95\%$ sparse in the federated one, while staying within $0.7$ accuracy points of the strongest dense baseline on five of the seven benchmarks in the centralized setting and within $1.6$ points on the same five in the federated one, and the second-order fed…

item.title: Sparse Autoencoders Can Induce Local Geometry for Mitigating Catastrophic Forgetting
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF

Catastrophic forgetting remains a challenge in supervised continual learning, as adapting to new tasks causes representation drift and loss of previously learned information.

Catastrophic forgetting remains a challenge in supervised continual learning, as adapting to new tasks causes representation drift and loss of previously learned information. This raises the question of which representational changes should be constrained while preserving plasticity. We therefore introduce Sparse Autoencoder Geometric Anchoring (SAGA), which converts a Sparse Autoencoder (SAE) trained at each task boundary into local, low-rank constraints on representation drift. Replay examples specify where the constraints apply, while leading right singular directions of the encoder Jacobian specify which changes are penalized. The resulting geometry is input dependent and can be retained without keeping the SAE for subsequent tasks' training. We establish its local relation to latent code matching, define its spectral truncation error, and derive a conditional bound on frozen-readout drift. With replay and snapshot history, the method achieves the highest mean Class-IL accuracy and lowest mean forgetting among the evaluated ER, DER++, ER-ACE, and SGD baselines on three pretrained ViT-B/16 benchmarks, with accuracy gains of 12.15, 4.79, and 3.22 percentage points over the strong…

item.title: Sparse Autoencoders Are a Shared Coordinate System for Symbolic Matching
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF

Large language models (LLMs) hold broad knowledge in one set of weights, but lack interpretability and trustworthy reasoning, especially in high-stakes use cases.

Large language models (LLMs) hold broad knowledge in one set of weights, but lack interpretability and trustworthy reasoning, especially in high-stakes use cases. A neuro-symbolic model, with its interpretable architecture and System 2 reasoning capacity, is a promising alternative if built at the scale of LLMs; however, its symbolic backbone is usually constructed with human effort, so existing neuro-symbolic models are bottlenecked by the scope of the symbol component and usually domain-specific. A data-driven method could instead build a larger symbolic system by aligning and merging existing ones. We target its first, foundational step: matching units across these heterogeneous systems. Our method, SAE-IDF, encodes a symbol in its native context into a sparse code with a sparse autoencoder (SAE), re-weights each dimension by its rarity and matches across systems. On 12 tasks across 6 kinds of symbolic system, SAE-IDF outperforms the same LLM's dense baseline on all tasks with Gemma-2-9B and all but one with Llama-3.1-8B, by up to 45 points, consistently across SAE layers and configurations. SAE-IDF is also interpretable: every dimension of the sparse code has a human-readable m…

item.title: ShiftQAT: Quantization-Aware Training for the Numerical Contract of a Fixed-Function Edge CNN Accelerator
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：固定功能边缘 CNN 加速器（MAX7800x 系列）只执行满足严格数值契约的网络——2 的幂每张量对称 scale、8-bit 激活与偏置、纯整数运算、每层一个静态配置移位；如何用量化感知训练（QAT）构造性地训出满足契约的网络。

方法：提出 ShiftQAT（已是开源工具链 ai8x-training 的默认训练路径）：解析残差、拼接与权重共享依赖使激活 scale 静态传播，每层重量化归约为一个离线配置的移位；权重与偏置在同一个 2 的幂网格上联合训练以适配 8-bit 偏置预算。

关键数字：对比方法中只有 ShiftQAT 满足全部 scale 约束（含符号 8-bit 激活存储）；ImageNet 上 W8A8 精度损失与约束更松的 QAT 方法持平，W4A8 距 FP32 在 2.9 个百分点以内；MAX78002 芯片上 MobileNetV2 / ResNet-18 单次推理 14.6 / 8.4 ms、5.1 / 2.8 mJ。

为什么值得看：固定功能加速器的数值契约如何进 QAT 流程的完整答案，对自研边缘推理芯片的模型工具链建设有直接参考价值。

方法：提出 ShiftQAT（已是开源工具链 ai8x-training 的默认训练路径）：解析残差、拼接与权重共享依赖使激活 scale 静态传播，每层重量化归约为一个离线配置的移位；权重与偏置在同一个 2 的幂网格上联合训练以适配 8-bit 偏置预算。

关键数字：对比方法中只有 ShiftQAT 满足全部 scale 约束（含符号 8-bit 激活存储）；ImageNet 上 W8A8 精度损失与约束更松的 QAT 方法持平，W4A8 距 FP32 在 2.9 个百分点以内；MAX78002 芯片上 MobileNetV2 / ResNet-18 单次推理 14.6 / 8.4 ms、5.1 / 2.8 mJ。

为什么值得看：固定功能加速器的数值契约如何进 QAT 流程的完整答案，对自研边缘推理芯片的模型工具链建设有直接参考价值。

item.title: Sequential Learning-Based Physics-Informed Neural Network Modeling for Parameter Estimation on a Power Converter
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF

A staged physics-informed neural network (PINN) is proposed for identifying the inductance, capacitance and parasitic resistances of a DC buck converter from time-domain data.

A staged physics-informed neural network (PINN) is proposed for identifying the inductance, capacitance and parasitic resistances of a DC buck converter from time-domain data. Gradients are released in the order of L to C to rL to rC, a sequence derived from sensitivity analysis. The five-stage schedule recovers L and C to within 5% and the series ESR to 10%, while a three-stage variant attains the same accuracy 11% faster. An 84 factorial sweep confirms that the trained PINN remains accurate for simultaneous 8% perturbations of all four components, achieving a waveform RMSE of 2.6 x 10-2 over 5 ms-an order-of-magnitude better than a simultaneous-training baseline.

item.title: Selective Next-Location Prediction with MetaModelSelect: A Lightweight Post-Hoc Confidence Metamodel
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF

Next-location prediction can support proactive mobile-network decisions, but acting on unreliable predictions can waste resources.

Next-location prediction can support proactive mobile-network decisions, but acting on unreliable predictions can waste resources. We apply MetaModelSelect, a lightweight post-hoc confidence metamodel, to selective cellular next-location prediction. The mobility-specific model combines a learned embedding of the predicted location with the four largest softmax probabilities and Softmax Concentration. It learns whether a frozen recurrent neural network's top-1 prediction is correct, using only its outputs and without retraining the backbone. On path-balanced Changchun cellular mobility trajectories, we evaluate backbones trained with cross-entropy (CE) and self-adaptive training plus entropy minimization (SAT+EM), comparing against eight scalar confidence scores, two location-aware lookup methods, and a raw-logit multilayer perceptron. Relative to maximum softmax probability, MetaModelSelect achieves mean per-run reductions in area under the risk--coverage curve (AURC), excess AURC (E-AURC), and area under the generalized risk--coverage curve (AUGRC) of 2.6%, 4.2%, and 3.0% for CE, and 2.0%, 3.3%, and 1.9% for SAT+EM. item.title: Seeing at the Edge: Energy Characterization of Vision-Language Model Inference on Edge Platforms
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 VLM 正走向边缘设备，但带 NPU/GPU 加速器的单板计算机上 VLM 能耗多少、耗在何处，此前知之甚少。

方法 在树莓派 5（Hailo-10H NPU）与 Jetson Orin Nano Super 上测量 Qwen2-VL-2B-Instruct 及其纯文本版的系统总能耗、延迟与热行为，CPU 与加速器后端各测，并把能耗拆为每请求固定部分与随输出长度增长部分；因加速器量化与服务软件不同，比较的是部署栈而非芯片。

关键数字 NPU 卸载使树莓派每生成 token 能耗约降三分之二，并避免 CPU 后端持续运行时的热降频；图像输入增加固定与每 token 能耗，但典型响应长度下生成答案远比处理图像耗能；Jetson GPU 固定成本低、利于短响应，树莓派 NPU 每 token 成本低、利于长响应，两条能耗曲线在约 40 个输出 token 处相交。

为什么值得看 少见的边缘 VLM 系统能耗实测，"固定成本 vs token 成本"拆解对边缘多模态选型很实用。

item.description:

Knowing the layout of the physical world matters for many applications, yet the sensors we rely on for it (e.g., cameras and LiDAR) can fail in darkness, in adverse weather, or behind walls.

Knowing the layout of the physical world matters for many applications, yet the sensors we rely on for it (e.g., cameras and LiDAR) can fail in darkness, in adverse weather, or behind walls. Wireless signals do not face these limitations: every link between a base station and a user is shaped by the buildings it passes, reflects from, or is blocked by, leaving information about the surrounding scene embedded in the wireless channel measured at the endpoints. However, mapping channel measurements to the environment is a severely ill-posed problem: a measurement records only the structures that interact with the transmitted electromagnetic waves along its propagation paths, and even these observations can often be explained by multiple plausible scenes. We therefore formulate wireless scene reconstruction as posterior inference and develop a hierarchical framework with two complementary stages to approach this problem. A wireless foundation model, pretrained to respect propagation physics, transforms each channel measurement into a representation of the scene structure that shaped the observation. item.title: Scaling LLM Inference via Parallelism: Throughput-Latency Trade-off
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 LLM 推理含决定首字延迟（TTFT）的 prefill 与决定逐字延迟（ITL）的 decode 两个本质不同的阶段，TP/PP/混合并行对两者的权衡各异，但不同负载与 SLO 下如何选并行配置缺乏系统理解。

方法 构建吞吐-延迟权衡的系统分析框架：通过构造 TTFT-ITL 可行集与 Pareto 前沿、提出"并行操作区域"概念刻画不同负载构成，并用 goodput 形式化 SLO 感知的并行选择。

关键数字 摘要未给实测数字，核心定性结论：负载越偏 prefill，最优配置从 TP 主导系统性迁移到 PP 主导；TTFT 要求严苛偏向 PP 主导，延迟约束宽松则转向容量更高的 TP 主导；长上下文中 PP 主导的扩展性与 SLO 达成更优。

为什么值得看 为分布式推理的并行配置选型给出系统性指导框架，做 serving 部署的团队值得参考。

item.title: Scaling Cheap Synthetic Pretraining Improves Indoor Radio-Map Prediction
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF

Real measurements are too limited to train an accurate indoor pathloss predictor that works across a wide range of buildings.

Real measurements are too limited to train an accurate indoor pathloss predictor that works across a wide range of buildings. Large-scale synthetic pretraining offers a way forward, but real building layouts are also scarce, and accurate ray-tracing simulators are slow, expensive, and often proprietary. We address both problems by introducing a generator that automatically creates diverse indoor layouts and a fast, open-source approximate ray tracer that computes radio maps for them. Using this pipeline, we generate 128M synthetic samples, pretrain ResNet-101 and Swin-T encoder-decoders, and fine-tune them on high-quality benchmark data. Despite simulator mismatch, our ResNet-101 model reduces error by 15% on average relative to the best known methods across five indoor radio-map prediction tasks and improves transfer on a small real-measurement dataset. Both architectures show predictable data-scaling trends: power laws fitted on 2M-16M samples predict the mean normalized downstream RMSE at 32M-128M with 3.33% mean absolute percentage error for ResNet-101 and 7.10% for Swin-T. These results show that pretraining on large amounts of cheap simulated data can improve indoor radio-map…

item.title: Safe-FCL: Continual Risk Awareness and Fine-Grained Safety Aggregation for Federated Continual Learning of LLMs
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF

Federated fine-tuning enables large language models (LLMs) to learn collaboratively from distributed client data, but malicious client updates can compromise global model safety.

Federated fine-tuning enables large language models (LLMs) to learn collaboratively from distributed client data, but malicious client updates can compromise global model safety. As federated tasks evolve, changing malicious update patterns challenge the ability of existing defenses to maintain reliable risk detection over time. To address this challenge, we propose Safe-FCL, a framework integrating continual risk awareness with fine-grained safety aggregation for federated continual learning of LLMs. Specifically, the Continual Risk Awareness (CRA) mechanism learns emerging risk patterns across sequential tasks and constrains detector updates using a protective subspace derived from historical features, mitigating forgetting of previously learned malicious patterns while adapting to new risks. To translate risk awareness into aggregation-level safety control, the Fine-Grained Safety Aggregation (FGSA) mechanism combines client-level risk assessments from CRA with module-level deviations from historical update behavior to adaptively regulate aggregation contributions, suppressing potentially malicious updates while minimizing unnecessary restrictions on benign updates. item.title: STISA: A 0.16 GOPS/W/PE Single-Shot Inference FPGA-based SNN Accelerator with Algorithm and Hardware Co-Design
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 SNN 事件驱动、低功耗潜力大，但时间依赖带来推理延迟高、硬件利用率低；现有加速器难以兼顾时间步、精度与能效，面向硬件的时间步压缩研究不足。

方法 STISA 算法-硬件协同设计框架：时间分裂压缩（TSC）以时间分裂结构削减时间冗余；时间优先输出驻留（TPOS）映射 + Block-Mux 流式（BMS）架构实现硬件高效的时空并行；TSC-TPOS-BMS 联合优化配合带宽感知资源分配。

关键数字 TSC 削减 24.44%–51.71% 突触操作，CIFAR-10/CIFAR-100/ImageNet/DVS-CIFAR10 精度分别 96.38%/81.10%/68.51%/82.40%；FPGA 原型最高 7.99 倍加速、30.4% 功耗降低、30.1% LUT 减少；整体达 0.16 GOPS/W/PE。

为什么值得看 SNN 时间步压缩与硬件协同的完整范例，能效数据齐全，对边缘低功耗推理有参考价值。

item.title: SPARS: A Stability-Plasticity-Aware Region Selection Framework for Continual Learning
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF

Continual learning aims to acquire new knowledge while retaining previously learned knowledge.

Continual learning aims to acquire new knowledge while retaining previously learned knowledge. However, updating shared parameters when learning new tasks often overwrites existing knowledge, causing catastrophic forgetting. Memory replay methods mitigate catastrophic forgetting but rely on previous samples, raising privacy, memory, and scalability concerns. On the other hand, parameter isolation-based methods preserve learned knowledge but may limit knowledge transfer, whereas regularization promotes adaptability but remains susceptible to interference between old and new tasks. To maintain the stability-plasticity trade-off, this paper proposes Stability-Plasticity-Aware Region Selection (SPARS), a replay-free hybrid framework combining global parameter isolation with localized parameter regularization. SPARS estimates parameter importance using either the Fisher Information Matrix (FIM) or a novel Confidence Score (CS) estimator that leverages logit sensitivity and achieves comparable performance to FIM without requiring labelled data. Based on parameter importance, SPARS partitions parameters into three importance-aware regions namely, winning, neighboring, and non-important pa…

item.title: SKG: A Law-Induced Engine from Inference to Induction

This paper proposes the SKG (Symplectic-Kernel Gradient) reasoning engine for law-induced inference and induction.

This paper proposes the SKG (Symplectic-Kernel Gradient) reasoning engine for law-induced inference and induction. Laws are a priori; data provide instances. Inference is geometric evolution under law constraints. We organize symplectic geometry, GENERIC, kernel methods, RKHS, group-equivariant networks, and constrained mechanics into a unified, analyzable, implementable, verifiable framework. We propose the SKG octuple S = (M, g, omega, H, S, G, Delta, Pi), whose four components correspond to four levels of laws: conservation laws, constitutive relations, symmetry groups, and axiom systems. Main results: (1) Invariants enter metric construction via the Jacobian: g = J^T Sigma^-1 J + epsilon_G I. For constant cases, we establish inverse reconstruction theory: solvability rank condition (Thm 3.9), consistency criterion (Thm 3.11), and uniqueness theorem (Thm 3.14). (2) The kernel bandwidth matrix is uniquely determined by Fisher information and satisfies task-independence (Thm 3.19). (3) The metric reconstruction error decomposes into four terms (Thm 3.21), with squared condition number kappa(Sigma^*)^2 as the dominant amplification factor (Thm 3.22). This paper proposes the SKG (Symplectic-Kernel Gradient) reasoning engine for law-induced inference and induction. Laws are a priori; data provide instances. We organize symplectic geometry, GENERIC, kernel methods, RKHS, group-equivariant networks, and constrained mechanics into a unified, analyzable, implementable, verifiable framework. We propose the SKG octuple S = (M, g, omega, H, S, G, Delta, Pi), whose four components correspond to four levels of laws: conservation laws, constitutive relations, symmetry groups, and axiom systems. 发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF

Learned dynamical models can accurately predict trajectories while producing unreliable sensitivities when differentiated or transposed, limiting their use in inverse problems and scientific decision-making.

Learned dynamical models can accurately predict trajectories while producing unreliable sensitivities when differentiated or transposed, limiting their use in inverse problems and scientific decision-making. Classical adjoints provide exact local derivatives, but a single adjoint cannot represent the nonlinear response of a system to a family of finite-amplitude perturbations. We introduce SALTO (Solver-Anchored Lifted Transfer Operators), a Koopman-based framework for inferring finite-amplitude sources. In the lifted space, the nonlinear dynamics are approximated by a linear propagator, and its transpose carries each sensor backward in a single solve. The result is a reusable lifted adjoint that predicts the measurement produced by any candidate localized event with one encoder pass and an inner product. To give the model the simulator's exact local behavior, SALTO imposes three structural constraints: it anchors the physical-state dynamics to the simulator's linearized propagator, centers the learned observables so that they vanish to second order at the reference state, and uses a block-triangular lifted propagator. item.title: Router Drift Control: Mitigating Off-Policy Degradation in Mixture-of-Experts Reinforcement Learning
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF

Reinforcement learning (RL) can become off-policy due to training-inference mismatch, mini-batch updates, and asynchronous training.The resulting mismatch is especially harmful in Mixture-of-Experts (

Reinforcement learning (RL) can become off-policy due to training-inference mismatch, mini-batch updates, and asynchronous training.The resulting mismatch is especially harmful in Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models, where rollout--training discrepancies can change routing decisions and lead to router drift. Rollout Routing Replay (R3) mitigates this mismatch by reusing expert selections from the rollout stage during training. Our analysis shows that routing replay introduces gradient bias by losing contributions from experts selected by the training router but not the rollout router. To address this, we propose Router Drift Control (RDC), which uses routing disagreement between rollout and training as a signal of off-policy staleness and selectively rejects high-drift responses. The sequence-level filtering avoids gradient bias introduced by replay while preserving native expert selection and the associated learning signals for retained responses. Experiments show that RDC achieves larger gains as policy staleness increases and remains effective in asynchronous RL. item.title: Rethinking Routing Exploration in Modern Mixture-of-Experts
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF

Mixture-of-experts (MoE) models have become an important approach for scaling model parameters.

Mixture-of-experts (MoE) models have become an important approach for scaling model parameters. Modern MoE architectures increasingly combine two design choices: fine-grained expert segmentation and shared experts. The former increases expressiveness by enabling more expert combinations at a fixed activation ratio, and the latter introduces experts that are active for every token. We identify an exploration dilemma between these designs: shared experts can make routing less exploratory by reducing the variability of token representations. This conflicts with the greater need for exploration induced by fine-grained expert segmentation due to the combinatorially enlarged routing space. Consequently, the additional expressiveness offered by fine-grained segmentation may not be fully realized in practice. MirrorMoE is proposed to reconcile this exploration dilemma by shrinking the exploration space through token-adaptive suppression of unnecessary experts. MirrorMoE consistently improves performance across model scales.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Resource-aware Sub-network Allocation for Heterogeneous Decentralized Learning
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：同步去中心化学习每一轮都被资源最弱的节点卡住，计算、通信、内存异构下，如何为每个节点分配合适的模型容量（子网络宽度）。

方法：提出 RASA-DL，把每节点可分配的最大子网络宽度当作部署变量；结合离线硬件画像（计算/内存开销）与部署感知的学习效用画像，把部署建模为带内存约束与聚合学习效用要求的瓶颈时延最小化问题，利用时延阈值的单调可行性做二分搜索求解。

关键数字：在 Moderate 与 Severe 两种异构档位下，最小时延工作点在相同轮次时延下，比全局可行的最大统一部署分别高 2.80 与 2.43 个百分点的精度；强 Non-IID 数据异构下优势进一步放大。

为什么值得看：把"部署资源"直接纳入模型容量决策，为异构边缘上的分布式训练提供了画像驱动、可复现的分配框架。

item.title: Representation Redistribution in Sparse Autoencoders
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF

Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) decompose language model activations into sparse features, but prompt transformations designed to preserve the underlying request can redistribute activity across them.

Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) decompose language model activations into sparse features, but prompt transformations designed to preserve the underlying request can redistribute activity across them. A feature change observed on one transformed prompt need not recur, and even a recurring change need not affect a downstream computation. We introduce the redistribution sensitivity score (RSS), which identifies large feature responses that recur in a consistent direction, and evaluate the resulting supports on variants excluded from selection. Across 27 pretrained SAEs spanning eight language models, the tested prompt transformations produce a reproducible redistribution profile on these excluded variants. We then separate recurring representation change from signed readout contribution and decision failure. For a fixed linear readout, an exact decomposition shows how response magnitude, readout coefficients, directional alignment, and the clean margin determine downstream consequences. item.title: Rent-Seeking Language Models: Reward Models Set the Prices, Frequent Audits Curb the Rent
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF

Reward model overoptimization in RLHF is usually described as reward hacking.

Reward model overoptimization in RLHF is usually described as reward hacking. We recast it as rent-seeking: the policy, a firm, earns reward from a regulator, the proxy reward model, that true quality does not back. The lens turns overoptimization into measurable quantities, namely rent, a capture index and deadweight loss, and into testable predictions from the economics of regulation. In a fixed, version-controlled testbed with three model families, accuracy-matched proxy reward models and two gold reward models, RL turns 41% to 66% of its proxy gain into rent while gold reward plateaus. Rent follows each regulator's prices. Neither proxy verifies facts, but one pays for confident specifics and the other for displays of diligence, so RL policies learn to fabricate details about nonexistent entities (97% to 100% of probes) or to deflect factual questions (67% to 98%). Kinship between policy and regulator adds a fixed premium of about 0.1 standard deviations but gives the policy no extra leverage under optimization. At a fixed expected fine, frequent mild audits beat rare severe ones, and random audits are as efficient per audit as targeted ones. Bringing the bunching estimator of …

item.title: Refusal Is Not Robustness: Measuring Harmful Reachability in Autoregressive Language Models
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF

LLM safety evaluations via jailbreaking typically index on attack success rate (ASR): whether a generated response violates safeguards.

LLM safety evaluations via jailbreaking typically index on attack success rate (ASR): whether a generated response violates safeguards. However, ASR only evaluates sampled outputs and provides little information on the underlying generation process. Autoregressive language models define distributions over possible outputs, and a sampled refusal can coexist with substantial probability mass on harmful generation paths. We study this hidden structure through bounded continuation analysis (BCA), which models autoregressive generation as a stochastic process over token prefixes and computes the finite-horizon probability that generation reaches a harmful continuation. BCA constructs a bounded continuation tree, labels terminal continuations with a semantic harm evaluator, and estimates harmful reachability using exact probabilistic model checking. BCA complements ASR by measuring how much harmful behavior remains accessible beneath a sampled safe response. This makes it useful for distinguishing models that look identical under measured ASR values, and allocating red-team effort toward regions of the generation process with greater hidden risk. Equivariant structure-prediction pipelines alternate coordinate updates with the construction of a k-nearest-neighbour (kNN) graph whose membership is a discrete, piecewise-constant function of the coordinates. We study a two-pass design in which the cheap pass records a small amount of state (margins, kNN radii, measured per-boundary displacements) and a second pass compensates conservatively. item.title: Recovering Reliable Supervision via Critique-Guided On-Policy Distillation
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF

On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student model on its own rollouts with token-level supervision from a teacher, assuming that the teacher can reach a correct answer from any prefix the student writes.

On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student model on its own rollouts with token-level supervision from a teacher, assuming that the teacher can reach a correct answer from any prefix the student writes. We call this property the recoverability of the teacher and show it fails on incorrect rollouts: the teacher follows student errors, although it recognizes them. We propose CriticOPD, using error recognition to restore recoverability. The teacher critiques an incorrect rollout, allowing the student to rewrite its solution following the error. The resulting output, including the critique as privileged information, is scored by the teacher while the student uses the revision without the critique for training. On two Qwen3 students and six mathematical reasoning benchmarks, CriticOPD improves OPD, with the largest gains on competition problems.

item.description:

Low-rank adaptation (LoRA) enables parameter-efficient fine-tuning by learning low-rank weight updates.

Low-rank adaptation (LoRA) enables parameter-efficient fine-tuning by learning low-rank weight updates. Increasing rank expands adaptation capacity, but does not guarantee that all learned directions improve downstream performance. In a diagnostic experiment with rank-16 LoRA, we show that retaining only the top singular components achieves the best performance, whereas adding further components degrades it. Motivated by this, we propose Residual-Gradient Adaptation (ReGRA), a two-stage method for making more effective use of a fixed rank budget. After the first stage, ReGRA estimates task gradients on a calibration set and removes their projections onto the two-sided subspace induced by the first-stage update. It then aggregates the residual-gradient directions to initialize a second-stage adapter without changing the first-stage update. An orthogonality regularizer encourages the two updates to capture complementary directions. Both updates can be merged into the pretrained weights, incurring no additional inference overhead. Reinforcement learning (RL) has been a critical paradigm for improving large language model (LLM) reasoning and agentic capabilities, but its efficiency remains a major bottleneck.

Reinforcement learning (RL) has been a critical paradigm for improving large language model (LLM) reasoning and agentic capabilities, but its efficiency remains a major bottleneck. Existing RL systems commonly rely on asynchronous execution to overlap rollout generation with policy optimization for enhanced efficiency. However, this approach faces inherent limitations: mild policy staleness offers only limited training efficiency gains, whereas aggressive asynchrony can degrade model quality and yields diminishing efficiency gains. The dynamic nature of LLM RL and multi-turn agentic workloads further challenges RL system design, as resource demands shift over time, making static resource allocation and generation strategy inefficient. This paper presents ReFlow, a system-algorithm co-designed RL framework for efficient LLM post-training. Its key insight is that, unlike existing RL frameworks which consume each trajectory only once, experience replay of recent trajectories enables effective sample reuse, thereby amortizing the high cost of rollout generation without incurring excessive policy staleness. Existing RL systems commonly rely on asynchronous execution to overlap rollout generation with policy optimization for enhanced efficiency. However, this approach faces inherent limitations: mild policy staleness offers only limited training efficiency gains, whereas aggressive asynchrony can degrade model quality and yields diminishing efficiency gains. The dynamic nature of LLM RL and multi-turn agentic workloads further challenges RL system design, as resource demands shift over time, making static resource allocation and generation strategy inefficient. This paper presents ReFlow, a system-algorithm co-designed RL framework for efficient LLM post-training. Its key insight is that, unlike existing RL frameworks which consume each trajectory only once, experience replay of recent trajectories enables effective sample reuse, thereby amortizing the high cost of rollout generation without incurring excessive policy staleness. To fully exploit this opportunity, ReFlow adopts a decoupled and adaptive archit…

item.title: Ranking and Partitioning of Attention Heads for Sparse and Continual Reinforcement Learning Fine-tuning
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF

We study sparse and continual reinforcement learning fine-tuning of language models through attention-head ranking and partitioning.

We study sparse and continual reinforcement learning fine-tuning of language models through attention-head ranking and partitioning. For sparse learning, we rank attention heads by gradient norm to identify a small subset of heads that can be trained effectively. For continual learning, we partition heads across tasks to reduce cross-task interference and preserve previously learned capabilities. Theoretically, we relate gradient norm to training effectiveness, and further characterize why sparse, separated head updates can remain stable. Empirically, across math, instruction-following, and coding tasks, tuning higher-ranked heads consistently outperforms tuning lower-ranked ones while often matching denser baselines, and head partitioning improves retention while preserving adaptation to new tasks.

item.title: Rank Measures of Fine-Tuning Updates Need a Noise Baseline
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF

Studies of what fine-tuning does to a language model often summarise the weight update $ΔW$ by its rank.

Studies of what fine-tuning does to a language model often summarise the weight update $ΔW$ by its rank. We compare the rank measures used for this against the same measures on a random matrix of the same shape, and against two harder references: the pretrained weights, and matched fine-tunes without alignment content. Measures that count directions put our fine-tuning updates only a little below noise; stable rank, computed from the same singular values, puts them far below. Both are right: an update has a few strong directions on top of a long tail. The pattern holds for thirteen released pairs up to 8B parameters, and it is not a mark of alignment: with training held fixed, instruction data does not stand out from Wikipedia or code, DPO gives the same update whether its preference labels are real or half swapped at random (one model, modest preference strength), and scrambled text gives the most concentrated update of all. item.title: RM-OPD: On-Policy Distillation for Generative Reward Models
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF

Reinforcement Learning on Mixed-domain preference data (Mix-RL) has become the mainstream approach for training general-purpose Generative Reward Models (GRMs).

Reinforcement Learning on Mixed-domain preference data (Mix-RL) has become the mainstream approach for training general-purpose Generative Reward Models (GRMs). However, Mix-RL suffers from two critical bottlenecks: the reward sparsity induced by outcome rewards, and the cross-domain interference arising from jointly optimizing heterogeneous capabilities, which together give rise to imbalanced capability acquisition and pervasive reward hacking. Inspired by the success of On-Policy Distillation (OPD) in multi-domain capability integration, we introduce RM-OPD (Reward Modeling via On-Policy Distillation), a two-stage framework that separates specialist acquisition from capability integration. First, we cultivate domain-specialized teacher models via single-domain GRPO fine-tuning, allowing each expert to reach its performance ceiling in isolation; then we consolidate these teachers into one student model through (i) routed on-policy distillation, which provides dense signed token-level supervision on student-generated critiques; (ii) domain contribution reweighting, which reweights token guidance toward target domain shares, preventing specific domains from dominating optimization; …

item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF

Relational databases (RDBs) remain the primary infrastructure for storing and managing structured data across enterprise and scientific domains.

Relational databases (RDBs) remain the primary infrastructure for storing and managing structured data across enterprise and scientific domains. Natural-language (NL) interfaces to RDBs aim to let users ask questions without writing SQL, but real user needs go beyond SQL-style lookup: some questions require reasoning over the observable database state, while others require predictive inference from historical relational records under temporal constraints. Existing benchmarks address these goals in isolation. To address this gap, we introduce RDL-Bench, a benchmark for task-aware question answering (QA) over real RDBs. RDL-Bench organizes diverse user questions into reasoning-oriented questions, whose answers are determined by the current database state, and prediction-oriented questions, whose answers depend on future outcomes under temporal constraints. Each instance contains an NL question, task metadata, schema information, temporal context, either executable evidence or target-construction logic, and denotation-level ground truth. item.title: RA$^2$: Retain-Anchored Attraction Preserves Forget-Adjacent Utility in LLM Unlearning
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF

Large Language Model (LLM) unlearning is often evaluated primarily by target suppression and clean retain utility.

Large Language Model (LLM) unlearning is often evaluated primarily by target suppression and clean retain utility. These metrics can miss a local failure mode: a model may perform well on standard retain prompts, yet degrade on benign reasoning when prompts lie near the forgotten domain. This phenomenon is termed forget-adjacent utility loss. A fundamental question is: where should forget representations go after they leave the removed behavior? Successful unlearning depends not only on whether forget-conditioned representations depart from the harmful computation, but also on the direction in which they are redirected afterward. We propose RA$^2$ (Retain-Anchored Attraction), a latent-space unlearning method that redirects forget-token states toward nearby retain-supported representations while preserving higher-layer behavior on retain data. On WMDP and MUSE, RA$^2$ yields higher forget-adjacent utility than strong unlearning baselines at similar broad-utility levels. These results show that the migration direction of forget representations materially affects benign behavior near the forget boundary. Our code is available at https://github.com/ZacLing/retain_anchored_attraction.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Query-Efficient Rejection Sampling for Parallel Masked Diffusion
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF

Masked diffusion models (MDMs) accelerate generation by unmasking multiple tokens in parallel, but sampling these tokens independently ignores their correlations and biases the output.

Masked diffusion models (MDMs) accelerate generation by unmasking multiple tokens in parallel, but sampling these tokens independently ignores their correlations and biases the output. Anari et al. (2026) corrected this bias with rejection sampling, decomposing the log acceptance probability into a sum of token-level terms, but the evaluation requires one score query per unmasked token. We propose the Single-Increment Rejection Sampler (SIRS), which provides an estimate of the log acceptance probability from a single randomly sampled increment at the cost of one query. SIRS then converts a Poisson number of clipped estimates into accept/reject decisions through a Bernoulli factory adapted from Chen et al. (2026). Since each query returns the conditionals of all remaining tokens in the block, we further Rao-Blackwellize each increment by averaging over these tokens at no extra cost, thereby reducing clipping. We show that the KL-divergence between the data distribution and the SIRS output is bounded by a clipping term plus the model's training error. With exact scores, parallel decoding pays the full within-block dependence, whereas SIRS pays only the part beyond the clipping range.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF

Risk-sensitive reinforcement learning (RL) addresses decision-making under uncertainty and adverse outcomes.

Risk-sensitive reinforcement learning (RL) addresses decision-making under uncertainty and adverse outcomes. Learning risk-sensitive policies from fixed datasets is important when additional interaction with the environment is costly. Existing work on risk-sensitive RL focuses on online settings or specific risk measures, leaving a general theoretical understanding of its offline setting underdeveloped. In this work, we investigate efficient offline risk-sensitive RL using the optimized certainty equivalent (OCE), a general class of risk measures. We consider two formulations: dynamic-OCE RL, which applies OCE recursively at each step, and static-OCE RL, which applies a single OCE to the cumulative rewards. Under the tabular setting, we develop pessimistic value-iteration algorithms for both formulations and establish tight sublinear suboptimality bounds, explicitly capturing how risk sensitivity, encoded by utility functions, affects learning difficulty. Moreover, we establish minimax suboptimality lower bounds to characterize the problem's fundamental limits. item.title: Provable Transformer Context Compression for In-Context Reinforcement Learning
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF

Transformers can perform in-context reinforcement learning without parameter updates.

Transformers can perform in-context reinforcement learning without parameter updates. However, existing theoretical constructions often require context sizes that grow with the number of sampled transitions, leading to increasing memory costs in large-scale problems. This raises a fundamental scalability question: how much context is intrinsically necessary to carry out such learning? We answer this question for fixed-policy TD evaluation. We show that, with a shared linear decoder, the minimum context dimension required to exactly reproduce the first $L$ TD iterates is the Krylov dimension induced by the sampled transitions. When the available context dimension $m$ falls below this threshold, exact reproduction is no longer possible. In this regime, we characterize the optimal approximation error and show that it decays as $Θ(γ^m\max\{1,1/(m(1-γ))\})$ where $γ$ is the discounting factor. Moving from representation complexity to actual memory cost, we characterize the optimal retained memory for exact continuous representations as $Θ(nk_L)$ and show experimentally that on a sampled task whose exact rank is full but whose numerical rank is small, a context accurate to $10^{-2}$ is $…

item.description:

Large protein language models provide a powerful framework for learning sequence-function relationships and guiding experimental design.

Large protein language models provide a powerful framework for learning sequence-function relationships and guiding experimental design. However, architectural improvements are underexplored, especially in low-compute regimes of relevance for resource-constrained research laboratories. We show that the training cost for encoder-only transformer architectures can be reduced by leveraging modern architectural refinements, offering an encouraging performance / compute-efficiency trade-off. We introduce ProtModernBERT, a modernized BERT-style model pre-trained on amino acid sequences, and compare it with ProtBert, Amplify, and ESM2 across a set of supervised structural tasks -encompassing secondary structure prediction, disorder prediction, and subcellular localization- and ProteinGym's zero-shot functional benchmark. We find that ProtModernBERT matches or closely tracks the performance of Amplify-120M and ProtBert with up to 80-90\% reduction in pre-training FLOPs, and narrows the gap to ESM2 when controlling for pre-training. item.title: Progressive Misalignment Can Emerge from Benign Recursive Self-Distillation
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF

Training models on their own outputs has attracted widespread attention as a possible route to advance AI capabilities.

Training models on their own outputs has attracted widespread attention as a possible route to advance AI capabilities. One prominent approach is self-distillation, where a model is trained to match the token-level predictions it would have produced when given access to additional context, such as a cue, feedback, or instruction. However, the safety properties of this training procedure are poorly understood. In this paper, we present a surprising safety failure of recursive self-distillation, where each self-distilled model becomes the teacher for the next round of training. We observe that when a safe model is recursively self-distilled on its own (safe) generations while receiving an additional non-harmful cue, it becomes increasingly misaligned across a diverse set of harmful queries; we call this Progressive Misalignment. We show this failure mode in both the Qwen3 and Phi-4 model families on SORRY-Bench and StrongREJECT. Progressive misalignment also occurs in a more realistic setup, where the fixed cue is replaced by feedback from a simulated user with benign intent. Using a gradient-based method, we are also able to find benign prompts that lead to progressive misalignment …

item.title: Progress-Aware Distillation for Mitigating Stagnation in Small Language Model Agents
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 用蒸馏把 agent 能力迁移到小模型（SLM）时，随交互轨迹变长，学生模型易出现"进展停滞"：困在反复失败的策略循环里难以推进，该现象跨模型、跨任务域普遍存在。

方法 提出进度感知蒸馏（ProD）：显式检测学生生成轨迹中的停滞并施加惩罚，把学生与教师之间的停滞差距编码为自适应裕度，动态惩罚潜在停滞行为；迭代施加该过程使学生逐步逼近教师行为。

关键数字 在 0.6B–8B 的 8 个 SLM、域内与域外基准上，ProD 显著缓解进展停滞，同时提升蒸馏 SLM agent 的成功率与任务完成效率（摘要未给具体百分比）。

为什么值得看 指出小模型 agent 蒸馏的一个共性失效模式并给出训练侧解法，做低成本 agent 的团队值得参考。

item.title: Probabilistic Optical-Layer Surrogate for Risk-Aware Control-Plane Decision Making
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF

In this paper, we propose a generative surrogate for the optical layer.

In this paper, we propose a generative surrogate for the optical layer. Current control-plane decisions in optical transport networks are made using analytical impairment models, deterministic learned predictors, or quantile-regression-based uncertainty estimates. These approaches expose only a limited, static summary of the optical layer at any given time. This forces the control plane to rely on conservative fixed margins that leave capacity underutilized. Our proposed surrogate is a conditional generative model trained on traces from optical simulators with validated physical models. The surrogate produces a full conditional distribution over physical-layer metrics such as OSNR, Q-margin, nonlinear penalty, and feasibility. This output allows the controller to estimate violation probability and tail risk at arbitrary thresholds at runtime. This is different from existing approaches because no retraining is required for each decision. We present the first case study in fast path feasibility estimation using a generative surrogate for the optical layer. We compare the surrogate against simulators, deterministic learned predictors, and quantile-regression estimators. We evaluate th…

item.title: Predicting Privileged Information Effectiveness for On-Policy Self-Distillation
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF

On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) enables large language models (LLMs) to learn from privileged information (PI) without a separate teacher model.

On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) enables large language models (LLMs) to learn from privileged information (PI) without a separate teacher model. However, prior work largely treats PI as a fixed design choice, leaving the effects of its content and construction poorly understood. This challenge is particularly important in multi-turn agentic settings, where trajectories contain actions, observations, and reasoning that can be transformed into PI in many ways. We systematically evaluate 16 PI configurations across three multi-turn agentic benchmarks and three student models that vary in scale and reasoning mode. We find that PI effectiveness depends on its content, generation source, and the student model. Information-dense trajectories and PI produced by more capable generators generally yield larger gains, whereas thinking models benefit less consistently. To assess PI before training, we compare PI utility with two KL-based metrics: sampled-token reverse KL ($D$) and error-step KL contrast ($Δd^{-}_{\mathrm{err}}$). The KL-based metrics track post-training performance more consistently than PI utility, which can be distorted by information leakage. Empirically, selecting each t…

item.title: Predicting Live Birth After Fresh Embryo Transfer in IVF/ICSI: Differential ICM/Trophectoderm Morphology Encoding and a Hybrid Attention--Logistic Regression Ensemble
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF

Predicting live birth before fresh embryo transfer could support shared decision-making in IVF/ICSI, but routine clinical data are small, heterogeneous, and contain pathway-dependent variables prone to outcome leakage.

Predicting live birth before fresh embryo transfer could support shared decision-making in IVF/ICSI, but routine clinical data are small, heterogeneous, and contain pathway-dependent variables prone to outcome leakage. We aimed to construct a curated single-centre IVF/ICSI dataset and develop a prediction model suited to small tabular clinical data. \textit{Materials and Methods:} We assembled 616 fresh embryo-transfer cycles (251 live birth, 365 non-live birth) with clinical, laboratory, and embryological predictors, and embryo morphology encoded with a novel differential weighting of the inner cell mass and trophectoderm. After KNN imputation, robust scaling, and selection of 50 features, we developed a Hybrid Attention Network (HAN), a learnable feature-attention gate followed by a compact multilayer perceptron, and a HAN + logistic-regression (LR) ensemble with a validation-tuned weight. Models were benchmarked against classical machine learning, TabPFN, and text-serialized language models on a held-out test set; AUC-ROC was the primary metric. \textit{Results:} The HAN + LR ensemble achieved the highest test AUC-ROC (0.710; accuracy 0.710, F1 0.630), ahead of the HAN backbone …

item.title: PocketTSLM: Deploying an On-Device Soft-Prompt Time-Series Language Model for Privacy-Preserving Smartphone Reasoning
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：手机与可穿戴设备采集的生理时间序列越来越多，但云端时序语言模型要反复把敏感数据送出设备；如何把时序语言模型（TSLM）完整跑在消费级手机上、保留时间结构又保护隐私。

方法：提出 PocketTSLM，将 OpenTSLM 的 SoftPrompt 变体做移动端原生部署——时间序列窗口编码为 embedding 注入软提示，而非序列化成文本；用数值一致性协议验证 Swift 移植与 Apple MLX 参考实现的贪心解码 token 序列逐位一致，答案与 PyTorch 参考也一致。

关键数字：在同一个骨干上，软提示路径相比文本序列化基线少用约 12 倍的时间序列 token，同时降低上下文与内存占用。

为什么值得看：端侧时序大模型落地少有的完整工程样本——从移植、数值校验到上下文经济学评测，对端侧健康类隐私推理有直接参考价值。

item.title: Physics-Aware Distillation of a Grid Foundation Model for Real-Time Edge Inference
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：电网基础模型（GridFM）体积大、面向数据中心推理，如何把它蒸馏到边缘侧，在量测设备旁以 batch size 1、在一个 PMU 上报帧内完成实时潮流推断。

方法：把 20.1M 参数、12 层的教师模型蒸馏成 0.62M 参数、6 层的学生模型，损失函数组合 masked power-flow loss 与输出、物理残差、隐状态、注意力四类迁移项，其中物理残差项首次在带类型的电网图上使用；在 IEEE 118 节点可再生能源改造版基准上评测，并消融全部八种迁移项组合。

关键数字：参数量压缩 32.5 倍、消息传递深度减半；97,529 个 AC-OPF 可行运行场景；蒸馏使学生模型四项预测量误差全部下降，有功调度误差最多降 48%；所有蒸馏后的学生模型在无功调度上都比教师更准。

为什么值得看：给出科学计算图基础模型走向边缘实时推理的完整蒸馏配方，物理残差迁移项对图模型边缘化部署有直接借鉴价值。

item.title: Phase Kernel Lifts Capacity of Dense Associative Memory
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF

Dense associative memory underlies modern attention mechanisms; however, Modern Hopfield Networks (MHNs) with linear kernels yield overlapping attractor basins and spurious states under high memory lo

Dense associative memory underlies modern attention mechanisms; however, Modern Hopfield Networks (MHNs) with linear kernels yield overlapping attractor basins and spurious states under high memory load, limiting their theoretically exponential storage capacity in practice. We construct a class of nonlinear phase kernels that modify the energy landscape and retrieval dynamics, and prove that these kernels preserve exponential storage capacity and local fixed-point convergence under given conditions on kernel smoothness, memory separation, and memory distributions. The framework is instantiated by the Sigmoidal Phase Hopfield Network (S-Hop), which guarantees monotone energy descent and mitigates practical capacity loss. S-Hop has $8.3\times$ and $4\times$ gains in one-step noisy retrieval load over Uniform Hopfield Networks (U-Hop) on CIFAR-10 and TinyImageNet respectively, and reaches a $50\times$ gain in first-failure load for ImageNet. The results demonstrate that phase kernels provide a principled route to robust dense associative memory.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Personalized Projected Ascent for Federated Stackelberg Optimization
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF

Federated minimax problems, such as distributionally robust optimization and adversarial training, include an inner maximization variable built from each client's local data.

Federated minimax problems, such as distributionally robust optimization and adversarial training, include an inner maximization variable built from each client's local data. These variables differ in meaning and dimension from one client to the next, so averaging them across clients, as standard federated minimax methods do, is ill-posed. We therefore study a federated minimax problem where the minimization variable $\mathbf{x}$ is shared and aggregated, while each client retains the maximization variable $\mathbf{y}_i$ (personalized). Because these applications constrain $\mathbf{y}_i$ to a compact convex set, we analyze projected ascent directly. We show that, in the nonconvex-concave regime, this projected personalized scheme attains the standard sublinear rate. In the nonconvex-PL regime, however, it hits a stepsize-invariant noise floor due to stochastic $\mathbf{y}_i$ updates. To mitigate this, we propose VR-SGDA, incorporating a variance-reduced ascent step where each client maintains a private variable snapshot. By evaluating current and snapshot gradients on the same sample, the constant variance is replaced by a vanishing drift under a two-timescale regime. VR-SGDA elimi…

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Parallel Sparse Outputs for Tensor Compilers
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 稀疏张量编译器是优化稀疏数据上张量代数程序的常用工具，但并行稀疏张量编译器研究极少：已有方法要么无法并行，要么对访问模式/输出格式做了限制通用性的假设。

方法 提出 Birdseed：首个支持任意标准稀疏格式、全部循环次序并行化的张量编译器；支持并行稀疏 scatter，可直接写入 fibertree 稀疏格式的 list、bytemap、hash 与 dense 层级。

关键数字 相对所有先前工作在内存与时间上均有渐近改进；在 histogram 构造、SpMSpV 等公认难并行的核上展示了实测加速（摘要未给具体倍数）。

为什么值得看 补齐并行稀疏张量编译器这块空白，做稀疏计算与编译器的高性能方向值得跟进。
