item.title: FireGraphNet: Sub-daily wildfire spread prediction with directed graph neural networks
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF

Wildfire decisions are made in hours, yet most learned spread models predict daily on targets including burned area.

Wildfire decisions are made in hours, yet most learned spread models predict daily on targets including burned area. We propose FireGraphNet which formulates 12-hour growth as node classification on directed H3 graphs, with candidates ahead of the front and wind alignment, terrain, fuel continuity and barriers on edges. On satellite perimeters it achieves average precision 1.7-1.9x the strongest distance baseline on test California fires and 1.62x out of state. We show this skill comes from message passing rather than cell features or the aggregator, is highest on young fires in state, is carried deep along the wind by its edges, and is hidden by pooling. A convolutional network matches this ranking once trained on new growth, at worse calibration, so candidate construction, target definition, and aggregation shape conclusions about model skill. Editing fuel and barrier attributes reduces predicted spread more under guided than random placement, extending FireGraphNet to operational intervention analysis.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: FinGREAT: Evaluating LLMs on Financial Graph-guided Retrieval And Typing
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF

Financial disclosures express the underlying relationships of double-entry accounting through unstructured text.

Financial disclosures express the underlying relationships of double-entry accounting through unstructured text. While financial LLM benchmarks predominantly emphasize question answering and classification, schema-guided evidence discovery remains relatively under-explored. We investigate whether open-weight LLMs can extract and classify evidence corresponding to predefined double-entry accounting relationships underlying the text. Using a financial accounting graph comprising 11 nodes (accounts) and 11 edges (transaction types), we evaluate mid-sized models from 5 open-weight families across 1,300 SEC 10-K Item 7 filings spanning 26 years, comparing their extraction performance against three proprietary models. item.title: Federated Art Chase: Privacy Leakage and Data Poisoning in Federated Fine-Tuning
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF

Federated learning (FL) is increasingly used to adapt a pretrained, centrally fine-tuned model to data that remain on user devices, beyond training a model from scratch.

Federated learning (FL) is increasingly used to adapt a pretrained, centrally fine-tuned model to data that remain on user devices, beyond training a model from scratch. In this report, prepared for the 4th Federated Machine Learning International Summer School, we study the privacy and integrity of this approach with a reproducible pipeline. An ImageNet-pretrained MobileNetV4-Conv-Small model is fine-tuned centrally on ten Quick, Draw! classes (97.50% test accuracy) and then adapted with head-only FedAvg over ten non-IID clients, which raises client training accuracy from 90.34% to 91.49% while preserving global accuracy. We evaluate four adversarial scenarios. First, from a single one-step client update, an honest-but-curious server recovers the complete private label set, but its reconstructions follow class prototypes rather than the private drawings (mean SSIM 0.130). Second, from a one-round FedAvg aggregate, label-count recovery falls from 87.5% with one client to 75.0% with five and ten clients, below the 80.0% of an uninformed uniform guess. Third, under FedAvg, a backdoor injected by 30%, 50%, and 100% of the clients reaches an attack success rate (ASR) of 21.9%, 31.3%, a…

item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF

Optical Wireless Communication (OWC) systems provide high-bandwidth, spatially secure, and RF-interference-free digital transmission.

Optical Wireless Communication (OWC) systems provide high-bandwidth, spatially secure, and RF-interference-free digital transmission. However, direct free-space optical links suffer from extreme sensitivity to line-of-sight disruptions, optical attenuation, high ambient light saturation, and transmitter-receiver misalignment. Traditional channel diagnostic frameworks rely on external computing nodes or cloud-based processing, which introduces severe diagnostic latency and reduces edge node autonomy. This paper presents an autonomous, self-diagnosing optical wireless receiver node that integrates physical-layer signal telemetry extraction with an on-device TinyML classification engine. Built around an ESP32-S3 microcontroller, the receiver recovers 1000 bit/s On-Off Keying (OOK) digital payloads using a 5-sample majority voting mechanism while concurrently extracting real-time channel features: Bit Error Rate (BER), received signal voltage (Vsignal), Signal-to-Noise Ratio (SNRdB), and ambient light baseline (Lambient). item.title: Fast Distributed $(Δ+ 1)$-Edge Coloring in Bipartite Graphs
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF

We show that, on bipartite $n$-vertex graphs in the LOCAL model of distributed computation, $(Δ+ 1)$-edge coloring can be solved deterministically in $O(f(Δ) \log n)$ rounds for some function $f$.

We show that, on bipartite $n$-vertex graphs in the LOCAL model of distributed computation, $(Δ+ 1)$-edge coloring can be solved deterministically in $O(f(Δ) \log n)$ rounds for some function $f$. In particular this implies a deterministic $O(\log n)$-round upper bound for $(Δ+ 1)$-edge coloring on bipartite constant-degree graphs. Our results improve on the previous state-of-the-art bounds (which hold already on general graphs) whose $n$-dependencies are $\widetilde{O}(\log^5 n)$ rounds deterministically and $\widetilde{O}(\log^2 n)$ rounds randomized [Bernshteyn and Dhawan, J.\ Comb.\ Theory 2025]. In fact, we obtain the aforementioned results already for a more restrictive version of $(Δ+ 1)$-edge coloring that corresponds to a \emph{local-palette} strengthening of Vizing's theorem shown recently to hold [Christiansen, STOC 2023]. In this version, every edge $\{u, v\}$ has to be colored with a color from $\{1, \dots, \max(\operatorname{deg}(u), \operatorname{deg}(v))+ 1\}$. For all of our results, the vertices do not need to know on which side of the bipartition they lie---the structural promise of bipartiteness suffices.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: FUSE: Fairness-aware Update Screening against Byzantine Exploitation in $q$-Fair Federated Learning
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF

Client-level fair federated learning, in the form of $q$-fair federated learning ($q$-FFL), agnostic federated learning, or tilted empirical risk minimization, has emerged as an attractive solution to equalize utility across heterogeneous clients.

Client-level fair federated learning, in the form of $q$-fair federated learning ($q$-FFL), agnostic federated learning, or tilted empirical risk minimization, has emerged as an attractive solution to equalize utility across heterogeneous clients. This paradigm grants high-loss clients greater relative influence, while a central server aggregates their loss-weighted updates into a single shared model. Yet, the Byzantine robustness of $q$-fair federated learning has been largely neglected, leaving the server unable to tell legitimate fairness-induced amplification from malicious update scaling. To address this critical gap, we formalize the problem of Byzantine-robust $q$-fair federated learning under an \emph{update-only interface}, in which the server observes nothing but the fairness-scaled client updates. Our analysis under shared class-conditional label skew shows that fairness scaling preserves the nonnegative class-mixture structure of honest updates, while replacing their unit-sum constraint by a client-dependent radial scale. item.title: FIRM: Fisher-Informed Retention Merging for Federated LLM Unlearning
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF

Federated LLM unlearning addresses targeted knowledge removal when forget and retain data remain distributed across private clients and are inaccessible to the server.

Federated LLM unlearning addresses targeted knowledge removal when forget and retain data remain distributed across private clients and are inaccessible to the server. The resulting locally trained adapters encode conflicting objectives, making their aggregation fundamentally different from conventional federated optimization. A key failure mode is magnitude explosion, whereby unnormalized cross-client aggregation increases the merged update magnitude and degrades retained utility under stronger unlearning. We propose FIRM (Fisher-Informed Retention Merging), a single-round framework for stable and retention-aware server-side aggregation. FIRM uses client-local Fisher statistics as a unified sensitivity signal to construct a Fisher-normalized base merge and impose explicit control over retain-sensitive parameters. Its second-order retention projection admits a unique minimum-distance solution, while the corresponding dual scales with the number of retain clients rather than the model dimension. Experiments across WMDP, TOFU, and MUSE-HP using Zephyr-7B and Llama-3-8B show utility gains at comparable forgetting on WMDP and MUSE-HP, with metric-dependent trade-offs on TOFU. Controlle…

item.title: Exact Makespan Bounds and the GPipe Homogeneity Bias for Heterogeneous LLM Inference Pipelines
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 经典同构 GPipe 公式在异构 GPU 推理流水线的 makespan 估计上偏差有多大、偏差从哪来。

方法 给出精确临界路径刻画：纯前向无通信时 T(M)=(M−1)τ_max+Στ_j；异步 NCCL 通信下附加纯加性常数 Σd_j；阻塞通信下仅当 d_s>τ_max−τ_s 时通信才进入稳态斜率；并把 GPipe 偏差分解为同构项与通信忽略项。

关键数字 在 11 种配置与 1.6×10^5 点模糊测试上逐点验证（误差小于 10^-9），包括 RTX 5090/3090/GTX 1070 混合分区。

为什么值得看 为异构推理流水线设计提供闭式调度依据，并给出「均衡各阶段计算比削减通信更主导稳态吞吐」的直接结论。

item.title: Energy Consumption Analysis of Discrete Diffusion and Autoregressive Language Models
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 LLM 推理能耗日益关键；扩散语言模型（DLLM）支持并行生成，是与自回归（AR）模型并行的路线，但两者缺乏系统的能耗对比。

方法 对扩散模型（LLaDA-8B、Dream-7B）与 AR 模型（Llama-3.1-8B、Qwen-2.5-7B）做对照式能耗基准测试，分析模型架构、KV-cache 优化与每 token 焦耳（J/token）效率之间的权衡。

关键数字 200–600 token 较长序列下，扩散模型能耗 2.5–2.7 J/token，约为带 KV-cache 的 AR 模型（5.3–5.7 J/token）的 1/2；KV-cache 在长序列下为 AR 模型降低 50–70% 能耗。

为什么值得看 为"扩散 vs 自回归"给出直接的每 token 能耗证据，对绿色推理与部署选型有参考价值。

item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF

Efficient sequence modeling remains a fundamental challenge in machine learning.

Efficient sequence modeling remains a fundamental challenge in machine learning. Despite the success of Transformers, recurrent neural networks (RNNs) have recently re-emerged as efficient alternatives. Particularly, Echo State Networks (ESNs) offer a compelling framework of randomized RNNs that have been extensively studied for time-series forecasting and dynamical systems. This paper presents an empirical analysis of distributional, architectural, and optimization variants of ESNs evaluated on few-shot sequence-to-sequence (seq2seq) pattern tasks. These synthetic tasks utilize discrete symbol sequences, characterized by delays, inactive phases, and triggered markers to isolate and evaluate memory and pattern recognition capabilities. The minimality of these tasks is crucial to understand the strengths and limitations of machine learning models. Furthermore, when the input signal utilizes a one-hot encoding, ESN dynamics are governed strictly by their weight distributions, offering an ideal lens through which to study reservoir computing. Our findings map the performance boundaries of ESNs relative to state-of-the-art (SOTA) models. We show that preserving a linear state regime is…

item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF

We study finite stochastic partial monitoring (PM) games with side information, a paradigm of sequential learning with partial feedback.

We study finite stochastic partial monitoring (PM) games with side information, a paradigm of sequential learning with partial feedback. On each round $t \in [T]$, both player and environment observe a context and player chooses an action and environment simultaneously chooses an outcome. The player neither observes the outcome nor the loss; instead, they only observe a feedback symbol which is partially informative about the outcome. We utilize the Estimation-to-Decisions (E2D) meta-algorithm of Foster et al.(2021) to design E2D.PMSide, a computationally efficient framework for contextual partial monitoring, which uses an online regression oracle to efficiently estimate the outcome distributions based on historical (context, action, feedback symbol) tuples. Since the exploration rule given by the original E2D algorithm is intractable to compute, we propose two computationally efficient exploration rules that achieve optimal regret orders in $T$: in the globally observable setting, our exploration rule is based on $ε$-greedy, while in the locally observable setting, our exploration rule uses inverse gap weighting (Foster & Rakhlin, 2020), which was previously only known to be effec…

item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF

Pairwise Difference Learning for Classification (PDC) enhances supervised learning in low-data regimes by training a binary similarity classifier on pairs of instances rather than individual samples,

Pairwise Difference Learning for Classification (PDC) enhances supervised learning in low-data regimes by training a binary similarity classifier on pairs of instances rather than individual samples, effectively inflating the training set from $n$ to $O(n^2)$ examples. However, the PDC framework leaves critical implementation choices underspecified, particularly regarding input representation and pair selection strategies. This work systematically investigates these design decisions through extensive empirical evaluation. We compare four feature encoders (paired features, triplet with relative difference, absolute difference, and a novel triplet with absolute difference) alongside four pair selection strategies ranging from exhaustive to kernel-thinning-based schemes. Experiments across nearly 200 benchmark classification datasets using Decision Tree, Multilayer Perceptron, Gaussian Naive Bayes, and Support Vector Classifier as base models reveal that the proposed triplet with absolute difference encoder ($φ_{\mathrm{3dabs}}$) achieves the highest average F1 scores. item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 协同边缘计算中边缘服务器易断连或过载，而云端 KV 迁移方法（跨 GPU 直传、从输入重算）不适配带宽受限的边缘环境。

方法 EdgeFlow 混合迁移方案：KV 缓存直传与基于激活的重算并行推进，以计算-通信重叠压缩迁移时间；把多节点迁移建模为优化问题，用改进的线性规划松弛加二部图技术设计 2-近似算法。

关键数字 在真实分布式 LLM 推理平台上，迁移时间最多降低 45%。

为什么值得看 直击边缘 LLM 推理的有状态迁移痛点，算法带近似比保证，兼顾鲁棒性与效率。

item.title: ETH: Data-Balanced Heterogeneous Pipeline Parallelism for Training Large Models
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 现有异构感知训练系统靠给各阶段分配不等层数来均衡负载，既解决不了内存约束，均衡粒度也太粗。

方法 提出数据均衡的异构流水线并行（HPP）并用 ETH 系统实现：分层工作负载均衡框架联合优化跨流水线与阶段内的均衡，块级梯度聚合缓解非对称 All-Reduce 通信，专门优化大幅降低 HPP 配置搜索开销。

关键数字 相比最先进系统，训练加速最高 2 倍，配置生成开销最高降低 56 倍。

为什么值得看 数据均衡比按层切分更细粒度，且直面异构训练的内存瓶颈，代码已开源。

item.title: ESL-former: Event Sparse Linear Transformer for FPGA-Accelerated Malware Detection
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 基于 Transformer 的恶意软件检测有潜力，但自注意力的计算与内存成本使其难以部署到资源受限的边缘 FPGA。

方法 提出事件稀疏线性 Transformer（ESL-former）：不构造显式注意力矩阵，直接从 Linear Transformer 累积的键值状态推导 token 与通道重要性；贡献感知打分函数度量各 token/通道对线性注意力状态的扰动，剪掉冗余；硬件上用 Top-K 活跃 token 缓冲与压缩单元替代二值掩码执行，将活跃 token/通道重组为稠密定长数据流，让处理单元执行规则乘累加。

关键数字 摘要未给出具体量化指标，结论为在保持恶意软件分类精度的同时降低硬件成本。

为什么值得看 把 Transformer 安全检测落到功耗敏感的边缘 FPGA，线性注意力 + 稀疏化 + 硬件重组的协同设计值得借鉴。

item.title: Does On-Policy Distillation Need to Complete Every Rollout?
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF

On-policy distillation (OPD) effectively transfers capabilities from a teacher to a student through feedback on student-generated rollouts.

On-policy distillation (OPD) effectively transfers capabilities from a teacher to a student through feedback on student-generated rollouts. However, generating complete student rollouts and computing teacher feedback for every token make OPD computationally expensive. We introduce Stochastic Truncated On-Policy Distillation (STOPD), which accelerates OPD by randomly truncating student rollouts and correcting the resulting sampling bias with blockwise inverse-probability weighting (IPW). At each training step, we sample a stopping position for each rollout before generation and let the student generate until that position or natural termination. We obtain teacher feedback on every generated token and use blockwise IPW to compensate for the lower probability of retaining later tokens while controlling the weights. We prove that this weighting preserves Vanilla OPD's gradient sum in expectation and derive one-step update-error bounds for SGD, Adam, and Muon. We evaluate STOPD across multiple teacher-student model pairs, task domains, and optimizers. STOPD reduces generated tokens by 25-48% while maintaining accuracy comparable to Vanilla OPD, achieving 1.3-2.2x training speedups.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Does Compression Imply Generalization? A Minimum Description Length Perspective
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF

A central question in modern learning theory is what notion of compression, if any, explains why over-parameterized neural networks generalize.

A central question in modern learning theory is what notion of compression, if any, explains why over-parameterized neural networks generalize. Existing answers measure complexity at different levels, ranging from weights to representations; however, estimating the associated quantities either requires held-out data in principle or relies on the challenging (ultra) high-dimensional mutual information estimation. To overcome these challenges, we approach the question through the minimum description length (MDL) principle, and specifically, we propose the prequential regret as a complementary signal that is computable from the training trajectory alone. We establish that, in the (nearly) interpolating regime, the expected prequential regret upper-bounds the description length of the trained parameter under the algorithm-induced distribution, and that this description length translates into a high-probability generalization bound in the PAC-MDL setting. Along the way, we show that the encoder-complexity correction recently added to the algorithm-level information bottleneck (IB) is upper-bounded by an MDL parameter description length, \new{bringing together} the two views of compressi…

item.title: Do Vision CIL Methods Transfer to Protein? A Diagnostic Benchmark of Frozen Protein Encoders
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF

Protein function annotation operates over an expanding label space, making class-incremental learning (CIL) a natural framework for incorporating newly discovered functions without full retraining.

Protein function annotation operates over an expanding label space, making class-incremental learning (CIL) a natural framework for incorporating newly discovered functions without full retraining. Yet existing CIL methods have been developed largely in vision and have not been systematically evaluated over frozen protein representations. We conduct a controlled benchmark of nine representative CIL methods across five sequence-, structure-, and sequence--structure-based protein encoders and two enzyme function datasets at different scales, while keeping the encoders frozen and evaluation settings consistent across representations. We find that no method transfers reliably across encoders, and that these failures persist across alternative phase constructions. Diagnostic analyses reveal that this instability arises from weak gradient-based stability signals, substantial heterogeneity in embedding geometry, and covariance assumptions whose appropriate capacity changes with both dataset scale and encoder. These findings suggest that the representation itself should be treated as a central component of continual-learning design rather than a passive feature extractor. More generally, r…

item.title: Divergent Paths: Learning an Outcome-Predictive Representation of LLM Agent Trajectories
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF

In this work, we reframe agentic trajectories as paths through a shared embedding space of actions and environmental observations.

In this work, we reframe agentic trajectories as paths through a shared embedding space of actions and environmental observations. We show that successful and failed rollouts of the same task separate in this space, with simple per-task discriminators predicting held-out rollout outcomes at up to 0.95 AUROC across three agent benchmarks and three policy models. To exploit this signal across tasks, we introduce Precog-RM, a transformer-based model that meta-learns a representation in which outcome prediction can be performed in a few-shot setting. We show that Precog-RM generalizes to unseen tasks and models, and gives confident predictions of trajectory success long before termination. Deployed as an early stopping controller for Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) on Tau2-Bench, Precog-RM cuts training FLOPs by up to 47.3\% while maintaining performance comparable to baseline GRPO.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Diffusion Language Models as Open Quantum Systems
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF

Diffusion language models generate text by reversing a classical diffusion process over token sequences.

Diffusion language models generate text by reversing a classical diffusion process over token sequences. We show that their continuous-time forward and reverse dynamics can be embedded in the framework of open quantum systems, which describes quantum systems interacting with their environment. This connection provides a basis for extending diffusion sampling to superpositions of sentence states and for modifying the underlying generation dynamics. We construct a $τ$-leaping unraveling scheme that simulates stochastic trajectories of these states while updating multiple token positions at each step. This enables generation conditioned on superposed prompts or thoughts, which we call Superposition of Prompts (SoP) and Superposition of Thoughts (SoT). The same formulation yields Quantum-Inspired Remasking (QIR): perturbing the masked-diffusion dynamics produces a confidence-based rule for revising previously generated tokens. Experiments with pretrained diffusion language models show that superposition-based generation can retain information from conditioning components not selected at the final measurement, while QIR improves LLM-assessed text quality when applied at an appropriate s…

item.title: Did the LLM Answer the Question? A Semantic Reconstruction Game for Jailbreak Evaluation
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF

Jailbreak attacks against large language models (LLMs) are evaluated using attack success rate (ASR), which depends on correctly identifying responses that fulfill prohibited requests.

Jailbreak attacks against large language models (LLMs) are evaluated using attack success rate (ASR), which depends on correctly identifying responses that fulfill prohibited requests. Existing evaluators can mistake refusals or topically related responses for successful attacks. We show that changing only the judge LLM can alter reported ASR by up to $82$ percentage points. We introduce the semantic reconstruction game, a training-free evaluator that decomposes compliance judgments into constrained semantic comparisons. Given only a response, an LLM reconstructs the request answered by its substantive content, excluding information merely repeated or refused. The game compares this reconstruction against similar decoy requests to determine whether it matches the original request, allowing abstention when neither candidate matches. Across three off-the-shelf LLM judges, the game achieves the lowest mean error against human labels among evaluated methods and reduces variation in reported ASR. It prioritizes avoiding false positives, even at the cost of missing some successful jailbreaks.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Diagnosing GNN Failure Modes with Layer-Wise Probe Entropy
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF

Graph neural networks (GNNs) are typically evaluated only at their final layer, obscuring how task-relevant information evolves during message passing.

Graph neural networks (GNNs) are typically evaluated only at their final layer, obscuring how task-relevant information evolves during message passing. We introduce a post-hoc diagnostic that freezes a trained GNN, fits an independent linear probe to each layer, and tracks probe accuracy alongside normalized predictive entropy. Across real and synthetic graph settings, layer-wise probe entropy distinguishes beneficial, neutral, and harmful smoothing, a capability not demonstrated by existing geometric measures. Moreover, by comparing shallow and deep models, we show that the onset of entropy degradation separates the two main GNN failure modes: structural mismatch under heterophily, which appears from the earliest layers even in shallow models, and excessive-depth oversmoothing, which emerges only as propagation depth increases. These results establish probe-entropy trajectories as a tool for analyzing information flow in GNNs and motivate future work on adaptive depth selection and early-exit mechanisms.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Demystifying On-Policy Distillation: Where Does the Teacher's Advantage Live?
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF

On-policy distillation (OPD) is increasingly studied as a cheaper alternative to reinforcement learning, yet it remains a form of knowledge distillation (KD) that relies on teacher supervision.

On-policy distillation (OPD) is increasingly studied as a cheaper alternative to reinforcement learning, yet it remains a form of knowledge distillation (KD) that relies on teacher supervision. We revisit OPD from the KD perspective by asking where the teacher's advantage lies along student-generated trajectories. Controlled token flips at teacher-student disagreements directly measure the accuracy gained from teacher corrections. Single-token flips yield a modest average gain on selected failed trajectories, whereas repeated flips raise accuracy from 28.4% to 74.5%, close to the teacher's 76.9%. Gains continue to accumulate with more flips, but mass- and KL-based selection outperform random flips by 15-18 percentage points at counts of similar magnitude. Selective intervention remains useful after OPD, but greater argmax agreement does not consistently improve accuracy across model pairs. We advocate training schedules that learn more valuable teacher corrections while maintaining distributional stability. Controlled flips and fork-resolution analysis evaluate OPD beyond accuracy by measuring which teacher preferences the student acquires and what further correction can recover.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Deep Generative Models for Phylogenetic Inference with Complex Evolutionary Processes
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF

Inference of phylogenetic trees from sequences plays a central role in understanding evolutionary relationships, with applications ranging from tracking pathogen spread to reconstructing the history of life.

Inference of phylogenetic trees from sequences plays a central role in understanding evolutionary relationships, with applications ranging from tracking pathogen spread to reconstructing the history of life. Conventionally, practitioners obtain posteriors over trees using likelihood-based methods like MCMC. However, likelihoods are only available for simple evolutionary models with restrictive assumptions. For realistic evolutionary models, inference using conventional methods is prohibitively expensive, inaccurate, or even impossible. In practice, practitioners settle for using as flexible a conventional method as possible, even though they expect it is misspecified. In principle, we could use simulation-based inference: simulate tree and sequence data from an evolutionary model and train a neural network to predict the posterior over trees given sequences. However it is a mathematical challenge to represent and train complex posterior distributions over trees. Here we present a flexible family of conditional generative models over trees. Our models iteratively build trees using three natural paradigms -- top-down, middle-out, or bottom-up -- and are trained using a discrete diffu…

Inference of phylogenetic trees from sequences plays a central role in understanding evolutionary relationships, with applications ranging from tracking pathogen spread to reconstructing the history of life.

Inference of phylogenetic trees from sequences plays a central role in understanding evolutionary relationships, with applications ranging from tracking pathogen spread to reconstructing the history of life. Conventionally, practitioners obtain posteriors over trees using likelihood-based methods like MCMC. However, likelihoods are only available for simple evolutionary models with restrictive assumptions. For realistic evolutionary models, inference using conventional methods is prohibitively expensive, inaccurate, or even impossible. In practice, practitioners settle for using as flexible a conventional method as possible, even though they expect it is misspecified. In principle, we could use simulation-based inference: simulate tree and sequence data from an evolutionary model and train a neural network to predict the posterior over trees given sequences. However it is a mathematical challenge to represent and train complex posterior distributions over trees. Here we present a flexible family of conditional generative models over trees. Our models iteratively build trees using three natural paradigms -- top-down, middle-out, or bottom-up -- and are trained using a discrete diffu…

item.title: Decoupled Marginal Sharpening for Training-Free Inference-Time Scaling
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF

We study how to improve LLM reasoning at inference time without updating model weights or using external reward models.

We study how to improve LLM reasoning at inference time without updating model weights or using external reward models. Recent reward-free power-sampling methods define the sequence-level power target $π_α(y\mid x)\propto p_0(y\mid x)^α$, where $α>1$, which increases the relative probability of completions that are already likely under the base model. Existing methods use Metropolis--Hastings or Sequential Monte Carlo (SMC) to approximately sample from this target. However, two challenges arise at different levels. At the target level, full-sequence sharpening can concentrate probability on a few exact reasoning--answer trajectories, suppressing alternative paths that support the same answer. At the sampler level, finite-particle SMC can suffer from path collapse when resampling repeatedly duplicates a few high-weight prefixes. To address these challenges, we propose Decoupled Marginal Sharpening (DMS), which separately controls how strongly the model favors particular reasoning paths and how strongly it favors final answers after aggregating support across those paths. item.title: Decoding Naturalistic Speech from fMRI with Temporal Modeling and Multimodal Alignment
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF

Reconstructing what a person perceives from their brain activity is a stringent test of whether neural recordings carry meaningful information.

Reconstructing what a person perceives from their brain activity is a stringent test of whether neural recordings carry meaningful information. Naturalistic speech offers a rich testbed for this challenge: it unfolds over multiple timescales, but fMRI's noisy, temporally smeared measurements make this structure hard to recover. We introduce NOEMA, a temporal convolutional decoder that aligns windows of consecutive fMRI measurements with multimodal stimulus embeddings. These embeddings combine complementary text, audio, and speech representations of the same stimulus segment, enabling its retrieval directly from brain activity. On two naturalistic speech datasets, Cephalonauts One and LeBel, NOEMA retrieves the correct segment among 2,000 candidates within the top 10 for more than 42% of held-out queries. This substantially outperforms baseline decoders, an advantage that persists when the candidate pool is extended with thousands of distractors absent from training. Controlled ablations establish the contributions of temporal modeling and complementary stimulus representations.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Data Density Scaling Laws for Image Self-Distillation
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF

Current scaling law formulations suggest that increasing the number of unique samples in a dataset improves model performance, while repeated exposure to the same samples provides diminishing value.

Current scaling law formulations suggest that increasing the number of unique samples in a dataset improves model performance, while repeated exposure to the same samples provides diminishing value. In this work, we examine this assumption for image self-distillation models. Through systematic experiments across diverse datasets, namely Maxar, SATLAS, Waymo, nuPlan, Ego4D, ImageNet, and YFCC15M, we demonstrate that the effects of sample repetition on downstream performance are non-trivial and dataset-dependent. We identify settings where repeatedly training on a smaller random subset can outperform training on a larger set of unique samples. This finding highlights a limitation of existing scaling laws. To address this gap, we propose a modified version of a Chinchilla-style scaling law that explicitly accounts for two factors: the number of unique samples and repetition per sample. This formulation provides a framework for understanding data-compute trade-offs and improves prediction in some regimes where repetition plays a central role, although its benefits are not consistent across datasets. Finally, we examine how subset selection and augmentation affect downstream performance…

item.title: DTDD: Divergence-Triggered Dynamic Distillation for Reliable On-Policy Supervision
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF

On-policy distillation (OPD) provides dense token-level supervision on student rollouts, but this supervision can become unreliable when the student and teacher diverge, either because of a large init

On-policy distillation (OPD) provides dense token-level supervision on student rollouts, but this supervision can become unreliable when the student and teacher diverge, either because of a large initial policy gap or compounding errors in long-horizon reasoning and tool use. We introduce Divergence-Triggered Dynamic Distillation (DTDD), an adaptive OPD framework that uses segment-level student-teacher divergence to trigger teacher takeover during training. When divergence triggers an intervention during reasoning, the student prefix continues to receive standard OPD supervision. The teacher then generates a recovery suffix, which the student learns through behavior cloning, using cross-entropy on the teacher-generated tokens. We evaluate DTDD in three regimes: long-horizon reasoning, distillation from a base initialization without offline supervised fine-tuning (SFT), and multi-turn agents. We also compare alternative trigger designs and teacher-intervention rates. DTDD reduces the post-warmup peak gradient norm by $8.6\times$ and, from a base initialization, reaches $21.3\%$ held-out math accuracy in $2.6\times$ fewer optimizer updates than OPD; both methods finish near $22\%$. item.title: Coordination-Free Workload Regularization for Variable-Cost Distributed Training
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF

Synchronous data-parallel training usually assigns every rank the same number of records, even when record costs vary by orders of magnitude.

Synchronous data-parallel training usually assigns every rank the same number of records, even when record costs vary by orders of magnitude. For variable-length models, this converts input variation into idle time because each step waits for its most expensive rank-local batch. We present Batch Cost Lookahead (BCL), a coordination-free data-loading policy that buffers a bounded rank-local window and repartitions it into fixed-cardinality packs with balanced estimated cost. BCL preserves the trainer's record-count contract and requires neither cross-rank metadata exchange nor runtime modification. In simulation over public workload distributions, enabling BCL reduces per-rank estimated batch-cost variability by up to 82.8%. Across 13 NeMo-RL SFT corpora on eight H200 GPUs, rank-local BCL runs 1.050 to 1.167 times faster than pooled MFFD. Compiled H200 measurements on an internal sequence workload show speedups of 1.197 to 1.343 times over packed execution from one to four nodes. We also identify a memory-feasibility boundary: a p99 cap for high-variance or OOM-prone data bounds outliers before BCL balances the rest. These results show that substantial variable-cost imbalance can be…

item.title: Continuum Attention
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF

We introduce Continuum Attention (CA), a causal Transformer attention operator that replaces discrete key and value lookup with integration over a continuous, piecewise linear memory curve.

We introduce Continuum Attention (CA), a causal Transformer attention operator that replaces discrete key and value lookup with integration over a continuous, piecewise linear memory curve. Each query induces an exponential relevance density along the curve. Integrating the density and interpolated values yields exact normalized attention from closed form exponential moments, including half token boundary contributions. The gradients follow analytically from moments of order at most two, enabling parallel GPU implementations while retaining quadratic sequence complexity and the standard Transformer decoder. Compared with ordinary softmax and focal attention, CA reduces mean validation negative log likelihood by 0.0200 and 0.0480 nats per byte, respectively, winning all paired comparisons. An additional disjoint validation slice yields a 0.0457 nats per byte advantage over the strongest selected softmax baseline, with a paired 95% confidence interval. These findings motivate continuous integration as a promising attention alternative while leaving larger scale generalization open.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 量化激活的多阈值硬件表示目前只支持单调递增函数、逐通道一维粒度和少数预定义激活-量化器组合。

方法 形式化多阈值表示，扩展到非单调函数与多维阈值的细粒度参数；给出集成进 ONNX 编译器基础设施的代数规则，自动把量化函数组合转换为阈值表示，并把基于二分搜索的多阈值算子扩展进 FINN 框架做定制 FPGA 加速器端到端综合。

关键数字 摘要未给出量化性能数字，主要是对非单调与细粒度支持的硬件成本刻画（与图级分解方案及 hls4ml 对比），并演示以多阈值表示做量化感知训练的前景。

为什么值得看 为定制加速器解除了少比特激活函数的形状限制，对做 FPGA DNN 加速器的人是块重要拼图。

item.title: Compatibility Matters: A Framework for Token-Level Teacher Selection in On-Policy Distillation
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF

On-policy distillation (OPD) has recently been introduced as a promising paradigm for continual learning, where a student policy can be supervised at the token-level.

On-policy distillation (OPD) has recently been introduced as a promising paradigm for continual learning, where a student policy can be supervised at the token-level. Typically, OPD is performed using a single teacher per prompt rollout (or even per training run). However, this ignores a whole other axis of flexibility that is available due to the on-policy nature - token-level teacher selection during rollouts. Building on this insight, we theoretically explore what makes a teacher and a student compatible for OPD, and leverage our findings to derive several empirical heuristics for teacher selection. In particular, our framework captures several desiderata for OPD: compatible teacher-student reasoning patterns, teacher competence, and induced student diversity. Theoretically, we categorize several types of teacher routing schemes, and we prove that under different scenarios, different routing schemes are likely to be beneficial for optimization and student diversity. We back up our findings with extensive experimental results in domains such as math, coding, kernel generation, and visual reasoning, where we find upwards of 10 percentage points of improvement on pass@$k$ when comp…

item.title: Close Enough is Nowhere Near: Fidelity-Consumability Decoupling in KV Caches
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 多智能体系统中双方模型都冻结时，能否把发送方的 KV 缓存直接替换给阅读方，实现无损的缓存通信。

方法 答案是不能：冻结的 transformer 只能消费与其自写缓存足够接近的缓存（可容忍集），几何相似性无法预测可消费性，且失败不是渐进的；作者用竞争性注意力机制解释该现象。

关键数字 8 种替换方法对照无信息缓存基线与阅读方自读精度两个锚点，全部停留在基线水平；改让阅读方保留自身缓存、仅调整 query 去注意发送方缓存则能超过基线，合并 8 个发送方时仍高于基线。

为什么值得看 把一串零散负结果整合为带推翻条件的单一结论，并指明「叠加缓存而非替换」的可行方向。

item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF

In this paper, we present a lightweight algorithm for modelling tabular data containing both continuous and discrete variables.

In this paper, we present a lightweight algorithm for modelling tabular data containing both continuous and discrete variables. The method uses empirical marginal distributions and a selected quantile function to transform the data into a continuous latent space, where a distribution of choice, e.g. a multivariate Gaussian, can be efficiently estimated and applied. While this approach is closely related to classical well-established machine learning methods, we present a novel adaptation that fits well within the contemporary computational ecosystem. Unlike in the case of deep architectures, it results in a simple implementation with few dependencies, robust training/estimation, as well as efficient sampling. The transformation preserves complex marginal distributions and correlations, providing high-fidelity models, especially for data with unimodal distributions. One of the key characteristics of the proposed approach is its continuous representation of discrete variables. While highly desirable, this introduces a significant challenge, since a single observation corresponds to a region rather than a point in the latent space. We propose CktHGVAE, a heterogeneous graph variational autoencoder for transistor-level analog/mixedsignal CMOS circuits that takes not only design variables but also state variables as its inputs and outputs. With a single hyperparameter configuration without topology-specific tuning, comparison between model-generated and SPICE-simulated circuit operational states gives median R2 values above 0.9 for typical single-ended voltage amplifiers and the CMOS inverter, and 0.81-0.96 for differential amplifiers with larger datasets. Latent-space optimization in the PCA-reduced latent space with Bayesian optimization, evolutionary search, random search, and quasi-exhaustive search is demonstrated for a common-source voltage amplifier with NMOS input and resistive load, where the objective function is defined as a penalty for deviation from required circuit specifications. For each search strategy, 93.3 - 100% of all design candidates suggested by the model satisfy the required circuit specifications at the decoder output, and SPICE simulations verify that 90 - 100% of them indeed satisfy the requirements. With a single hyperparameter configuration without topology-specific tuning, comparison between model-generated and SPICE-simulated circuit operational states gives median R2 values above 0.9 for typical single-ended voltage amplifiers and the CMOS inverter, and 0.81-0.96 for differential amplifiers with larger datasets. Latent-space optimization in the PCA-reduced latent space with Bayesian optimization, evolutionary search, random search, and quasi-exhaustive search is demonstrated for a common-source voltage amplifier with NMOS input and resistive load, where the objective function is defined as a penalty for deviation from required circuit specifications. For each search strategy, 93.3 - 100% of all design candidates suggested by the model satisfy the required circuit specifications at the decoder output, and SPICE simulations verify that 90 - 100% of them indeed satisfy the requirements. item.title: ChemArgus: Automated Scientific Diagnostics for Lab-Grade Multimodal Chemistry Reasoning: A Frontier Benchmark
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF

Chemistry evaluation has moved past multiple-choice probes toward open-ended expert problems, yet the benchmarks that define the current frontier still score answer endpoints alone.

Chemistry evaluation has moved past multiple-choice probes toward open-ended expert problems, yet the benchmarks that define the current frontier still score answer endpoints alone. Such scoring conflates memorized facts with stepwise derivation, treats visual and textual inputs as interchangeable, and confounds long-horizon planning with stepwise execution. These blind spots prevent any diagnosis of where the reasoning chain breaks in a model. We present ChemArgus, a competition-level chemistry benchmark drawn from chemistry competition material, textbooks, and research papers, whose scoring replaces the answer endpoint with three measurement properties. Fine-grained scoring grades every subquestion point by point with partial credit, so a score lands at the level of the step rather than the outcome. Multimodal capability is priced on every problem containing a real image, paired with a controlled text description, so visual understanding is measured against text on identical tasks. Diagnostic attribution reads paired metrics that share one scoring unit and differ only in context construction, so a gap between two scores isolates a single cause, namely integration, propagation, or…

item.title: Chance-Constrained Personalized LLM Routing with Online Preference Learning
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF

We study personalized LLM routing, where a router selects among heterogeneous models with different costs and capabilities.

We study personalized LLM routing, where a router selects among heterogeneous models with different costs and capabilities. The router must minimize cumulative inference cost while ensuring reliable realized response quality, even though user preferences are unknown and must be learned from feedback during deployment. We formulate this problem as a constrained contextual bandit and develop an algorithm that learns preferences while balancing cost and quality. Under a logistic preference model and a strict-feasibility condition, we establish sublinear expected cost regret relative to an optimal stationary randomized contextual oracle and a high-probability guarantee on realized cumulative satisfaction. The framework extends beyond LLM routing to broader online model-selection problems with reliability requirements.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Can LLMs predict the outcomes of machine learning experiments?
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF

Recent advances in AI make Recursive Self-Improvement (RSI) increasingly plausible.

Recent advances in AI make Recursive Self-Improvement (RSI) increasingly plausible. Large Language Models (LLMs) can already propose, select, and run Machine Learning (ML) experiments. However, the space of possible design choices in ML is vast. An LLM that proposes an experiment needs a reliable intuition of whether it is worth running given the timing constraints of long training runs. In this work, we measure such intuition in current frontier LLMs by evaluating how accurately they predict the impact of self-generated ML experiment ideas before these are put into training runs. To this end, we construct a dataset of 288 LLM-proposed ideas on eight MLE-bench tasks. We then prompt five frontier LLMs (GPT-6 Astra, Claude Opus 5.5, Claude Fable 5.1, Kimi K3, and GLM-5.3) to predict the impact of each idea and compare their predictions with the actual outcomes after training. We report four main findings. First, LLM predictions are substantially better than random chance but far from accurate: even the best model, Claude Opus 5.5, explains only half of the variance in outcomes (R^2 = 0.49). item.title: CacheSmith: Accurate RAG Serving under Latency SLOs with Adaptive KV Reuse
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 RAG prefill 中复用检索块的预计算 KV 可降低延迟，但会漏掉跨块注意力；已有选择性重算方案采用静态一刀切配置，无法应对请求异质性与动态延迟预算。

方法 CacheSmith 把选择性重算分解为 WarmUp、Probe、Patch 三阶段，可动态配置以覆盖宽范围的成本-精度权衡；服务时由 SLO 感知调度器组批降低请求间干扰，预算感知规划器跨批次配置重算阶段，两组件均基于剖析得到的成本-精度带做免求解器快速决策。

关键数字 在 4 个基准、不同到达率与突发度下，质量门控 SLO 达成率较四个 SOTA 基线最高提升 27.5%。

为什么值得看 针对 RAG 服务"精度门控 + 延迟 SLO"联合目标的系统设计，做 RAG 推理服务的团队可直接参考。

item.title: CTIA-ODE: Continuous-Time Inter-Variable Attention for Long-Term Time Series Forecasting
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF

Although multivariate time series forecasting has broad application prospects, effectively incorporating exogenous variables remains challenging.

Although multivariate time series forecasting has broad application prospects, effectively incorporating exogenous variables remains challenging. Prevailing discrete-time architectures often impose rigid temporal alignment across heterogeneous variables, which may limit their ability to capture continuously evolving external effects. To address this limitation, we introduce CTIA-ODE, a continuous-time forecasting framework centered on Continuous-Time Inter-Variable Attention (CTIA). Specifically, CTIA is embedded within an ordinary differential equation (ODE) solver, enabling the continuously evolving endogenous trajectory to dynamically query a static exogenous context along the integration path without requiring explicit temporal alignment. To improve the stability of the continuous latent dynamics, we further introduce a dual-stabilization strategy: architecturally, a Linear Residual Augmentation (LRA) module provides a macroscopic trend anchor, while an Outlier-Robust Hybrid Loss (ORHL) mitigates the influence of heavy-tailed anomalies during optimization. Extensive experiments across eight real-world datasets demonstrate that CTIA-ODE achieves state-of-the-art forecasting perf…

item.title: CMM-MP: A Novel Memory Pooling Architecture using Purpose-built Memory Device with CXL and Ethernet
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：内存密集型工作负载需要百 TB 级 GPU/CPU 可寻址内存池，但纯 CXL fabric 受成本/规模限制，纯 RDMA 又延迟偏高；能否把两者结合做成专用内存池化器件？

方法：CMM-MP 把 CXL 与以太网融合为单一内存池化器件，把发现、组合、后端网络数据通路全部 offload 到器件侧，对上层暴露为一台逻辑大内存设备，同时支持 pooling 与 sharing 两种用法。

关键数字：单器件延迟 2.7 μs、吞吐最高 23 GB/s；在 Valkey+YCSB、DiskANN 等真实负载上延迟与吞吐均显著优于 RDMA 方案。

为什么值得看：CXL 内存池化的硬件/系统协同工程落地范例，做大内存池化与可组合内存基础设施的可参考样本。

原文：CMM-MP: A Novel Memory Pooling Architecture using Purpose-built Memory Device with CXL and Ethernet

item.title: CGDT-CESN: Correlation-Guided and Dynamics-Trained Clustered Echo State Network for Multivariate Time-Series Prediction
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF

Accurate prediction of multivariate time series requires models that simultaneously capture variable-specific dynamics and cross-variable interactions.

Accurate prediction of multivariate time series requires models that simultaneously capture variable-specific dynamics and cross-variable interactions. In this work, a Correlation-Guided and Dynamics-Trained Clustered Echo State Network (CGDT-CESN) is proposed, which comprises a modular reservoir architecture with each cluster distinctly specializing in one of the variables in the multivariate time series. An innovative reservoir design is proposed in which inter-cluster connections are enabled by empirically observed correlations among variables, providing a data-driven coupling mechanism. Apart from conventional readout training, inter-cluster connection weights informed by correlations are trained, which in turn allows the reservoir to capture time-varying cross-variable dependencies without sacrificing computational efficiency and further improves forecasting accuracy. The prediction performance of CGDT-CESN is found to be superior to that of the conventional ESN when evaluated on two fundamentally different datasets: Twitter information cascade evolution and solar wind forecasting. Also, the improvement in performance is preserved across multiple prediction horizons, even when…

item.title: CAT-alyzing Honesty: Continuous Adversarial Training for Transferable LLM Honesty
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF

Large language models (LLMs) are becoming prevalent in scenarios where honesty is critical.

Large language models (LLMs) are becoming prevalent in scenarios where honesty is critical. However, despite alignment training, these models still exhibit dishonest behaviour, such as outputting claims that contradict some knowledge or are not supported by what is accessible in context. We introduce Continuous Adversarial Training for Consistent Honesty (CATCH), inspired by a method originally developed to robustly refuse harmful queries. CATCH trains the model towards an honest answer and away from a dishonest one while maintaining the model's capabilities. We evaluate two architectures (Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct and Qwen3-3.6-27B). We show that trained with only hundreds of targets built from self-reporting scenarios, CATCH learns an honest behaviour that robustly generalizes and transfers across distinct benchmarks. It consistently reduces dishonesty under pressure on MASK, increases confessions in the multi-agent game of Among Us, and improves the discovery rates of the model's hidden behaviours in AuditBench. We show that CATCH outperforms prompting and supervised fine-tuning in improving honesty, and it is on par with state-of-the-art honesty activation steering. However, CATCH…

item.title: CAST: History-Adaptive Spectral Clipping for LLM Pretraining
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF

Soft spectral clipping (SSC) reduces gradient singular values, but its effect depends on the gradient scale and clipping threshold.

Soft spectral clipping (SSC) reduces gradient singular values, but its effect depends on the gradient scale and clipping threshold. We introduce CAST (Clipping with Adaptive Scales and Thresholds), a history-adaptive extension of SSC. AdamW's previous second moment sets row and column scales. An exponential moving average of the clipped output's estimated spectral norm sets each matrix's threshold. CAST restores the original coordinates before the AdamW update. We train a mixture-of-experts (MoE) model with 19.08B total parameters for 83.89B tokens. CAST achieves lower training and mean validation losses than nine gradient-processing baselines, with the fewest relative gradient spikes. It reaches the best baseline's final smoothed training loss in 7.2\% fewer steps.

item.title: CARD: Closing the Teacher-Student Loop for Adversarial Robustness Distillation
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF

Adversarial robustness distillation typically treats a robust teacher as a fixed knowledge source and transfers robustness to a compact student in a one-way manner.

Adversarial robustness distillation typically treats a robust teacher as a fixed knowledge source and transfers robustness to a compact student in a one-way manner. This paradigm terminates teacher-student interaction once the student is distilled, thereby discarding potentially useful feedback from the distilled student. However, exploiting such feedback is nontrivial because indiscriminate weak-to-strong transfer may propagate student errors to the teacher. To address this issue, we propose Cyclic Adversarial Robustness Distillation (CARD), a closed-loop framework that turns the distilled student into a feedback source for refining the robust teacher and subsequently transfers the teacher gains back to the same student. CARD first performs strong-to-weak adversarial distillation and then uses reliability-enhanced student feedback to refine the robust teacher. The refinement combines inverse adversarial student feedback with teacher-student discrepancy maximization, after which the refined teacher is used to continue training the same student under the unchanged base distillation objective. We further establish a sample-level sufficient condition for reliable weak-to-strong feedba…

item.title: CAFE: Conducting-Cell-Aware Adaptive Differential Encoding for Robust DNN Inference in FeFET-Based Compute-in-Memory
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 FeFET 存算一体（CIM）做 DNN 推理时器件偏差会严重降低位切片精度；FeFET 关态漏电可忽略、误差由导通态单元主导，且二进制补码符号扩展会把小负值映射到高位切片、放大误差。

方法 提出 CAFE 导通单元感知自适应差分编码框架：定义按位显著性加权的导通单元活性度量 C²AM 预测精度退化，用差分权重/激活编码消除符号扩展引起的放大效应；通过类型级枚举、层级 NSGA-II 搜索与后剪枝在鲁棒性-成本间分配编码。

关键数字 C²AM 最高降低 28.6 倍；主部署研究中精度较补码 CIM 提升超 87 个百分点；归一化成本 1.86–2.78 倍，低于均匀全差分编码的 3.06 倍。

为什么值得看 器件机理感知的编码-硬件协同设计，为 FeFET CIM 的鲁棒部署给出新的成本权衡思路。

item.title: BitSparse: Compact Activation Storage for ReLU Feed-Forward Networks
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 稀疏 ReLU/ReLU² 激活的回潮带来第三种训练显存优化机会：对激活缓存本身做无损压缩。

方法 BitSparse 是 GPU 驻留的无损压缩格式：压缩与重构由定制 Triton kernel 实现并融入 autograd 函数，反向传播时精确还原缓存；支持 BF16 与 FP8，可选符号位打包逼近理论压缩极限；另提出预分配缓冲系统，变长张量分配时避免主机同步。

关键数字 Modded-NanoGPT 与 Nemotron-H 上每 token 显存分别降 31% 和 30%，实用序列长度下开销不超过 1%。

为什么值得看 在重计算检查点与有损压缩之外新增一条无损、GPU 原生的训练内存优化路线。

item.title: Beyond Static Positional Encoding: Bayesian Time-aware Attention for Non-Stationary Long-term Time Series Forecasting
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF

Transformers have demonstrated strong performance in long-term time series forecasting (LTSF), yet modeling non-stationary temporal dependencies remains challenging.

Transformers have demonstrated strong performance in long-term time series forecasting (LTSF), yet modeling non-stationary temporal dependencies remains challenging. In this paper, we interpret self-attention as a Bayesian posterior over attended positions, combining a content-based prior induced by scaled dot-product similarity with a temporal-evidence likelihood induced by positional encoding. This formulation provides a probabilistic interpretation of how positional encoding shapes the temporal dependencies captured by self-attention. Building on this perspective, we derive a population-level evidence lower bound (ELBO) that characterizes the role of positional encoding in forecasting weakly stationary time series. Our analysis further highlights a limitation of static positional encoding: when temporal dependence structures vary across input windows, a fixed temporal bias must accommodate heterogeneous dynamics and can therefore be suboptimal for non-stationary forecasting. Motivated by this analysis, we propose Bayesian Time-aware Attention (BTA), which employs a mixture-of-experts (MoE) router to adaptively combine temporal kernels and generate input-conditioned, head-specifi…

item.title: Beyond Expert Rankings: Contrast Calibration for Mixed-Precision MoE Quantization
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 MoE 语言模型每 token 只激活少数专家，但全部专家权重都需存储；混合精度量化可降低存储成本，但仅凭专家排序无法确定各专家误差应加多强的权重。

方法 提出 NatScale 对比校准分配框架：用模型特定的幂变换把基于梯度的专家权重校准到信息论对比目标、同时保留排序；联合评估每个专家的 gate/up/down 配置估计输出误差，再结合基于权重谱、方差与精度衰减的先验，在存储预算下选择配置。

关键数字 3 个模型、5 种分配基线对比下，NatScale 在全部 9 个设置中取得最低原生-量化 KL 散度与最高 top-token 一致性，其中 7 个设置困惑度最低。

为什么值得看 指出"目标感知"的精度分配优于单纯专家排序，对 MoE 低比特部署有直接参考价值。

item.title: Beyond Distribution Matching: Selective Margin Preservation for Supervised Fine-Tuning
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF

Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) changes logit margins among non-target tokens at teacher-forced prefixes.

Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) changes logit margins among non-target tokens at teacher-forced prefixes. Matching a local reference distribution keeps those probabilities and also penalizes margin expansions. We ask whether a soft auxiliary can preserve selected local non-target margin relations without freezing that distribution. We introduce \textbf{Selective Rank-Preserving SFT (SRP-SFT)}, a soft margin target: a hinge on reference-scaled lower bounds for pairs from the reference's top-$K$ non-target tokens, applied at fixed teacher-forced prefixes. The hinge stops once the requested bound is met. We derive the KL cost of violating a margin, characterize the feasible region and its conditional utility, and give a finite-step condition for reducing aggregate violations. In one-epoch experiments on Qwen3-4B-Base and UltraFeedback, this target raises MATH-500 and code-generation scores over CE and LP-SFT at all three training seeds. At seed 1234, MATH-500 pass@1 rises from 49.56\% to 54.56\% and the four-metric code mean rises from 65.91\% to 69.50\% relative to LP-SFT. item.title: Bellman-Consistent Trajectory RL for LLM Arithmetic Reasoning
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF

To address sparse terminal rewards in LLM arithmetic reasoning, we propose a Bellman-consistent trajectory RL method.

To address sparse terminal rewards in LLM arithmetic reasoning, we propose a Bellman-consistent trajectory RL method. Our framework introduces Trajectory Bellman Residual Minimization (TBRM) to transform sparse rewards into dense token-level signals. We integrate a Reinforce Leave-One-Out (RLOO) group strategy to reduce gradient variance of Bellman residuals and use hindsight goal relabeling to accelerate intermediate learning. Evaluated on the Countdown task, our method alleviates optimization bottlenecks and stabilizes gradient variance significantly better than GRPO. The TBRM-RLOO framework boosts Pass@1 to 0.55--0.64 and achieves a state-of-the-art Pass@16 accuracy of 76.0--84.0\%, outperforming the SFT, IPO/DPO, and RLOO baselines. Our approach demonstrates exceptional single-sample efficiency and successfully circumvents standard performance plateaus via test-time scaling.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Behavioral Compositionality of Sparse Autoencoder Representations
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF

Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) represent model activations with sparse, linearly decoded features, but the downstream effects of those features need not compose additively.

Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) represent model activations with sparse, linearly decoded features, but the downstream effects of those features need not compose additively. We introduce SAE Additivity Residuals (SAR), which measure the behavioral variation left unexplained above a chosen interaction order. Under independent feature subset sampling, population SAR is exactly the normalized energy of interactions above that order and bounds coalition ordering error for the optimal low order approximation. To distinguish compositionality associated with the SAE representation from that induced by downstream computation, we compare learned SAE coordinates with sum preserving random rotations of the same selected subspace and find lower first order residuals for the learned coordinates across all 18 model and behavior settings. The coordinates are nevertheless not fully additive: pairwise terms improve held out coalition ordering in every setting and outperform parameter matched models using randomly selected third order terms. item.title: Backpropagating Verifier Rewards Through Continuous Flow Language Models
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF

Reinforcement learning (RL) has substantially improved the reasoning of autoregressive and discrete-diffusion language models.

Reinforcement learning (RL) has substantially improved the reasoning of autoregressive and discrete-diffusion language models. Language models that generate continuous token embeddings are emerging as a strong alternative, but RL post-training for them remains understudied. We propose \method{}, a post-training framework for continuous flow language models. Such a model denoises token embeddings over multiple steps and decodes them into discrete tokens only at the last step. To obtain pathwise gradients, which backpropagate through continuous actions and have much lower variance than REINFORCE, we introduce a critic that estimates the value of intermediate token embeddings, bypassing the non-differentiable decoding step. The critic must also keep track of the value function as the policy changes; to this end, we design a critic that predicts a value from every token representation and improves policy optimization. Across four reasoning tasks, \method{} reliably improves a continuous flow language model through RL post-training and outperforms baseline methods of the same type.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: BOLT: Multi-Bottleneck Bound-Guided Learning for Flexible Job-Shop Scheduling with Time Lags and Resource-Coupled Transport
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF

Flexible job-shop scheduling becomes resource-coupled when a scarce vehicle fleet moves jobs between stations, because the schedule sets the transport waits.

Flexible job-shop scheduling becomes resource-coupled when a scarce vehicle fleet moves jobs between stations, because the schedule sets the transport waits. BOLT (bound-oriented learning for transport-coupled scheduling) builds a lower bound from chain, machine-capacity, and fleet-capacity relaxations. The bound equals the makespan at termination, so its per-step changes form a reward that sums to a constant minus the makespan. Because it never exceeds the attainable makespan, each candidate's bound increase is a proven rise of the makespan floor, which the policy reads as a price. The root bound certifies a completed schedule's suboptimality gap without a solver. On industry-motivated 10-module prefabricated-construction instances, explicit transport coupling outperforms a transport-penalty policy in every tested cell where loaded moves occupy at least 66% of fleet time and in none at or below 56%. Across five zero-shot 50- and 80-module production batches, BOLT outperforms the best dispatching-rule pair on four and the penalty policy on the three with long moves. In the three-vehicle 80-module batch, its mean makespan is 13.0% below the best pair and 4.2% below an hour-budget co…

item.title: Augment the Cache, Replace the Activation: A 2x2 Study of Internal-State Sharing
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF

Multi-agent systems built from frozen language models communicate through text, which discards the internal state the sender already computed and makes the receiver pay to rebuild it.

Multi-agent systems built from frozen language models communicate through text, which discards the internal state the sender already computed and makes the receiver pay to rebuild it. Work on internal channels avoids that cost, framing the problem as transfer: agent A sends information to agent B. Every agent pair that must communicate needs its own transfer bridge, and every agent added to a system needs a new bridge fitted against each previous agent. We reframe this problem as sharing: an agent publishes its internal state once into a pool, and every peer reads that pool through a single mechanism fitted to no sender in particular, so adding an agent adds a publisher and no new bridge. Whereas the carrier of the internal state and the fusion mechanism are usually chosen independently in the literature, our main finding is that these two choices are coupled; the deciding factor is where the carrier enters the receiver's computation. Consumability is a property of the receiving computation rather than of the representation. item.title: Asymptotically Exact Negative Guidance of Diffusion Models via Positive-Unlabeled Learning
item.description:

Negative guidance of diffusion models generates samples that avoid an undesired condition, specified either by reference samples or by a conditional score alongside an unconditional model.

Negative guidance of diffusion models generates samples that avoid an undesired condition, specified either by reference samples or by a conditional score alongside an unconditional model. Existing methods inject repulsive terms derived from local information at each sample, so the resulting sampler does not target an explicit density, and its bias cannot be systematically reduced by increasing computation. We instead present a negative-guidance method that samples from an explicit target density, which uniformly handles both reference-sample and score-based specifications and suppresses probability mass near the undesired condition with an avoidance strength that parametrizes the target density itself. Realizing this target requires estimating, at each diffusion timestep, how likely each sample is to belong to the undesired condition. We cast this estimation as a Positive-Unlabeled learning problem that admits lightweight online training along the diffusion trajectory, using condition samples as positives and diffusion particles as unlabeled data. item.title: Asymptotic Behavior of Transformers
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF

In this paper we study the behavior of transformer networks generating text over long periods of time.

In this paper we study the behavior of transformer networks generating text over long periods of time. We show that even a three-token, single-layer attention-only transformer can fail to converge. We then study a rich class of transformers with arbitrary finite depth, layer normalization, MLPs, RoPE encodings, and an arbitrary mix of local and global layers. Every transformer in this class has a softmax temperature threshold above which its empirical cache distribution converges to a unique limit, independent of initial conditions. We show further that, while each transformer has a temperature threshold, the supremum of this set is infinite, so there is no global minimal temperature that forces all transformers to converge.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Architecting for Hardware Diversity: Meta's End-to-End Co-Design for High-Performance AI Training on AMD GPUs
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 长期积累的 NVIDIA 专属优化阻碍性能可移植，如何在 AMD GPU 上拉起大规模 AI 训练。

方法 以 MI350X 对比 B200 的推荐模型训练为案例，给出三条可复用原则：硬件-模型协同设计（改造模型结构与配方以利用 MI350X 1.6 倍 HBM 容量，而非直接移植）、解析性能模型实现零预热选核、以及用 agentic 工作流做 CUDA 迁移与微架构感知优化。

关键数字 相比直接移植基线，端到端训练吞吐最高提升 1.5 倍；作者称这是超大规模厂商首次公开 AMD GPU 大规模训练生产化报告，成果已上游合入 PyTorch、Triton、ROCm。

为什么值得看 异构算力车队与供应商多元化的第一手方法论，软硬协同细节值得借鉴。

item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF

Gaussian diffusion models offer a practical framework for generative modeling.

Gaussian diffusion models offer a practical framework for generative modeling. Denoising Lévy Probabilistic Models (DLPM) introduce heavy-tailed perturbations with a fixed tail index throughout denoising. We introduce Annealed Lévy Diffusion (ALD). ALD varies the stability index $α(t)$ to combine heavy-tailed exploration with Gaussian refinement. Our marginal-first formulation represents stable noise as a scalar Gaussian scale mixture. This formulation enables standard Gaussian noise-prediction training with one additional scale input. We study two sampling processes. ALD-renoise estimates the clean sample and injects fresh marginal noise. item.title: AlphaBet: Reinforcement Learning for LLM Event Forecasting Agents
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF

Forecasting an unresolved event requires finding relevant evidence and deciding how strongly it supports each outcome.

Forecasting an unresolved event requires finding relevant evidence and deciding how strongly it supports each outcome. Yet outcome-based training of Large Language Model (LLM) forecasters often begins with preassembled evidence at a single prediction date, leaving evidence acquisition outside the learning loop. We introduce AlphaBet, an agentic reinforcement learning (RL) framework that trains a single LLM policy to search, reason, and report probabilities across multiple pre-resolution dates. Each dated forecast is scored by a proper scoring rule against the eventual outcome, allowing one resolved event to supervise decisions under different information states. We decompose forecasting regret into an evidence-acquisition gap and a probability-reporting gap, and show that Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO)'s standard-deviation normalization can distort the reporting target under multi-class proper scores. item.title: Activation-Adjacent Layer Normalization: Effects on Approximation Power
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF

Layer normalization (LN) and root mean square normalization (RMSNorm) depend on their inputs and remain nonlinear at inference.

Layer normalization (LN) and root mean square normalization (RMSNorm) depend on their inputs and remain nonlinear at inference. Inserting either next to an activation may therefore change the function a network represents. We study when shallow activation-normalized (AN) and preactivation-normalized (PN) networks can approximate a prescribed width-$N$ one-hidden-layer MLP. Viewing RMSNorm as input-dependent scaling, we use width augmentation to locally linearize normalization on compact feature sets. For AN networks, an unbounded activation range allows width $N+1$, while every continuous nonconstant activation admits width $N+r$ with error $O_f(r^{-1})$. For PN networks, affine parameters or, without them, degree-one positive homogeneity recover width $N+1$; general continuous activations admit width $N+r$ with error tending to zero. The corresponding LN constructions use centered coordinate pairs, yielding widths $N+2$ and $N+2r$, respectively. We prove that $N+1$ for RMSNorm and $N+2$ for LN are also the worst-case bound for approximations, and show that applicable universal-approximation theorems for ordinary MLPs transfer to these normalized architectures. Numerical experiment…

item.title: Accelerated Dataflow: scaling inference in streaming data analytics with efficiency
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：流式数据系统历来按数据搬运优化，跑 GPU 上 LLM 推理这类重算负载很吃力；混合流式 ML 负载在异构资源上如何同时兼顾吞吐、时延与峰值资源占用？

方法：在 Google Cloud Dataflow 上做协同设计的系统：异构 worker 池的自动扩缩 + prefix-aware batching，把 LLM 推理自然嵌入流式管线，与数据搬运调度共享同一基础设施。

关键数字：相对已有流式处理系统，吞吐提升 1.5x–2x，峰值资源节省最高 75%，峰值尾时延下降 84%。

为什么值得看：把 LLM 推理塞进既有流式平台且给出生产级数据，给"实时风控/内容审核"类场景提供了一个可复用的工程样板。

原文：Accelerated Dataflow: scaling inference in streaming data analytics with efficiency

item.title: AMAX: Accuracy-Aware Multi-Loop Asymmetric Perforation for Heterogeneous Architectures
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 异构多核系统受热约束制约，DVFS 与任务迁移在高负载下开销大；近似计算中的循环穿孔可减少计算量，但现有方法对所有循环施加统一穿孔率，忽略了各循环的敏感度差异。

方法 提出 AMAX 精度感知多循环非对称穿孔框架：通过逐循环剖析与多目标配置选择压缩组合设计空间，得到非对称穿孔配置，并在运行时按性能需求动态调整配置。

关键数字 在 PARSEC 基准上，相同性能目标下归一化精度相对对称穿孔最高提升 0.85。

为什么值得看 给出"剖析-选择-运行时调节"的完整循环级近似计算流程，对异构平台热约束下的精度感知优化有直接借鉴意义。

item.title: AI-Driven, Timing-Aware Power Optimization
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF

Post-route power recovery changes cell choices under tightly coupled timing, electrical and physical constraints, and the value of each change depends on what it costs to repair its side effects.

Post-route power recovery changes cell choices under tightly coupled timing, electrical and physical constraints, and the value of each change depends on what it costs to repair its side effects. We propose an AI-driven framework in which a learned model drives both phases of the optimization: it ranks the powerrecovery edits to try and the repair actions that follow, while deterministic electronic design automation (EDA) analyses govern every acceptance. The framework records baseline constraint margins, identifies the damage a recovery transaction introduces in each analysis view, holds pre-existing violations at their baseline rather than working them inside the power step, and caps repair spending at a fraction of the measured saving. An ensemble of gradient-boosted models predicts power change, normalized damage reduction and constraint-regression risk from action and timing-context features available before each trial; calibrated, conservative estimates feed separate acquisition scores for recovery and repair, with a deterministic fallback when the model is uncertain. Recovery and repair remain speculative until physical implementation and fresh analysis establish baseline pr…

item.title: ABNAT: Attention-Based Noise-Aware Training for Robust Transformers on Analog Compute-in-Memory Systems
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 模拟存算一体（CIM）的硬件噪声会扰动存储权重、拖累 Transformer 性能，而现有噪声感知训练忽视了注意力机制。

方法 作者观察到干净与含噪注意力图的偏差随层深显著增大，且常规 NAT 在注意力路由已偏离时仍过度自信；ABNAT 让含噪学生模仿干净教师的逐头注意力路由而非只复现答案，不改硬件、无推理开销。

关键数字 视觉、语言、多模态 Transformer 上一致优于对应 NAT 基线：噪声下精度最多提升 11.28%，注意力偏差最多降低 85.77%。

为什么值得看 用注意力路由蒸馏提升 CIM 上 Transformer 的鲁棒性，训练侧低成本、部署侧零改动。

item.title: A Large-Dimensional Analysis of Least-Squares Federated Learning via Generalized Total Variation Minimization
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-15　分类：论文PDF

Federated learning over decentralized networks inherently trades off the suppression of local finite-sample noise through collaboration against the bias that collaboration introduces between heterogeneous nodes.

Federated learning over decentralized networks inherently trades off the suppression of local finite-sample noise through collaboration against the bias that collaboration introduces between heterogeneous nodes. We study this tension by performing a large-dimensional analysis of Generalized Total Variation Minimization with least-squares models. Using tools from random matrix theory, we show that Lipschitz observations of the global GTVMin solution concentrate in large dimensions, universally for any underlying network structure. We provide exact analytic expressions for the asymptotically precise performance under both i.i.d. and non-i.i.d. Gaussian mixture distributions on a fixed network. For the latter, these expressions quantify how regularization balances local adaptation against collaboration. Our theoretical results are confirmed by experiments on synthetic and real-world data.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。
